Description: Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. produces and sells iron and steel products in Turkey. The company’s product portfolio includes railway rails and wheels profiles wire rods rebars billets granule blast furnace slag and products from its air separation plant. It offers GI sections for mine support as well as coke and by-products. The company also engages in casting and machining services energy business steel structure manufacturing and assembly insurance brokerage activities and urban and intercity freight transportation. Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Karabük Turkey.

Name: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company engages in the research development manufacture and marketing of generic medicines and pharmaceutical preparations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Private Public and Export. Its product portfolio includes dermatological respiratory cardiovascular alimentary and anti-infectives musculoskeletal genitourinary systems and CNS. The company also exports its products. Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company was formerly known as Middle East Chemical Products Factory Company and changed its name to Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company in January 2006. Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries Company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A.
Description: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. explores for and operates mining concessions in Peru Europe Asia and the United States. The company operates through six segments: Volcan Chungar Cerro investments energy and Others. It primarily explores for zinc copper lead and silver deposits. The company holds interests in Yauli Animon Alpamarca and Cerro mines located in the department of Cerro de Pasco and Junín and Lima. It also engages in electric power generation; real estate development; port and logistic activities; non-operating; and other activities. In addition the company operates and maintains electric transmission system generation plants. Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Transition Metals AG.

Name: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S.
Description: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S. produces imports and markets agricultural and veterinary pesticides in Turkey. The company’s crop protection products include fungicides herbicides insecticides acaricides biological products fumigants and nemathists plant growth regulators winter struggle medicines and summer oils spreaders-adhesives pheromons and molluscicide and others. It offers smart base organically coated foliar and pure fertilizers; organominerals; drip irrigation; biological preparation; and other plant nutrition products. In addition the company provides tomato pepper cucumber eggplant wheat bean pea corn sunflower cotton and barley seeds. Further it provides ruminant and poultry products such as antibacterials vitamins and minerals and feed additive; and pet products including cat litter and pet care products as well as environmental health products. Additionally the company involves in development activities to establish greenhouses and specially equipped areas. Hektas Ticaret T.A.S. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Gebze Turkey.

Name: Mediterranean Towers Ltd.
Description: Mediterranean Towers Ltd. owns and operates residential homes for the elderly population in Israel. The company also owns land for construction. Mediterranean Towers Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Ganei Tikva Israel.

Name: Sok Marketler Ticaret A.S.
Description: Sok Marketler Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates in retail sector in Turkey. The company sells fast-moving consuming products. Its products portfolio includes dairy products such as milk butter cream cheese butter milk yogurt cocoa milk ice cream and milk puddings; fruit juices; spices comprising sumac carbonate red pepper flakes pepper coconut sesame cumin currants black cumin cinnamon eight oregano and pistachios; dry foods including bulgur rice lentils nohut wheat beans chickpeas and corn; pasta soups flour semolina starch cooking bases and bouillons and cooking aids; corn sunflower and canola oils; margarine kase; laundry conditioners washing powders general cleaning products and washing liquids; tea; olives and olive oils; canned foods gravies and sauces; chips and dryfruits; and cappuccino and coffee products. The company also provides shaving foams and related products; tissues napkins and toilet papers; wet towels soaps and colognes; fries potato coquettes mixed pizza peas meatballs ravioli puff pastry and sweet corn; and molasses and tahin and related products. In addition it offers wafers and cakes; pretzels stick crackers biscuits and creams; and soda and soft drinks as well as kitchenware cleaners paper products and clothing items. The company sells its products under the Mis Anadolu Mutfagi Piyale Evin Mintax Deren Lio Bizim Vatan AMIGO LEZZCAFE ADAM Beyaz Guvercin Ebru iNCi Taskale Peki Tempo Crown and Karmen brands. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacture marketing and sale of vehicle tires in Turkey and internationally. The company offers tires for radial passenger car truck minibus bus outer tires automobiles light commercial vehicles buses trucks and agricultural and construction machinery under the Bridgestone Lassa Dayton Firestone and Kinesis brand names; tire retreading services under the Bandag brand name; and vehicle maintenance services. It provides digital fleet services through Filofix road assistance mobile application and fleet services under the Probox Mobilfix and Propratik brands. The company offers its products and services through its stores and e-commerce platform under Lastik.com.tr website. The company was formerly known as Lassa Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in 1988. Brisa Bridgestone Sabanci Lastik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Petroreconcavo S.A.
Description: Petroreconcavo S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Mata De Sao Joao Brazil.

Name: Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio
Description: Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio produces and sells aluminum products. The company provides bauxite hydrate alumina molten aluminum ingots secondary ingots slabs billets rod caster rolls caster sheet and coils hot-rolled sheet and coils roofing and siding foil coated foil extruded profiles surface treatment lines custom parts and components and services. It also owns and operates hydroelectric power plants. The company serves e automotive building and construction energy agribusiness consumer goods packaging transportation and other industries. It operates in Brazil South America North America and Europe. Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio operates as a subsidiary of Votorantim S.A.

Name: JSE Limited
Description: JSE Limited operates as a multi-asset class stock exchange in South Africa. It offers listing services for securities and debt instruments; trading colocation and client support services across its markets; post-trade services such as risk management as well as clearing and settlement assurance for the exchange’s equity bonds and derivatives markets; transfer secretarial services including share register maintenance issuer communication the handling of corporate actions and share scheme management to issuers; and central securities depository service. The company provides market data products comprising live data for JSE-listed equities derivatives and bonds as well as a selection of historical data products to market professionals and data distributors; and Issuer Services including results presentations and investor engagements annual general meeting facilitation and training through the JSE Training Academy. In addition it operates a private placements platform to address the needs of companies that seek to raise capital. The company was founded in 1887 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company
Description: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company invests in and develops properties. The company operates through four segments: Real Estate Property Management Contracting Activities Investing Activities and Sales of Goods and Services. Its project portfolio includes master communities residential commercial hospitality and industrial projects. The company is involved in central air-conditioning requisites manufacturing and fire fighting equipment assembling; cold storage and warehousing; facilities management security mechanical electrical and plumbing works and energy management services; building management and consultancy for motor racing tracks; manufacturing and interior decoration; and owners association management. It is also engaged in real estate development; investment in equities; facilities management services; trading activities; investment and management of companies; lifeguard services; and facilities management security mechanical electrical and plumbing works and energy management services. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A.
Description: Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A. is involved in the distribution of electricity in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Companhia de Eletricidade do Rio de Janeiro. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil. Ampla Energia e Serviços S.A. is a subsidiary of Enel Brasil S.A.

Name: Italtile Limited
Description: Italtile Limited manufactures retails and franchises tiles bathroom ware and related home-finishing products in South Africa rest of Africa and Australia. The company imports distributes and retails brassware and accessories laminate and vinyl floor boards bathroom furniture shower enclosures sanitaryware décor and other home finishing products; tiles and bathware and related products; taps shower enclosures and bathroom furniture and accessories; and paint ceiling décor lighting laminate flooring window blinds and tile adhesives. It also manufactures and sells glazed porcelain floor tiles ceramic wall and floor tiles vitreous China sanitary ware acrylic baths adhesives shower trays grout adhesives paints and related products. In addition the company provides logistics and warehousing services. It sells its products under the Italtile Retail CTM and TopT brands through retail stores and online. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa. Italtile Limited operates as a subsidiary of Rallen Proprietary Limited.

Name: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc
Description: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc provides cellular radio telecommunication services for individual and business customers in Zambia. The company offers voice services 4G data home broadband and internet services SMS services MiFi’s and routers value added services and international calling and roaming services for individual customers. It also provides fixed voice bulk SMS closed user group postpaid hybrid roaming and toll-free services; dedicated internet data center international leased circuit co-location and National VPN services; and audio and video conferencing and virtual PABX services for businesses. The company was formerly known as Celtel Zambia Plc and changed its name to Airtel Networks Zambia Plc in April 2013. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. Airtel Networks Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Zambia Holdings BV.

Name: Isiklar Enerji ve Yapi Holding A.S.
Description: Isiklar Enerji ve Yapi Holding A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates in the paper sack casting energy construction and contracting textile and building materials fields in Turkey and internationally. The company operates three river type hydroelectric power plants. It also manufactures and sells paper sacks; and provides alloyed grinding products to cement and mining companies. In addition the company manufactures pressed coating and floor bricks; cotto clinker pang hand and facade systems; and flex joint sealants and adhesives ceramics adhesives and joint sealants liquid silicones and brick surface cleaners. Further it manufactures sells and exports polyester yarns; and constructs water structures bridges tunnels roads factories treatment plants infra-structure facilities pipelines houses and commercial buildings. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Saudi Manpower Solutions Company
Description: Saudi Manpower Solutions Company provides recruitment manpower and logistics services and support solutions to workers government and private sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Corporate Individual and Other segments. The company manages employees’ housing and transportation solutions; and offers manpower under short-term contracts. It provides storage facilities for various types of goods; accommodation services transportation services; wholesale activities for prepaid cards; custom software programming; network and information communications management and monitoring services; data processing services and related services; and investment services as well as establishes infrastructure for hosting websites on the network. Further the company offers integrated administrative services for offices; ground management services and supervision at airport ground service providers; temporary employment agencies for expatriate labour services; call centre services; mobile communication services; rental of communication facilities; monitoring of communication and information networks; and digital authentication services as well as cleaning services. It serves construction industrial retail healthcare hospitality logistics oil gas and petrochemical and other sectors. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Saudi Manpower Solutions Company is a subsidiary of Al Holoul Al Mutakamela Holding Company.

Name: GB Corp
Description: GB Corp engages in the assembly manufacture sale distribution financing and after-sales service of automotive products in the Middle East and Egypt. It operates through Passenger Car Buses and Trucks 2 & 3 Wheels Financial Non-Banking Services and Other Operations segments. The company offers new and used heavy trucks semi-trucks passenger cars buses mini and micro buses agriculture tractors cranes and mechanical tools equipment for soil movement and motors with various structures. It also provides trailers superstructures and construction and farming equipment; motorcycles; and three-wheelers. In addition the company is involved in trading spare parts and accessories and tires for vehicles and equipment as well as light trucks; undertakes import and export activities; provision of microfinancing nano-financing SME lending factoring mortgage finance leasing venture capital securitization consumer lending and insurance services. It sells its products under the Hyundai Mazda Chery Changan Haval Karry Bajaj Marcopolo Volvo Truck and Volvo Bus Volvo Construction Equipment Mitsubishi Fuso SDLG Higer Shacman Lassa Yokohama DoubleCoin Goodyear Thunderer MRF Sunfull and MG as well as Westlake Verde and Techking brands. The company was formerly known as GB Auto (S.A.E.) and changed its name to GB Corp in May 2023. The company was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Adcock Ingram Holdings Limited
Description: Adcock Ingram Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture marketing and distribution of healthcare products to private and public sectors in Southern Africa and India. It operates through four segments: Consumer Over the Counter (OTC) Prescription and Hospital Products and Services. The company provides various healthcare personal care and homecare products through FMCG retailers and corporate pharmacies; OTC medicinal products through corporate and independent pharmacies; branded and generic prescription products and specialized instrumentation and surgical products; and hospital products and services. It also offers various products in the therapeutic areas including hypertension cholesterol diabetes depression anxiety insomnia psychosis epilepsy dementia pain headache inflammation joint pain gout dipolar disorder heartburn acne and bacterial and fungal infections. In addition the company provides medicines for cardiovascular health hyperlipidaemia and metabolic syndrome; psychiatric and neurological diseases; dry skin eczema psoriasis rosacea and skin infection; and women’s health comprising bacterial vaginosis menopause osteoporosis and urinary. Adcock Ingram Holdings Limited was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Midrand South Africa. Adcock Ingram Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of The Bidvest Group Limited.

Name: Fidelity Bank Plc
Description: Fidelity Bank Plc provides various banking products and services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Investment Banking segments. The company offers current savings fixed deposit domiciliary term deposit flex bridge vintage and small business accounts; asset leasing personal loans and mortgages fast loans and salary advance schemes; bills settlement and cash and asset management services; treasury bills fixed income securities and foreign exchange and derivatives and safe deposit keeping services; and advisory insurance investment management estate planning wire transfer and tax planning services. Its corporate banking products and services comprise overdraft and advances trade finance bonds and guarantees receivables discounting and factoring distributor and suppliers financing asset based financing corporate and project finance collection payment solutions treasury and liquidity management relationship management transaction and business advisory and corporate account management. In addition it offers commercial support overdrafts and short term loans and development finance loans; agriculture banking services; and equipment leasing online banking mobile app instant banking point of sale terminal online payment and ATM services as well as cards. Further it provides private banking and collection of deposit services. The company was formerly known as Fidelity Union Merchant Bank Limited and changed its name to Fidelity Bank Plc in 1999. Fidelity Bank Plc was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E. engages in producing manufacturing processing and packaging of dairy products juices and cooking products in Egypt. The company produces plain and flavored milk yogurt specialty drinks and cooking creams under the Juhayna brand as well as cheeses fruit juices and frozen materials; and operates dairy farms. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company
Description: Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company engages in the wholesale and retail sale of household utensils electrical appliances and cleaning supplies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers coffee machines dough mixers refrigerators and freezers electric pots air fryers and thermos. It also engages in the general contracting; construction repair restoration and demolition of buildings; public construction of road works water and sewage works dams drilling wells; maintenance and operation of electrical mechanical and electronic installation; landscaping and blacksmithing carpentry aluminum decoration gypsum maintenance and cleaning works; management and operation of cities utilities buildings and public and private facilities; and buying and owning real estate and lands to construct buildings. It also sells its products online. Al-Saif Stores for Development & Investment Company was founded in 1993 in and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A.
Description: Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A. through its subsidiaries offers banking insurance and asset management products and services in Latin America. It offers health and automobile insurances as well as property services; trust and custody administration services; investment portfolio management and banking services; and mutual funds. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Mercantil Servicios Financieros C.A. operates as a subsidiary of Mercantil Servicios Financieros Internacional S.A.

Name: Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E.
Description: Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E. engages in developing buildings and integrated communities in Egypt. The company operates through Hotels Real Estate Land Sales Town Management and Other Activities segments. It develops residences hotels and commercial and leisure amenities such as golf courses sports facilities retail and restaurants and marinas; provides hospitality services; sells land and land rights; and offers facilities and infrastructure services at resorts and towns. The company also offers real estate rental mortgages sports hospital services educational services marina rentals limousine rentals and other services. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Orascom Development Egypt S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Orascom Development Holding AG.

Name: Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited
Description: Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited an investment holding company operates media and broadcasting gaming transport properties coal mining and branded products and manufacturing businesses in South Africa Other African countries the Middle East Europe and the United Kingdom. The company owns and operates hotel and leisure such as casinos hotels galaxy bingo sites gaming machines and vslots. It also involved in the operation of conference and exhibition industrial inner-city housing mixed-use precincts office student accommodation and retail properties. In addition the company engages in textile and non-woven textile manufacturing toy distribution and property investment activities. Further the company involved in the coal mining; and exploration and development of palladium. Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Compañía General de Electricidad S.A.
Description: Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. through its subsidiary engages in the distribution and transmission of electricity business in Chile. It sells the 11058 GWh capacity of power. The company was founded in 1905 and is based in Santiago Chile. Compañía General de Electricidad S.A. is a subsidiary of State Grid Chile Electricity Spa.

Name: CVK Maden Isletmeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: CVK Maden Isletmeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in production marketing and sale of chrome marble travertine lead zinc copper and magnesite ores. It also purchases sells markets imports and exports finished products semi-finished products concentrates and raw mineral ores. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Invictus Investment Company PLC
Description: Invictus Investment Company PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in trading of agricultural commodities and food products in Africa the Middle East Europe the Americas and Asia. It operates in two segments International Trading Business and Agri Commodities Wholesale Trading & Local Distribution. It trades in oilseeds sugar and sweeteners grains and cereals animal feed vegetable oils cotton and textiles ingredients and meat. The company is also involved in trading of non-manufactured precious metals and other general commodities. In addition it provides sea cargo and shipping lines agents services. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Invictus Investment Company PLC is a subsidiary of Invictus Holding Limited.

Name: MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public)
Description: MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public) provides managed information technology (IT) services and solutions in Qatar the Middle East and North Africa. The company offers data center cloud managed security solution and workplace services as well as master system integrator services. It also provides software designing and programming; trades in computer network equipment and device; information technology consulting; stores data and documents; and designs electronic sites. MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public) was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A.
Description: Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A. generates and sells electricity in Brazil. The company operates eight hydroelectric power plants; and two small hydroelectric plants that have an installed capacity of 2297.8 megawatts. The company was formerly known as Duke Energy International Geração Paranapanema S.A. and changed its name in January 2017. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Sao Paulo Brazil. Rio Paranapanema Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Rio Paranapanema Participações S.A.

Name: Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. provides various financial services. It provides brokerage credit operational and financial leasing factoring stock market intermediary and other services. The company was formerly known as Grupo Financiero Fina Value SA de CV and changed its name to Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. in May 2000. Value Grupo Financiero S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in insurance and reinsurance operations in Kuwait. It operates in four segments: Non-life insurance Life insurance Reinsurance and Investments. The company offers motor insurance such as third party liability comprehensive vehicle personal accident public liability car total loss driver license and unified orange card insurance policies; life and medical insurance including travel individual life group life and medical insurance policies; and marine insurance such as marine hull and marine cargo insurance. It also offers property insurance including fire and household protection policies; engineering insurance policies such as contractors all risk erection all risk contractors plant and machinery machinery breakdown loss of profit due to machinery breakdown electronic equipment and deterioration of stock in cold stores insurance policies; liability insurance including general public liability professional indemnity and product liability insurance; and general accidents insurance such as money fidelity guarantee glass plate burglary personal accident workmen's compensation employer's liability bankers blanket directors and officers liability and decennial liability insurance products. In addition the company engages in investment activities. Al-Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi operates in the photovoltaic power generation sector in Turkey. The company offers inverters comprising of hybrid irrigation communication and monitoring solar irrigation off and on grid inventors; MPPT and PWM charge controllers; solar equipment energy storage heating solar panels and cooling related equipment. It also provides solar packs such as vineyard house/caravan packages boat/yacht packages micro inverter kits carport packages and agricultural irrigation packages. In addition the company offers solar-power irrigation systems off-grid and on-grid solutions solar power camera systems and signages and Led lighting system services. Further it provides technical and maintenance services. CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Antalya Turkey.

Name: Grupo SBF S.A.
Description: Grupo SBF S.A. retails and wholesales sports and leisure products in Brazil. It offers footwear clothing sports equipment and accessories. It also provides logistics services; and organizing races and sporting events under the Xterra and Uphill brands. In addition the company engages in the advertising films and audiovisual production businesses. Further it operates dance platform and sports channel network. The company sells its sports and leisure products through physical stores and e-commerce channels. Grupo SBF S.A. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Thungela Resources Limited
Description: Thungela Resources Limited engages in the mining and production of thermal coal in South Africa and Australia. It owns interests in and produces its thermal coal from mining operations consisting of underground and open cast mines in the Mpumalanga province of South Africa including Goedehoop colliery Greenside colliery Isibonelo colliery Khwezela colliery Zibulo colliery and Mafube colliery. It also holds 85% of the Ensham Mine located in Queensland Australia. The company also exports its products to Indian Asian Southeast Asian the Middle East and North African markets. Thungela Resources Limited was founded in 1945 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Enel Distribucion Chile S.A.
Description: Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. distributes electricity in Chile. It distributes electricity across 33 communes with concession area covering 2105 square kilometers in the Metropolitan region. The company was formerly known as Chilectra S.A. and changed its name to Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. in October 2016. Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. was founded in 1996 and is based in Santiago Chile. Enel Distribucion Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Enel Chile S.A.

Name: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A.
Description: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. produces distributes and sells cement and cement-related materials in Peru. It operates in three segments: Cement Concrete Mortar and Precast; Quicklime; and Sales of Construction Supplies. The company offers cement and concrete products for use in residential and commercial construction and civil engineering; ready-mix concrete for use in construction sites; concrete precast such as paving units or paver stones for pedestrian walkways as well as other bricks for partition walls and concrete precast for structural and non-structural uses; and cement-based products. It also produces and distributes quicklime for use in steel food fishing and chemical industries. In addition the company sells and distributes other construction materials manufactured by third parties such as steel rebar wires nails corrugated iron electric conductors and plastic tubes and accessories. It offers its products directly to other retailers private construction companies and through a network of independent retailers and hardware stores. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones ASPI S.A.

Name: Plano & Plano Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A.
Description: Plano & Plano Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. through its subsidiaries develops constructs and sells real estate projects in the São Paulo Metropolitan Region. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Forus S.A.
Description: Forus S.A. designs develops markets and distributes footwear apparel accessories and beauty/ personal care products in Chile Peru Colombia and Uruguay. The company offers its products under the CAT RKF Columbia Under Armour Merrell BSoul VANS Hush Puppies Azaleia Norseg and as of this year Crocs and L’OCCITANE en Provence brand names. It serves its customers through sales channels which include physical stores e-commerce websites and wholesale and third-party marketplaces. The company was formerly known as Comercial Hush Puppies Chile Limitada and changed its name to Forus S.A. in December 1991. Forus S.A. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Forus S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Costanera Limitada.

Name: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S.
Description: Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. manufactures and sells cement and clinker products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers portland cement clinkers and potassium silicate cement; portland cement sulphate resistant portland cement portland compound cement and pozzolanic cement; and aggregates and cement bypass dust. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. Batisöke Söke Çimento Sanayii T.A.S. is a subsidiary of Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd
Description: Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd engages in the provident and pension funds management activities in Israel. The company manages savings provident funds central severance pay provident funds central provident funds for budgetary pension participation as well as investment provident funds which include children savings plan and comprehensive pension funds and general pension funds. It is also involved in the management of alternative real estate investments. The company was formerly known as A.S. Matrat Hanpaka Ltd and changed its name to Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd in March 2022. Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel. Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd is a subsidiary of Altshuler Shaham Ltd.

Name: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells cement Portland cement clinker and ready mixed concrete in Central Anatolia and the Mediterranean Region. It also offers testing and analysis services. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Konya Turkey. Konya Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Parficim S.A.

Name: Construtora Tenda S.A.
Description: Construtora Tenda S.A. operates as a construction company in Brazil. It engages in the execution and management of civil construction works; real estate development; purchase and sale of real estate and land; provision of civil construction management services; and intermediation of the sale of consortium shares. The company was founded in 1969 is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper
Description: Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of container boards and industrial papers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Middle East Africa Asia and Europe. The company operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Trading. The Manufacturing segment provides containerboards comprising high performance fluting test liner dual use kraft liner board and white top test liner products under MEPFLUTE MEPLINER MEPDUAL MEPKRAFT and MEPWHITE brand names for use in beverages consumer durables detergents industrial goods and processed food industries; and semi-chemical fluting products under the MEPCHEM brand name for frozen and fresh food applications. The segment also offers paperboards including core boards under the MEPCORE brand name for film tape and label textiles and paper applications; plasterboard liners under the MEPGYPSUM brand name for interior wall lining systems; and absorbent kraft products under the MEPLAMINATE brand name for laminated furniture and shelves and counters and floors as well as industrial and tissue papers. In addition it is involved in the wholesale and retail sale of paper carton and plastic waste products; production and sale of tissue paper rolls; wholesale of wastes scrap and other products; provision of waste management and treatment services; recycling and collection of carton waste; and manufacture import and export of cartons. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Movida Participações S.A.
Description: Movida Participações S.A. through its subsidiaries provides car rental services in Brazil. It operates in two segments Rent-a-Car and Fleet Management and Outsourcing (GTF). The company offers light vehicle rental services; fleet management and outsourcing services; fleet sizing study including acquisition customization and standardization of the customer's fleet; management of maintenance provision of temporary vehicles spare car documentation management and demobilization; and corrective and preventive maintenance insurance tire replacement and replacement vehicles for maintenance periods. It also sells pre-owned cars. The company was formerly known as H.L.C.S.P.E Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. and changed its name to Movida Participações S.A. in December 2014. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Movida Participações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Simpar S.A.

Name: Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A.
Description: Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A. provides various banking and financial services to professionals individuals and corporate clients in Ivory Coast. It offers various accounts credits payments money transfers savings and investments cash management solutions and insurance services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire S.A. operates as a subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA.

Name: Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. designs manufactures and sells components and systems for land vehicles including special purpose mobility vehicles in Turkey and internationally. It offers axle and suspension system components for commercial vehicles and special vehicle applications including fabricated axle housings tag axles air bellow beams trailer axles pusher axles and cast axles machining. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Bayraktar Holding A.S.

Name: Amen Bank Société anonyme
Description: Amen Bank Société anonyme provides banking products and services to individuals and businesses in Tunisia. It offers savings and term deposits; and investment products. The company was formerly known as Crédit Foncier et Commercial de Tunisie. Amen Bank Société anonyme was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the retail of health and wellness products. The company also provides medicamentos non-perishable food and hygiene and beauty products as well as photography. The company was founded in 1917 and is based in Monterrey Mexico. Farmacias Benavides S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Walgreens Boots Alliance Inc.

Name: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S.
Description: Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. manufactures and sells solar panels to solar power plants in Turkey and internationally. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Kalyon Günes Teknolojileri Üretim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Kalyon Teknoloji Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Advanced Building Industries Co.
Description: Advanced Building Industries Co. engages in the design and engineering manufacturing and fabrication of construction materials pre-engineering steel buildings steel structures air conditions and climate control systems. It operates through four segments: Air Conditioners Industry Steel Industry Insulation Industry and Corporate and Others. The Air Conditioners Industry segment produces window split and central air conditioners; electrical and gas ovens; automatic dryers; microwave ovens; air conditioning ducts/channels; household refrigerators; and automatic washing machines as well as engages in the installation maintenance operation and leasing of air conditioning and refrigeration systems. The Steel Industry segment engages in constructing managing and operating industrial projects airports and warehouses; constructing and providing fire protection services for building and structures; building repairing and maintaining the communication towers. This segment is involved in the business of steel sheets works heavy equipment and spare parts and storage tanks; installation of containers and pumps; and implementation of electric works. The Insulation Industry segment engages in the production of insulation products including fiberglass for thermal insulation of central air conditioners pre-insulated pipes glass wool rock wool and engineering plastic foam insulations. The Corporate and Others segment is involved in training and investment activities. It caters commercial industrial and residential applications as well as telecom and broadcasting towers process equipment fiberglass rockwool and engineering plastic foam insulation and solar power projects in Saudi Arabia other Asian countries and Africa. The company was formerly known as Zamil Industrial Investment Company and changed its name to Advanced Building Industries Co. in October 2025. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Arabian Cement Company
Description: Arabian Cement Company engages in the production trading and selling of cement in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. The company trades construction materials clinker derivatives and other related materials. It also produces concrete products. Arabian Cement Company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company
Description: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company produces and sells wheat and feed products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also offers livestock and poultry feed; and bran. The company was formerly known as Second Milling Company and changed its name to Arabian Mills for Food Products Company in November 2023. Arabian Mills for Food Products Company was founded in 1977 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. The company operates as a subsidiary of Abdulaziz Alajlan & Sons Company for Commercial and Real Estate Investment SA.

Name: Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A.
Description: Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. operates as a machinery and equipment rental company in Brazil. It rents sells imports and exports steel and aluminum tubular structures shoring and access equipment for civil construction works and reusable concrete forms. The company also develops related engineering projects and provides supervisory and optional assembly services. Additionally it sells rents and distributes aerial work platforms manipulator handlers parts and components and offers technical assistance and maintenance services. It also offers tractors excavators wheel loaders motor graders forklifts and pallet trucks. The company was formerly known as Mills Estruturas e Serviços de Engenharia S.A. and changed its name to Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. in July 2022. Mills Locação Serviços e Logística S.A. was founded in 1952 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Almawarid Manpower Company
Description: Almawarid Manpower Company provides recruitment services for domestic workers expatriate labor services and operates temporary employment agency for domestic services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company engages in the recruitment of workforce at the various occupational levels for individuals firms and companies of the private sector the governments and mixed institutions. It also offers workforce services for home such as private driver female domestic worker house cook home farmer nanny home expeditor house tea boy physical therapist home nurse home manager and home tailor; and building renovation maintenance general building cleaning administrative and support construction and catering services. In addition the company is involved in the searching of employees for positions including induction or testing and online recruitment agencies as well as provision of other human resources comprising Saudi human resources on a long-term or permanent basis. Almawarid Manpower Company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Akçansa Çimento Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement clinker ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Turkey and internationally. The company operates through Cement and Ready-Mix Concrete segments. It offers products under the Akçansa Agregasa and Betonsa brand names. The company provides port services. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Naturgy BAN S.A.
Description: Naturgy BAN S.A. engages in natural gas distribution business. The company was formerly known as Gas Natural Ban S.A. and changed its name to Naturgy BAN S.A. in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Naturgy BAN S.A. is a subsidiary of Invergas S.A.

Name: E7 Group PJSC
Description: E7 Group PJSC engages in commercial printing packaging and distribution business in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in two segments Printing and Distribution. The Printing segment is involved in the printing publishing packaging and distribution of newspapers magazines books outdoor printing collaterals and educational publishing solutions; and provision of banking cards telecom cards national ID cards and passports as well as foldable boxes disposable food packaging frozen food packaging and paper cups. The Distribution segment provides services including fulfilment distributions logistics mailing room and customer services. It serves its products to banking government telecom hospitality financial institutions education healthcare food and beverage transportation pharmaceuticals media and retailer sectors. The company was formerly known as United Printing & Publishing Sole Proprietorship LLC and changed its name to E7 Group PJSC in November 2023. The company is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Eastern Province Cement Company
Description: Eastern Province Cement Company produces and sells clinker and cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates in two segments Cement and Precast. The Cement segment engages in the manufacture and wholesale of ordinary salt-resistant and clinker cement. The Precast segment provides partitions frames and prefabricated buildings from prefabricated concrete. It is also involved in the operation of quarries mining of gypsum and anhydrite and wholesale of cement and gypsum. Eastern Province Cement Company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates as an engineering procurement and construction contracting company in Kuwait. It operates in three segments: Industrial Oil & Gas; Shipyard; and Offshore. The company is involved in the construction and repair of ships; marine industrial installation and maintenance works related to ships waterways and ports; trading in equipment spare parts and industrial consumables; acting as an agent for trading agencies; industrial inspection works and radiation services; and maintenance repair and public services for transport lines oil and gas tankers refineries factories and annexes as well as projects and stations of electrical power generation and distribution water sources and water and electricity establishments safety. It also supplies installs and maintains safety equipment and security systems; provides installs and maintains establishments equipment machinery and devices as well as supplies specialized technical manpower for works related to the electricity water oil and environment sectors; undertakes contract works for laying and installation of pipes and fine cutting works through using plasma and water etc.; engages in sandblasting paint and fixed mobile scaffolds and welding; provides galvanization works; acquires movables and real estate; and owns intellectual property rights comprising patents trademarks and franchise rights. In addition the company engages in dredging marine and civil construction activities; shipyard oil and gas construction industrial maintenance fabrication service and onshore and offshore operations; electrical and mechanical works; diving and afloat/port repairs; and testing and calibration services. Heavy Engineering Industries and Shipbuilding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt
Description: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt provides retail and corporate banking and investment services in Egypt and internationally. The company operates through Large Medium and Small Enterprises; Investment; Individuals; and Other Activities segments. It offers current and debit current accounts; deposits; financial derivatives; saving pools; and personal and real estate Murabaha. The company also engages in mergers purchase of investments; restructuring of financing companies and instruments; and finance and investment transactions as well as other banking activities such as fund management. In addition it provides mutual funds and saving certificates; Faisal investment Bab Rizk joint and investment accounts for minors; bank cards; e-wallet; and digital and online banking services as well as letters of credit and guarantee. Further the company offers promotion and marketing real-estate marketing specialized exhibitions appraisal and other services such as payment of periodical commitments and regular dues and concluding sale and rent contracts and real-estate mortgage agreements. Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A.
Description: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. engages in the industrialization and commercialization of food and alcoholic beverages in Argentina and internationally. It operates through Foods and Wineries segments. The company offers edible oils pasta dried frozen fractionated flour grass rice wines and sparkling wines. Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Ecogas Inversiones S.A.
Description: Ecogas Inversiones S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of natural gas to residential and commercial customers in Argentina. It serves 1399777 customers through an infrastructure of 35842 km of networks and gas pipelines. The company was formerly known as Inversora de Gas del Centro S.A. Ecogas Inversiones S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
Description: Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi operates in the cement industry in Turkey and internationally. The company offers Portland cement clinkers and potassium silicate cements; Portland sulphate resistant Portland Portland compound and pozzolanic cements; and aggregate and cement bypass dust products. Batiçim Bati Anadolu Çimento Sanayii Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Malam-Team Holdings Ltd
Description: Malam-Team Holdings Ltd provides computer services in the field of information technology in Israel. It provides cloud architecture solutions including cloud computing internet communication and disaster recovery in cloud technology; cyber solutions; software solutions for information security; and planning and implementation of communication systems. The company also provides software development solutions for mobile digital world opensource solutions Microsoft-based technology public transportation mainframe customer legal proceedings and debt collection JAVA and Oracle and guidance and training. In addition it offers outsourcing and managed services; solutions for the management and analysis of organizational information including payroll human resources attendance and pension savings to government offices retail chains the national defense establishment communications and high-tech companies. Further the company provides consultant services for various sectors; consulting architecting designing and implementing of system-based solutions infrastructure software communications and information security; and software solutions for BI and big data improving business managing infrastructure and organizational processes salesforce agile point customer relationship management enterprise resource planning cockpit 5 disaster recovery CAD customs clearance management central management management of information and documents product lifecycle management mobile applications and human capital management. Malam-Team Holdings Ltd was formerly known as Arad Investment & Industrial Development Ltd. and changed its name to Malam-Team Holdings Ltd in January 2025. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Net Holding A.S.
Description: Net Holding A.S. engages in tourism publication holding and other activities in Turkey Croatia Bulgaria Montenegro and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus. It is involved in hotel and accommodation gaming and lottery management touristic shopping and car rental; casino gaming hall management; real estate development; and tourist and book publishing businesses. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A.
Description: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. engages in the retail sale of medicines perfumes personal hygiene and beauty products in Brazil. The company offers medicines and health care products in the areas of pediatrics oncology psychiatry urology orthopedics dermatology contraception pediatric endocrinology assisted reproduction geriatric gastrointestinal and hepatic pain fever and inflammation diabetes and endocrinology. It also provides personal care and beauty products including deodorant intimate care and oral hygiene as well as foot hair face and hand care products; dermo-cosmetics; and repellent diaper cloth and food products as well as other accessories for moms and babies. In addition the company offers clothing and accessories supplements first aid food and drink utilities and others; and cereals fibers vitamins and minerals first aid and herbal medicines and natural products. It sells its products through retail stores and online. Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: Fourth Milling Company
Description: Fourth Milling Company produces of flour feed bran and wheat derivatives in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also engages packing and milling of wheat maize barley flour meal and bulgur wheat as well as rice dried leguminous vegetables and edible nuts; oats production; production of flour from rice; manufacture of flour and dough for bakeries breakfast grain food in flakes popcorn starch from corn and potatoes; and corn milling. In addition it manufactures bread and bread products by automatic bakeries pies cakes biscuits pastry flakes frozen bakery products concentrated fodder cattle fodder; making of eastern and traditional desserts and second plant products as animal feed; preparation milling and pressing of animal feed; and production of salt lick stones for animal feed. Further the company is involved in the manufacturing non-medicinal feed additives poultry fodder bird fodder pet feeds and freight transport by road; operation of storage facilities for goods; loading and unloading of goods animal food and feed stores; and storage in warehouses of grain silos flour and agricultural products. Additionally it engages in the wholesale of barley grain livestock feed for pharmaceutical feed additives feed and non-medicinal feed additives bakery products and food and beverage; retail sale of bakery products and sugar confectionery and barley; and trade of special and healthy food. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Gulf Flour Milling Industrial Company operates as a subsidiary of Gulf Flour Milling Industrial Company.

Name: Lesha Bank LLC
Description: Lesha Bank LLC an Islamic bank together with its subsidiaries provides financial products and solutions to Qatar and internationally. The company operates through Alternative Investments Private Bank and Other segments. It provides private wealth management; fixed income money market; investment banking advisory including mergers and acquisitions debt advisory/debt capital markets equity capital markets and restructuring advisory; and real estate investments services. The company is also involved in direct investment in the venture capital business direct private equity; provision of private banking including advisory deposit accounts brokerage funds and investments treasury forex products plain vanilla and financing and elite services to high net worth clients; and short term liquid investment and FX products to banking clients. In addition it engages in arranging deals in investment and credit facilities; provision and arranging of custody services; manages and advising on investments; and operates a collective investment fund. Further the company is involved in money market fund; financing construction; and owning and leasing real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Qatar First Bank L.L.C (Public) and changed its name to Lesha Bank LLC in October 2022. Lesha Bank LLC was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd
Description: FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd manufactures and sells ballistic protection raw materials and products worldwide. It offers uni-directional (UD) polyethylene and aramid fabrics; personal vehicle panel protection; and vehicle protection such as civilian military composite armor kits and boat armor. The company provides soft armor; hard armor including ceramic body armour plates against armour piercing threats groin protection plates neck protection plates and composite plates under the FAMOSTONE brands; and ballistic shields used by law enforcement personnel such as police or special forces. Its products are used for personal ballistic protection vehicle armoring ship armoring and aircraft armoring applications. FMS Enterprises Migun Ltd was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd
Description: Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. engages in the real estate and renewable green energy business in Israel and Germany. The company operates real estate properties including commercial centers and hotels. It is also involved in the development construction acquisition and holding of photovoltaic power generation systems. The company was formerly known as S.R. Overseas Investments Ltd. and changed its name to Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. in January 2012. Lahav LR Real Estate Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Yakum Israel.

Name: SHL Finance Company
Description: SHL Finance Company operates as a real estate finance company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It engages in financing the purchasing of houses residential lands and apartments; financing of real estate properties; and financing the establishment of commercial and industrial projects. The company was formerly known as Saudi Home Loans Company and changed its name to SHL Finance Company in February 2023. SHL Finance Company was founded in 2007 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of iron and steel products in Turkey and internationally. It offers merchant bars such as equal angle round square T serrated flat and flat bars; UB and UC universal beams W beam IPE beams HEA/HEB beams and IPN profiles; PFC C UPN UAC CH and UPE channels; and mining and tunneling steel profiles. The company also provides rasp bars steel profiles for solar mounting and tracking systems and underground fortification systems; and window sections. In addition it is also involved in domestic and international logistics activities. The company serves the structural steel transportation machinery manufacturing agriculture shipbuilding and defense industries. Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) manufactures and sells cement lime washed sand and other related products in Qatar. The company offers ordinary Portland cement sulphate resistant cement hydrated and calcined lime white cement calcium carbonate and calcium carbonate fines and ground granulated blast furnace slag. Qatar National Cement Company (Q.P.S.C.) was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme
Description: Banque de Tunisie Société anonyme provides various banking products and services to individuals professionals and public counterparties in Tunisia. The company offers demand deposits savings account term accounts and cash vouchers certificates of deposit and delivered pensions. It also provides furniture leasing services such as rolling stock office automation industrial equipment etc.; real estate leasing services including buildings factories stores etc.; and insurance products and servies. The company was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Vicenne S.A
Description: Vicenne S.A distributes technology-intensive equipment solutions and services to healthcare professionals. It provides medical equipment laboratory equipment and implantable devices. The company engages in the distribution of radiotherapy equipment such as accelerators; medical imaging including MRI scanners and catheterization rooms; implantable medical devices including heart valves and cochlear implants; and in vitro diagnostics which include equipment and reagents for laboratories. It is also involved in the collection management and treatment of medical and pharmaceutical waste; and provision of support and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Best Health S.A. and changed its name to Vicenne S.A in 2025. Vicenne S.A was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Rabat Morocco.

Name: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company
Description: Vodacom Tanzania Public Limited Company offers telecommunication services to consumers and enterprises in Tanzania. The company offers mobile; mobile internet and fixed data; SMS and social media applications; value-added services including media and entertainment education and advertisement and health services; and customer care comprising call centre Vodacom shops service desks supplementary service data and customer alerts as well as customer support through social media and live chat on website and WhatsApp. It also provides deposits and withdrawals; person-to-person transfers; M-Pesa super-app; electronic payment solutions including virtual M-Pesa Visa card merchants consumer to business business to consumer and business to business; and financial services such as M-Pesa overdraft savings and loans group savings agent term loans insurance services and wealth management solutions. In addition the company offers mobility solutions such as voice small medium enterprises packages data internet of things reverse charge bulk messaging SIM manager and value-added services; fixed and wholesale solutions including internet inter-branch capacity hosting/co-location cloud session initiation protocol services digital solutions and M-Pesa for business solutions. It serves customers through various sales and distribution channels including wholesale distributors retailers franchise stores direct sales partners street vendors and informal resellers; and direct sales forces independent dealers and agents street vendors and informal resellers. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Combined Group Contracting Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Combined Group Contracting Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries operates as a contracting company in State of Kuwait and other Gulf countries. The company offers construction general contracting and renovations of residential and non-residential buildings nonindustrial railway facilities and airports; and hospitals free zones or markets cooling warehouses buildings precast houses roads pavements bridges tunnels and infrastructure works. It is also involved in laying of communication and power lines oil liquefied petroleum gas steam fire irrigation and electrical and telecommunications wiring and networks; construction and maintenance of main lines and water distribution stations irrigation and sewer systems water wells drilling sewage disposal plants pumping stations and power plants parking lots outdoor swimming pools refineries petrochemical plants port docks marine structures tourist marinas and dams; and demolition removal site preparation pouring foundations dewatering and rocks and rocky ground blasting services. In addition the company builds finishing; installs lighting systems fire alarms and other electrical installation solar energy collectors emergency and exit lighting cooling systems sanitary wares and mechanical installations; ceramic terrazzo marble cut stone granite marble carpets and linoleum floor coverings and rubber or plastic and parquet and decorations; and exterior glass of towers interiors of shops mobile homes boats furniture and exterior cladding. Further it is involved in plastering or stucco and painting works; maintaining of oil pipes; building completion and preparation work bricklaying and stone setting works and scaffolding erecting; contracting for insulating materials and protection materials; and import of aggregate. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. The company is a subsidiary of Insha'a Holding Company.

Name: G City Ltd
Description: G City Ltd through its subsidiaries engages in the ownership development and management of supermarket-anchored urban shopping centers and commercial center and retail-based mixed-use properties in Israel North America Brazil and Northern and Central Europe. The company was formerly known as Gazit-Globe Ltd. and changed its name to G City Ltd in May 2022. G City Ltd was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv.

Name: Reunert Limited
Description: Reunert Limited operates in the fields of electrical engineering information communication technologies (ICT) and applied electronics in South Africa rest of Africa the United States Australia Asia and Europe. Its Electrical Engineering segment designs manufactures installs and maintains power cables; low-voltage distribution protection and control equipment as well as high and medium-voltage switchgears. This segment is also involved in the wheeling business. The company’s ICT segment offers office equipment communication equipment automation products managed print software and solutions production printing devices routers PBX equipment switches and handsets as well as communication equipment and software that includes design implementation and support of converged networking communications and security solutions. This segment also provides wireless fixed and satellite connectivity solutions; cloud-based virtual private branch exchange services; hosted call recording and business internet access products; and consulting digital solutions managed and cloud services as well as telecommunication services. Its Applied Electronics segment offers search and tracking radar systems and subsystems; radar sensor systems; ground and naval search and tracking radar systems; communication systems; cryptographic products and solutions; electronic components and printed circuit boards; remote controlled stabilized weapons platforms; and energy engineering and storage solutions. This segment also provides military and commercial products including technology solutions; and electronic manufacturing services. It serves municipalities parastatals utilities the mining and building industries corporate and retail customers small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) government and state-owned entities and defense forces. Reunert Limited was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A.
Description: Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Peru and internationally. It offers corrugated bars or rebars corrugated stirrups mechanical connectors transfer voussoirs and baskets nails wires electro-welded meshes and panels wire rod merchant bars beams flat products calamines tubes mill ball bars rock support bolts and adapters welding and tools and hardware. The company also provides plates for vehicle suspension spring profiles and dowel basket and load transfer. It serves its products to self-construction construction heavy and light metalworking mining and agroindustrial sectors. Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A. was founded in 1964 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC
Description: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC operates as an electric power generating company in Kenya. The company develops manages and operates geothermal hydro wind and thermal power generation plants with a combined installed capacity of 1726 megawatts. It also offers consultancy and drilling services. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Global Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: Global Yatirim Holding A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the port operation energy generation natural gas mining real estate brokerage and asset management and other businesses in Turkey and internationally. The company offers terminal services including embarkation and disembarkation check-in luggage operations and security; port berthing and mooring; marine pilotage and towage; stevedoring and waste removal; guest information centres and transportation; area and terminal management; and crew services including catering and crew lounges as well as operates cruise and commercial port facilities. It also generates electricity through biomass solar and co/tri-generation power plants; distributes compressed and liquefied natural gas to the logistics and agriculture industries and municipalities; engages in feldspar extraction and production business; and mining operations. In addition the company provides asset and portfolio management brokerage financial advisory corporate finance and research and securities and derivatives trading services to corporate and individual investors. Further it develops and operates real estate projects including house school hospital land shopping centre hotel and resort properties. Additionally the company is involved in tourism and travel agency operations; insurance agency; natural gas and petroleum product transportation; electricity and natural gas trade; publishing; ship management; administrative consultancy; and port real estate tourism financial and technology investment businesses. Description: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal provides personal business and private banking products and services in Venezuela. It offers currency digital key global and paid global accounts; financing services; credit and debit cards; payment and collection services; foreign exchange services; and mobile banking services. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Desarrollo Económico y Social de Venezuela.

Name: Délice Holding SA
Description: Délice Holding SA provides dairy products in Tunisia. The company produces and sells carbonated drinks and juice beverages; dairy products such as milk flavored milk milkshake fermented milk fresh cream butter and yoghurt; and melted triangle squared grated and fresh cheese products as well as packaged drinking water. It offers its products under the Délice Danone and other brands. The company also exports its products. Délice Holding SA was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Nitratos de Chile S.A.
Description: Nitratos de Chile S.A. through its subsidiary Potasios de Chile S.A. invests in shares of Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Santiago Chile. Nitratos de Chile S.A. is a subsidiary of Norte Grande S.A.

Name: Telefónica Chile S.A.
Description: Telefónica Chile S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a telecommunication company in Chile. The company operates through Fixed Telephony Communications and Company Data Television Services and Others segments. It offers basic telephone services line connections and installations services dedicated lines international long-distance services marketing terminal equipment rental of circuit media of terminal equipment rental of means of circuits and others. The company also engages in the provision of business communication services; data transmission services; the sale and rental of communication equipment; telecommunications; and the sale and lease of networks. In addition it provides multimedia services such as the development installation maintenance marketing and operation of satellite television services; broadband; channel paid services; video on demand; and interactive or multimedia television services. Further the company offers logistics personnel and administration services. Additionally it provides broadcast live and play services as well as other related services in the fields of connectivity cloud security big data IoT and digital workplace. The company was formerly known as Compañía de Telecomunicaciones de Chile S.A. and changed its name to Telefónica Chile S.A. in April 2009. Telefónica Chile S.A. was founded in 1880 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile. Telefónica Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Telefonica Moviles Chile S.A.

Name: RP Optical Lab Ltd
Description: RP Optical Lab Ltd. engages in the development production and marketing of optical and electro-optical products in Israel. The company offers short mid and long waved infrared lenses special lenses video engine for cooled thermal imaging systems thermal imaging cameras multi-sensor systems. It serves to defense homeland security medical and commercial markets. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Curro Holdings Limited
Description: Curro Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries acquires develops and manages independent schools primarily in South Africa Namibia and Botswana. The company operates in Curro and Meridian segments. It offers independent education and ancillary services including Select schools Curro Academy Schools Curro Preschools Curro Assisted Learning Curro DigiEd Curro Private College and Curro Online for learners from the age of three months to Grade 12. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Bank of Palestine Plc
Description: Bank of Palestine Plc provides banking and financial services in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through three segments: Retails; Corporate Institutions and Public Sector; and Treasury segments. The company offers current primary and saving account such as Baraem savings account; Labors program services; loan products including commercial mortgage loan programs personal personal housing student fishermen green and mortgage loans; overdrafts and microenterprise financing as well as loans for financing people with disabilities. It also provides card products and online banking services. In addition the company offers current accounts for corporate institutional customers and public sector; and trading and treasury services managing bank’s funds and investments. Bank of Palestine Plc was founded in 1960 and is based in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Banco BMG S.A.
Description: Banco BMG S.A. provides commercial and credit financing and investment products and services primarily in Brazil. It operates in Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking segments. The company offers digital accounts; digital account credit card and consigned credit card; payroll and personal loan; insurance products including lender life family life and FGTS Protected insurance as well as Bmg Med and Bmg Consortium services. It also provides investment products such as bank deposit certificates agribusiness letter of credit and letters of real estate credit. In addition the company offers commercial banking; debentures; trade finance; and working capital; and derivatives such as non-deliverable forward SWAP options. The company was formerly known as BMG Financeira S.A.–Crédito Financiamento e Investimento and changed its name to Banco BMG S.A. in April 1989. Banco BMG S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. engages in the provision of various upstream oilfield services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Oil field and Non-oil field services segments. The company offers upstream oil services that include cementing down hole tool completion directional drilling well logging services hydraulic fracturing coiled tubing and well stimulation services; environmental and sustainability services such as environmental and safety services; quality health safety and environmental services. It also provides drilling and maintenance of oil wells and chemical waste management; petrochemical activities; and support activities for petroleum & natural gas mining incidental to onshore and offshore oil & gas extraction. In addition the company offers support services for well drilling repairing and preparation for production well maintenance-related services; importing and owning machines tools and materials; owning lands and real estate necessary for establishing facilities and equipment; and importing and exporting chemicals. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Al Ahmadi Kuwait. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: Seprod Limited
