It operates through School and Higher Education segments. The company offers K-12 and higher education services. It owns and operates K-12 schools under the Mavericks BCCIS Saxony International School Regent International School Futures Futures Language Schools and Rising Stars brands; and nurseries under the KidzGround STEAMulation and Discovery Campus brands. The company also provides transport services to students. Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Ashdod Refinery Ltd
Description: Ashdod Refinery Ltd engages in the oil refining business in Israel and internationally. The company refines exports and imports crude oil and intermediate materials for petroleum distillates; and produces and sells electricity. It also provides fuel storage and distribution services and light gases LPG gasoline and naphtha diesel fuel kerosene fuel oil and other products. The company was formerly known as Paz Ashdod Refinery Ltd. and changed its name to Ashdod Refinery Ltd in September 2023. Ashdod Refinery Ltd was founded in 1973 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. The company operates through Real Estate Hotels and Investment segments. It is involved in commercial real estate activities such as purchase and sale of lands and properties. The company also involved in the establishment acquisition and management of hotels; and tourism activities. In addition it invests in shares and share capital of the companies. Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Libra Insurance Company Ltd
Description: Libra Insurance Company Ltd engages in the general insurance business in Israel. The company offers c compulsory motor and property motor insurance; and apartments businesses pet travel insurance products; and life insurance products. Libra Insurance Company Ltd was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Holon Israel.

Name: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates in three segments: Corporate Retail and Investment. The company offers current salary cheque savings call vevo RERA escrow and investment accounts; investment deposits; financing products such as personal property Ministry of Housing programs auto working capital capital expenditure enterprise export Bahrain special project and short and long-term financing as well as specialized trade financing instruments. It also provides debit and credit cards; remittances and foreign exchange transactions drafts and managerial cheques cash management and trade finance services; interbank tools and investment and hedging instruments; and payroll wealth management investment banking and custody services. In addition the company offers online and mobile banking automated and interactive teller machine services and bulk cash deposit machines; and money market trading and treasury services as well as handles debt and equity investments; and invests in real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. is a subsidiary of The National Bank of Bahrain B.S.C.

Name: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries engages in the design manufacture sale and marketing of auto parts and housewares in Mexico Europe Asia Spain the Czech Republic Poland Italy and China. It operates through Auto Parts and Home segments. The company offers gray and ductile iron and aluminum components for automotive systems including brakes engines and chassis. It also provides kitchen and tableware items such as vitrified steel and aluminum as well as ceramic tableware for domestic and institutional use. The company sells its products under the Draxton and Cinsa brands. Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1928 and is based in Saltillo Mexico.

Name: G1 Secure Solutions Ltd
Description: G1 Secure Solutions Ltd provides security and safety services in Israel. It offers security cameras alarm systems home alarm systems security cameras and digital recording home security cameras intercom systems emergency systems and services analytics systems cameras for detecting flammable liquid leaks fire detection safety systems suction systems fire detection systems conventional fire detection systems smoke detector cleaning escalators and moving walks elevator cleaning window cleaning steam washing polish industrial and deep carpet cleaning removing oil stains mirroring systems magnetometer meter for metal detection vehicle identification system access control system perimeter intrusion detection systems industrial control systems energy room and building control systems. The company also provides theft prevention systems display protection systems tags and stickers protecting libraries AI video-based crowd counting systems physical security solutions risk analysis national security center mounted security patrol unit security service for communities and neighborhoods physical security hotline services protection systems loss prevention multimedia systems cleaning and communication infrastructure. In addition the company designs supply install and maintain low voltage control systems; monitors and controls high level personal security products and services; and designs installs and services technological systems. The company was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Neto M.E Holdings Ltd
Description: Neto M.E Holdings Ltd. produces processes imports markets and distributes a range of food products in Israel. The company offers basic disposables chilled food frozen food pastries cheeses dry foods fish and meat products. It offers its products under the Rich exaltstion Philadelphia Magic EL Gaucho Angus Debsa Delidge Villiger Tibon Ville The Three Balers and Palace brand name. Neto M.E Holdings Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Kiryat Malakhi Israel.

Name: SHUAA Capital PSC
Description: SHUAA Capital PSC together with its subsidiaries provides various investment and financial services in the United Arab Emirates and the Gulf Cooperation Council markets. It operates in three segments: Asset Management Investment banking and Corporate. The Asset Management segment manages real estate funds and projects; and investment portfolios and funds in regional equities fixed income and credit markets. This segment offers investment solutions to clients. Its Investment Banking segment provides corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions advisory services; transaction services; private placements; public offerings of equity and debt securities; structured investments; and other products as well as creates market liquidity OTC fixed income products. The Corporate segment manages principal investments non-core assets corporate developments treasury and other shared services. It offers investment advisory and management project management financial securities trading consultancy and development management services; and is involved in commercial and real estate investment activities and establishment and management of enterprises. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Accel S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Accel S.A.B. de C.V. provides manufacturing and logistics services in Mexico and the United States. The company’s Manufacturing division manufactures and produces sweets nuts confectionery and various snacks as well as engages in real estate activities. Its Logistics division offers solutions for the handling conservation marketing and distribution of merchandise; merchandise collection delivery and selection; and inventory control packaging and labeling crossing platform and other services. Accel S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A
Description: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A provides financing solutions in Morocco. It offers financing solutions for personal automobile journey and life events. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Société Générale Marocaine de Banques.

Name: Balady Poultry Company
Description: Balady Poultry Company together with its subsidiaries produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts including gizzards hearts breasts thighs whole chicken feet wings mix chicken pieces liver feet and legs as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry rabbit and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed additives; and production of chilled and frozen meat poultry rabbits and birds as well as poultry feed. In addition the company is involved in the production of fertilizers from organic materials and potassium fertilizers; construction and renovation of residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels; pharmaceutical sales agency; and construction of government buildings. The company was formerly known as Balady Poultry Trading Company. Balady Poultry Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Khamis Mushait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A.
Description: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides oncology hematology radiotherapy and genomics healthcare services in Latin America. The company offers treatment services including radiotherapy hormone therapy immunotherapy port-a-cath palliative care target therapy breast cancer hormone therapy bone marrow transplant non-oncological infusions chemotherapy oral chemotherapy and prostate cancer hormone therapy; and surgery procedures such as breast head and neck lung prostate cancer stomach bladder cancer oncological kidney cancer gynecological and testicular cancer. It also provides diagnostics services comprising pathological analysis genetic testing molecular journey personalized medicine and individualized treatment myelogram-bone marrow biopsy and ONCO test-PDO. In addition the company offers treatment support services which include veinviewer cryotherapy integrative medicine and DeLife as well as hilotherapy laser therapy OC care line OC precision medicine OncoACCESS survivorship and telemedicine services. Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Sirketi
Description: Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi operates a holiday village in Bodrum Gümbet Turkey. The company is involved in the construction and sale of Fugayaz Gündoğan houses; and generation and sale of electricity through solar power plants. The company was formerly known as Metemtur Yatirim Enerji Turizm ve Insaat Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi in September 2025. Blume Metal Kimya Anonim Şirketi was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ibnsina Pharma
Description: Ibnsina Pharma operates as a pharmaceutical distributor in Egypt. The company offers pharmaceutical and cosmetics products to private and public-sector customers including retail chains independent pharmacies wholesalers hospitals and healthcare institutions. It also provides warehousing and logistic services for its suppliers; marketing solutions; importation and packaging services; and market research and analysis services as well as value added services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company
Description: The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells various pipes and related products in Saudi Arabia. The company offers ductile iron pipes and fitting products and pipe fittings; glass reinforced plastic glass reinforced vinyl ester and glass reinforced epoxy products pipes tanks manholes spools and fittings for water chemical and wastewater applications; and licenses related technologies. It also provides ductile iron valve products gate butterfly air control check and hydraulic valves; high density polyethylene products solid pipes and corrugated pipes; and rubber products such as rubber rings and seals ariflix tank track pads rubber spiders and o- rings as well as customized rubber solutions for construction HVAC and defense sectors. In addition the company offers design engineering and implementation services comprising full scale system installation; testing and commissioning services for installed systems; site consulting support and supervision services; supply usage and training on specialized equipment; electro-mechanical design and project execution including pipeline and tank design stress analysis and life assessments; and fiberglass piping installations for industries such as power desalination petrochemicals and infrastructure. Further the company provides water management services including related consultancy engineering and operations. It serves water infrastructure oil and gas industries. The Saudi Arabian Amiantit Company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Escar Filo Kiralama Hizmetleri A.S. provides motor vehicle rental services in Turkey. It offers various services including vehicle delivery financing support roadside assistance tire management backup vehicle door-to-door online fleet reporting and related consulting services as well as insurance brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Central Costanera S.A.
Description: Central Costanera S.A. generates transports trades and distributes electrical energy in Argentina. It owns and operates four conventional turbo steam units with an installed capacity of 661 MW; two cycles energy plant with an installed capacity of 851 MW; a gas turbine; and a BTH steam turbine with an installed capacity of 277 MW. The company provides engineering consultancy and management services for operation of electrical power plants. The company was formerly known as Enel Generación Costanera S.A. and changed its name to Central Costanera S.A. in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Enel Argentina S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P.
Description: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. provides ports management warehousing contract logistics equipment leasing and power rental services in Kuwait and rest of GCC. The company offers container handling RORO heavy lift break bulk vessels and aggregate cargo handling; handling of container terminal and general cargo; transportation; reefer plugging facility; and value added services including weighbridge general transportation and project logistics and advanced ERP management system. It also provides bulk transportation and customs clearance support services and turnkey solutions; temperature controlled warehouses client warehouse management system and inventory management; equipment leasing services including cranes heavy lift material handling equipment portable welding machines screw compressors tower lights man lifts excavators and wheel loaders; and power rental services such as diesel generators transformers fuel tanks power accessories as well as value added services comprising engineering design and consulting installation and commissioning project management and maintenance and support services. In addition the company is involved in buys sells rents hires and imports trucks vehicles and equipment and machinery; clearance shipping and stevedoring operations for imported and issued goods and packaging goods; and ground support services for passengers as well as airport management services for aircraft and aviation-related goods. The company was formerly known as Jassim Transport & Stevedoring Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. in November 2024. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Holmes Place International Ltd
Description: Holmes Place International Ltd manages and operates health and fitness clubs under the Holmes Place brands. The company also operates wellness spa and nutritionists related services. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Or Akiva Israel.

Name: Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V.
Description: Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V. together with its subsidiaries engages in designing promoting building and selling housing developments in Mexico. The company builds urban infrastructure and facilities for its housing developments including streets parks water supply systems power plants schools and commercial areas. It is involved in building and leasing shopping centers single centers and mini shopping centers as well as operating real estate projects. Consorcio ARA S. A. B. de C. V. was founded in 1977 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. operates Trabzonspor Professional Football Team. It engages in activities related to its sports teams including broadcasting contracts sponsorship contracts and advertising agreements; and publishes an electronic sports magazine. The company was formerly known as Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. in May 2011. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Trabzon Turkey. Trabzonspor Sportif Yatirim ve Futbol Isletmeciligi Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Trabzonspor Futbol Isletmeciligi Tic. A.S.

Name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E
Description: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers clinker and Portland pozzolana cement products. It also exports its products as bulk or bagged cement. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S.
Description: Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S. manufactures and sells ready-to-wear clothes for men and women under the Vakko brand in Turkey. The company offers dresses blouses knitwear jackets skirts pants shorts t-shirts and sweatshirts trousers and mont and kaban; jewelry hats belts socks bag accessories beanies and gloves; and scarves and shawls for women as well as beach wear swimwear bikinis sandals and slippers and accessories. It also provides suits jackets knitwear shirts t-shirts pants shorts outwear tuxedos underwear beach wears ties pocket square bow ties handkerchiefs belts socks bracelets cufflinks beanie hats gloves and scarves for men; shoes and bags; home décor and textile products; chocolates; and cosmetics. The company offers products through its stores as well as online. Vakko Tekstil ve Hazir Giyim Sanayi Isletmeleri A.S. was founded in 1934 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.S.
Description: Gipta Ofis Kirtasiye ve Promosyon Ürünleri Imalat Sanayi A.Ş. manufactures and sells notebooks school stationery products office products and promotional products in Turkey and internationally. The company also offers gift boxes and bags. In addition it exports its products primarily to Europe the Balkans and the Middle East. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams)
Description: Tourism Enterprise Company (Shams) engages in managing of tourism projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company manages hotels furnished residential units chalets tourist inns resorts wedding halls and events. It also manages camps restaurants coffee shops cafeterias and tourist accommodation facilities. In addition the company operates entertainment centers and facilities amusement parks and other recreational activities as well as rents bicycles. Further it owns and operates the Palm Beach Resort. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. operates as a real estate investment and management company in Brazil. The company is involved in management of own or third-party real estate developments including shopping malls centers; purchase and sale of ready-made or under-construction residential and commercial properties; leasing of real estate; and operation of rotating parking. Its portfolio includes office buildings and convenience centers. São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Banan Real Estate Company
Description: Banan Real Estate Company owns and leases residential and non-residential properties in Saudi Arabia. It operates and manages hotel apartments; manages real estate on commission basis; and provides real estate registration services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A.
Description: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. provides stock over the counter markets services for equity fixed income derivative and foreign exchange services in Colombia. The company offers listing services to issuer and issues; trading services through electronic trading and recording platforms; post trading services which consist of settlement clearing collateral management custody and securities management services; market information and price procurement services; and core banking and securities market system implementation services as well as digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Servicios Integrados Bursátiles S.A. and changed its name to Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. in June 2001. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Bogota Colombia. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi A.S.
Description: Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi A.S. together with its subsidiaries produces and sells cement steel ash and ready-mixed concrete in Turkey. The company offers Portland Portland composite and puzolanic cement as well as bulk and bagged cement lime plaster fly ash aggregate coal clay trass clinker slag chemical additives and raw materials used in cement production. It also engages in the provision of transportation loading pumping and application services; and trade including raw materials fuel oil hazardous and non-hazardous waste various raw materials finished and semi-finished products auxiliary materials construction machinery and equipment and products in bulk and packaged form. In addition the company produces steel for automotive machinery and agricultural machinery-tools industries; and engages in general cargo handling and mining activities. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey.

Name: S.R. Accord Ltd.
Description: S.R. Accord Ltd. provides credit and non-bank financing services in Israel. The company offers cashing check real estate financing bridging loans and line of credit; financing for infrastructure projects renewal and growth and public companies; guarantees for project execution; and currency services; as well as business financial support services. It serves corporations licensed dealers partnerships and businessmen. The company was formerly known as Shrem Fudim Group Ltd. and changed its name to S.R. Accord Ltd. in December 2010. S.R. Accord Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ramla Israel.

Name: Peninsula Group Ltd
Description: Peninsula Group Ltd provides credit solutions in Israel. The company offers long term medium term import supplier equipment and asset-based financing services. It provides bridge loans; line of credit; and diamond exchange services. Peninsula Group Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Reeder Teknoloji Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells e-book readers smart mobile phones smart watches and tablets in Turkey. The company also offers robot vacuum cleaners and smart televisions. In addition it sells its products through online. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Samsun Turkey.

Name: INMAR Company
Description: INMAR Company engages in establishing and owning real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It manages and leases owned or leased residential and non-residential properties. The company also undertakes real estate management activities. INMAR Company was formerly known as Enma Al Rawabi Company and changed its name to INMAR Company in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bonei Hatichon Civil Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd.
Description: Bonei Hatichon Civil Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Israel. It develops markets and manages residential commercial and luxury buildings. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Manazel PJSC
Description: Manazel PJSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in the United Arab Emirates. It invests in develops constructs manages and sells residential commercial retail. The company is involved in purchase and development of properties for resale or lease; properties management and brokerage; facility management services; district cooling; management services; public security guarding services; express delivery services and parcels documents and instruments delivery and letter-post dispatches delivery; and buildings maintenance. It is also engages in entertainment enterprises investment institution and management buildings cleaning services central air-conditioners maintenance electrical fittings and fixtures services and landscape and gardening services; land and real estate purchase and sale real estate lease and management services; commercial complex; building projects contracting; management of medical facilities; architectural engineering consultancy; cinema; cold and hot beverages and snack selling; sports academy; real estate enterprises investment development institution and management; and recreational services and hospitality services. The company was formerly known as Manazel Real Estate PJSC and changed its name to Manazel PJSC in July 2019. Manazel PJSC was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc
Description: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc engages in the transmission distribution and retail of electricity in Kenya. It purchases electricity generated from geothermal hydro thermal solar cogeneration and wind sources. The company was formerly known as East Africa Power & Lighting Limited and changed its name to The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc in October 1983. The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Misr Hotels Company
Description: Misr Hotels Company engages in the tourism and hotel business in Egypt. The company constructs buys and sells hotels resorts casinos and restaurants. It operates the Nile Ritz Carlton Hotel in Cairo; and the Safir Dahab Resort Hotel in Dahab. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production marketing and sale of iron and steel in Turkey and internationally. It is also involved in the energy production and trading; and ship production and operation activities as well as provision of port and harbor services. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Sahin Koc Celik Sanayi A.S.

Name: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd
Description: Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd through its subsidiaries operates in the insurance consumer credit and real estate markets in Israel. The company provides insurance products such as compulsory car property car property general medical expenses and hospitalization personal disability critical illness travel abroad life insurance and savings and other health insurance as well as savings products. It is also involved in the direct financing activity; and provision of loans for purchase of vehicles products and services as well as investment in real estate assets. The company was formerly known as Zur and changed to its name to Zur Shamir Holdings Ltd in February 1997. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Tapdi Oksijen Özel Saglik ve Egitim Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Tapdi Oksijen Özel Saglik ve Egitim Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. provides various health services in Turkey. It operates medical centers and hospitals; disabled and palliative care centers; and beauty centers. The company offers various services such as anesthesia and reanimation; biochemistry; brain and nerve surgery; cardiology cardiology intensive care and cardiovascular surgery; cosmetic plastic and reconstructive surgery; dermatology; ear nose throat endocrinology and eye diseases; emergency services; family medicine specialist; gastroenterology; general intensive care; general surgery; genetic diagnosis center; and gynecology and obstetrics. It also provides services including internal medicine; interventional radiology; medical oncology; microbiology; neonatal intensive care; neurology; nuclear medicine; nutrition and dietetics; oral and dental health; orthopedics and traumatology; pathology; pediatric surgery; pediatrics; perinatology; physical therapy and rehabilitation; psychiatry; psychology; pulmonary diseases; radiation oncology; radiation; and urology. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Mopas Marketcilik Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Mopas Marketcilik Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi sells various consumer products through physical and online stores. It offers fruits and vegetables; red/white meat; milk cheese butter margarine olive bakery products cream sauce yogurt egg milk dessert ice cream and breakfast products; detergent and cleaning products; and legumes pasta salt spice biscuits and snacks gums and candy frozen food oil chocolate and wafer coup and bouillon ready meals canned foods tomato paste and healthy living products. The company also provides fizz daily drink mineral water tea and coffee and still drinks; paper products wax depilatory oral care shaving facial care perfume and deodorant health hair care shower bathroom and body hand care products as well as makeup materials accessories; kitchenware utensils electrical electronics personal interest entertainment and pet products; baby care ready meal food diaper and toys; organic foods; and soups cuisine snacks and rice pasta. It also sells its products through website mopas.com.tr and the mobile application MOPAS. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Jordanian Duty Free Shops
Description: Jordanian Duty Free Shops invests in operates and manages duty-free shops. Its shops provide a range of products which include fragrances cosmetics accessories confectionary liquors cigarettes and tobacco products for diplomats non-residential foreigners tourists businessmen and pilgrims. Jordanian Duty Free Shops was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Siniora Food Industries Company
Description: Siniora Food Industries Company engages in the canning packaging distribution and trading of chilled meat in Jordan. The company is involved in the retail of cold cuts frozen products canned products and plant-based products as well as Horeca cold cuts and frozen products; peppers spices olives pistachios and vegetables; chicken and turkey; and luncheon meat salami and sausages under the Siniora UNIUM Polanez Almasa and BADEEL brand names. It exports its products to Palestine Syria Lebanon Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Kuwait Qatar Oman Yemen and Bahrain. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Sahab Jordan. Siniora Food Industries Company is a subsidiary of Arab Palestinian Investment Company.

Name: Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme
Description: Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme provides financial services to individuals professionals and enterprises in Tunisia and internationally. The company offers checking savings and current accounts; certificates of deposit; and direct credit savings and auto loans housing credit and home savings loans computer loans study savings loans investment credit and real estate credit financing services as well as financing services for professional projects and an operating cycle. It also provides online and mobile banking phone recharge cards commercial papers and treasury as well as bancassurance services. In addition the company offers documentary credits import/export import/export documentary discount credit for the mobilization of credit issues abroad extended change SWAP allowance for business travel professional currency accounts domiciliation of a foreign trade and export prefinancing services. Société Tunisienne de Banque Société anonyme was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A.
Description: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. operates in the fishery sector in Peru and internationally. The company offers frozen giant squid jack mackerel mackerel and anchovy for direct human consumption. It also provides indirect human consumption products such as fishmeal that is used for animal breeding in livestock sheep and porcine industry as well as in aquaculture; and fish oil which is used in the aquaculture industry as well as for human consumption as health supplement capsules. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Lima Peru. Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Caleta de Oro Holding del Perú S.A.C.

Name: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P. provides construction and communication services. The company engages in the trading and installation of telecommunications and related equipment; electrical communication tools and contracting; maintenance of telecommunication tools; trading of telecommunication materials and systems; information transfer infrastructure and contracting; trade installation management operation and maintenance of telephones and communication devices and tools; trading of communication lines and cards; marketing and leasing of electronic communication devices and internal communication networks; establishment and contracting of information centers and infrastructure; trade installation management operation and maintenance of communication devices and networks security and safety and monitoring devices; preparation of various studies and provision of technical consultation in the field of communications information systems and security services; owning establishing leasing and renting telecommunications networks; and investment business. It also offers mobile phone services paging systems and other telecommunications services as well as computer consultancy services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd
Description: Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd engages in leasing real estate properties to various tenants in Israel. The company was formerly known as Shemen Industries Ltd and changed its name to Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd in May 2023. Shemen Yielding Real Estate Ltd was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Haifa Israel.

Name: Kaplamin Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kaplamin Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells packaging materials in Türkiye. The company offers food packaging durable packaging chemical and cleaning package automotive packaging heavy duty packaging ceramic tiles and sanitaryware packaging YSM packaging and paper bag products. It serves food and agriculture fresh fruits vegetables fats and oils meat fish eggs alcoholic drinks beverages chemical products consumer goods textiles and apparel and ceramics industries. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Izmir Türkiye.

Name: Easy Lease Motor Cycle Rental P.S.C.
Description: Easy Lease Motor Cycle Rental P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading rental and repairing of motorcycles in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. It operates through five segments: Motorcycle Business; Delivery Services; Marine Sports Club; Event Management; Logistics and Freight Forwarding; and Mobility and Others. The Motorcycle Business segment offers motorcycle leasing solutions and related items including delivery boxes. The Delivery Services segment provides turnkey logistic solutions through bike messengers and delivery squads. The Marine Sports Club segment engages in managing marine sports club and wholesale trade of ships and boats. The Event Management segment organizes exhibitions fashion shows conferences and seminars and auctions and ripe market events. The Logistics and Freight Forwarding segment provides transportation cargo handling warehousing freight clearing marine and air shipment and specialized oil and gas field services. The Mobility and Others segment offers limousine services bus on demand vehicle rental recovery services electric vehicles charging car parking IT services railway infrastructure and train spare parts and security system trading. The company is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and trades in frozen and canned products in Turkey. The company operates through Frozen and Canned and Edible Oil segments. The company offers bakery products frozen vegetables and fruit potatoes and croquettes meat products and canned; consumer margarine; oils for pastry catering and industrial products; and cooking fats and spread cheese. It offers its products primarily under Superfresh brand and other brands. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Kerevitas Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi in May 2025. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Besler Gida Ve Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Yildiz Holding A.S.

Name: JMMB Group Limited
Description: JMMB Group Limited provides a range of financial services for individual business corporate and institutional clients in Jamaica North America Trinidad and Tobago Barbados the Dominican Republic and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Financial and Related Services Banking and Related Services and Other. The Financial and Related Services segment offers securities brokering stock brokering portfolio planning funds management and investment advisory services. The Banking and Related Services segment is involved in accepting deposits; granting of loans and other credit facilities; foreign currency trading; and provision of remittance and related services. The Other segment provides insurance brokering investment and real estate holding services. The company also offers savings and loans commercial and merchant banking; consumer financing; mutual fund administration; and pension funds administration services. JMMB Group Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S.
Description: A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S. operates as a brokerage company. It engages in fund management activities including portfolio management and join ventures; investment consultancy; transaction brokerage; and public offering brokerage activities. The company also provides trading platforms comprising the A1 Capital mobile application; A1 WEB platform; TradingView a charting and trading platform; Fintables mobile; Matrix data terminal Matrix e-broker and Matrix mobile; FXPlus and Forex mobile application that provides data from money markets; and iDeal data terminal which provides data and news broadcasts of financial markets. A1 Capital Yatirim Menkul Degerler A.S. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E)
Description: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers Portland sulphate resistant and blended pozzolanic cement. It also exports its products to Sudan. Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C.
Description: Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C. operates as an insurance company in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: General Insurance Life Assurance and Investments. The company offers personal insurance products including motor travel medical home yacht and jet ski; and business insurance products such as property engineering group medical group life credit life marine aviation motor fleet liability energy and miscellaneous insurance products. It also invests in equity securities investment properties and statutory deposits. Al Buhaira National Insurance Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail of mother-baby products in Turkey and internationally. It sells its products through its ebebek brand name through retail and e-commerce channels. Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of automotives and related vehicles and spare parts in Turkey and internationally. The company provides passenger cars trucks minibuses buses hydrogen buses and electric and diesel busses. It also offers after-sales marketing and financial leasing services. The company sells its products under the JEST ATAK and STAR brand names. Karsan Otomotiv Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. The company operates as a subsidiary of Kıraça Holding A.Ş.

Name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. manufactures and distributes dairy products in Egypt. The company engages in the packing and pasteurization of liquid dairies cream and natural butter as well as white dry and cooked cheese; and yogurt ice creams biscuits and natural fruit juices. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. designs develops produces and sells communication systems in Türkiye. It offers communication products such as PBX phone systems for small medium and large-scale businesses; IP based call center systems for public and private institutions; and IP analog wall hotel and feature phones as well as direct station select modules and operator phone headsets. The company also provides convergence and integration products including conference products GSM terminals wireless (DECT) systems auto-attendant and voicemail modules call traffic control systems VoIP and network products call recording systems nurse call systems and other products as well as vehicle tracking systems. In addition it offers visual communication and security systems comprising security cameras intruder alarm and intercoms; cloud solutions with Internet applications that facilitate the business processes and provide economy and productivity for corporate users; and electronics manufacturing services as well as undertakes telecommunication projects for fixed and mobile operators and state institutions and organizations. Further the company offers defense industry solutions such as military tactical switches; alarm and announcement system for small boats and navy ships phone and intercom PABX system military gateway and communications switching systems; electronic mirror; military computers; and inertial navigation systems. It provides its communication solutions for hotels public institutions medical institutions educational institutions production facilities retail business finance institutions and transportation institutions. The company also exports its products and technologies to approximately 30 countries. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Istanbul Türkiye.

Name: Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces cement clinker aggregate lime ready-mixed concrete and waste processing products in Turkey. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Bastas Baskent Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Parficim S.A.

Name: Basic Chemical Industries Company
Description: Basic Chemical Industries Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells various chemicals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Chemicals Polymers and Adhesives and Other Materials segments. The company offers industrial chemicals such as hydrochloric acid ferric chloride sulfuric acid caustic soda chlorine sodium hypochlorite etc. for use in various industries; rigid and semi-rigid polyurethane systems for manufacture of various density foams; and hot and cold melt adhesives for use in various industries. It also provides water treatment chemicals including boiler cooling water waste treatment plant domestic water reverse osmosis and desalination plant cleaning and hydrotest chemicals as well as provides contract manufacturing services. In addition the company offers caustic soda flakes sodium sulphate and industrial chemicals and solvents. Further it purchases formulates processes exports imports markets distributes and acts as an agent for the sale of chemicals. The company serves paints and coatings; oil gas and petrochemicals; steel galvanizing; beverage manufacturers dairy operators and farmers; and commercial laundry sectors. Basic Chemical Industries Company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Dammam the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Bossa Ticaret ve Sanayi Isletmeleri T.A.S.
Description: Bossa Ticaret ve Sanayi Isletmeleri T.A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing marketing and sale of textile products in Turkey. It also offers various denim products. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Adana Turkey.

Name: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A.
Description: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides tourism services in Brazil and internationally. It offers intermediation services land transportation hotel reservations air tickets and chartered sea cruises cultural and professional exchange marketing of sea cruises and other services. The company operates under Trend Travel and in the United States of America; Almundo.com Avantrip Biblos CVC and Ola brands in Argentina. It provides its tourism services directly to customers through independent service providers. CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Kardan Israel Ltd
Description: Kardan Israel Ltd. through its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Israel and the United States. It locates initiates and develops residential buildings in Israel for sale; demolishes and rebuilds properties for urban renewal; develops sells and rents office buildings and commercial areas; and invests in real estate properties. The company also provides contractor services for the construction of residential buildings commercial buildings public buildings etc. In addition it is involved in the development sale and rental of logistics real estate complexes such as server farm commerce office and cold storage buildings. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: United Capital Plc
Description: United Capital Plc together with its subsidiaries provides investment banking portfolio management securities trading and trusteeship services in Nigeria. It operates through Investment Banking Asset Management Wealth Management Trustees Securities Trading Consumer Finance and UCEE MFB segments. The company offers issuing house corporate investment advisory project finance debt restructuring mergers and acquisitions asset management wealth management and debt capital market services. It also provides trust services such as debenture trust; bond trusteeship to corporate and sub-sovereign issuers of public debt instruments; trustees to collective investment schemes; and private and security trusts. In addition the company offers pay day loans and consumer lending; stockbroking; and securities trading services including receiving agents to new issues stockbrokers to primary issues and advisers to SMEs as well as equity portfolio management and securities dealing services. It serves governments; micro small and medium scale enterprises; institutions; high net worth individuals; and other individuals. The company was formerly known as UBA Capital PLC and changed its name to United Capital Plc in December 2014. United Capital Plc was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Mutakamela Insurance Company
Description: Mutakamela Insurance Company provides insurance products and solution in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Motor Health care Property and Casualty and Protection and Saving segments. The company offers accident fire or theft and third-party liability motor insurance; medical cover to policyholders; group retirement products; and protection and saving products to individuals and corporate institutions. It also provides engineering insurance for builders’ risks construction mechanical electrical electronic machinery breakdown and other; property accidental physical loss or damage fire and allied perils and related losses; and marine credit fidelity guarantee and liability insurance products as well as burglary and money insurance solutions. The company was formerly known as Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Mutakamela Insurance Company in November 2024. Mutakamela Insurance Company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Mutakamela Insurance Company is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company PJSC.

Name: International Company for Agricultural Crops
Description: International Company for Agricultural Crops engages in the agricultural activities in Egypt. The company is also involved in trading and import of agricultural pesticides and fertilizers; and mixing and filling of liquid fertilizers; production of agricultural crops seeds; and trading ginning and export of cotton. It also engages in trading and import of fertilizers and agricultural fertilizers; trading of agricultural crops and seeds; and seed screening. In addition the company offers rice wheat maize legumes beans etc. as well as NPK mixture fertilizers. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mansoura Egypt.

Name: Americanas S.A.
Description: Americanas S.A. operates in the e-commerce business in Brazil. It offers e-commerce digital platform for various digital solutions. The company operates Americanas.com an online store with various products; Ame a platform for financial and non-financial products and services; and Puket an online clothing platform; MinD an online design and home decoration platform. In addition it provides imaginarium a multi-brand e-commerce channels; Lovebrands an online platform that offers various products and services; Skoob a virtual library platform as well as operates a retail chain of fruits and vegetables under Hortifruti Natural da Terra brand. Americanas S.A. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a guardrail supplier company in Turkey. The company provides steel guardrail systems noise barrier systems solar energy systems and motorcyclist protection systems as well as hot dip galvanizing services. It also offers other products such as traffic sign and boards overhead sign carrier and intersection direction information signs omega profiles traffic sign trailers pedestrian railings crash cushion systems and pedestrian overpass construction systems. Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2006 and is based in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Raoom trading Company
Description: Raoom trading Company engages in the manufacture trade and installation of glass mirrors and aluminum decorations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers polycarbonate clear flat glass stained glass reflective glass glass path crystal and fused glass products as well as accessories doors and fronts. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Buraydah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Al Jouf Cement Company
Description: Al Jouf Cement Company engages in production and sale of cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides sulfate-resistant cement ordinary Portland cement Super 20 cement and finishing cement. The company also engages in the provision of marketing services; land transport of goods; and import export wholesale and retail trade of cement products. Its products are used in various application such as various types of concrete structures and foundations civil and construction projects reinforced concrete works pipes and cement brick factories as well as finishing works. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells feeds for the livestock sector in Turkey. It offers ovine calf fattening milk and poultry feeds under the Ofis Yem brand. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Banco del Caribe C.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco del Caribe C.A. Banco Universal provides various banking products and financial services. Its deposit products include savings and checking accounts saving accounts for kids foreign currency accounts workers' compensation and demand yield deposits. The company also offers loans for wholesale and retail trade restaurants and hotels communal and social services manufacturing industry agriculture fishing and forestry transport storage communications exploitation of mines and hydrocarbons and construction industry; mortgage loans; auto line finance; and commercial microcredit and CrediMujer. In addition it provides biometric services digital banking mobile payment services foreign exchange operations payment system for services and recharges and credit cards; and cash services including payment to suppliers collection service payment at the box office concentrator accounts collection of values roster and electronic data interchange. Further the company engages in trust operations. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of impregnated and laminate paper table tops school desks chair backrests and building profiles in Turkey and internationally. The company was formerly known as Gentas Genel Metal Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Gentas Dekoratif Yuzeyler Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in April 2020. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Umm Al-Qura Cement Company
Description: Umm Al-Qura Cement Company manufactures and sells clinker and cement products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company provides ordinary Portland Portland Pozzolana sulphate resistant and white cement products. Its cement products are used in various applications including construction and civil projects concrete structures foundations reinforced concrete works pipes concrete slabs cement bricks factories flooring and flooring works hydraulic concrete structures concrete works marine structures construction and plastering works sewage facilities dams waterways and foundations of sulfate-prone buildings as well as for pegs or foundations of underground concrete structures and precast concrete. The company provides general contracting for buildings; installation work; construction of mechanical and electrical works; management and operation of Portland cement and white cement factories; and wholesale and retail of construction materials including cement plaster bricks gypsum cement tiles etc. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company
Description: Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade of medical supplies for the aesthetic market in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers Teoxane a range of injectable hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers designed to treat wrinkles; Deka medical laser systems and therapies; Magellan an autologous concentration system that delivers concentrated platelets and cells at the point of care; and Euromi medical dermatological and aesthetic surgery equipment. It also provides perfumes cosmetics orthotic devices decorative soaps incense veterinary medicines and medical equipment. Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company was founded in 2005 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development
Description: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development engages in development of real estate properties in Egypt. The company develops large scale urban communities. It also provides civil construction and brokerage services. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development operates as a subsidiary of BIG Investment Group Limited.

Name: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Kuwait and rest of GCC countries. The company operates through Project Management Investments Property Management and Others segments. It owns trades in leases and rents real estate properties; buys develops owns and sells land; and develops establishes and manages commercial residential tourist infrastructure and industrial projects. The company also engages in contracting business related to real estate; trading of construction materials and building supplies; and the provision of building maintenance services. In addition it invests in owns operates manages rents and leases hotels health clubs tourist facilities restaurants and cafeterias residential complexes shops and sports projects. Further the company is involved in the exploitation of investing surplus funds in portfolios. Additionally it invests in and establishes engineering laboratories associated with real estate investment; and provides real estate consultancy services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C.
Description: Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. engages in the investment advisory and wealth management businesses in the United Arab Emirates. It operates in two segments Investments and Banking Services. The company manages investment portfolio; provides treasury services; credit facilities; and accepts deposits from corporate and individual customers. It also provides wealth and estate planning asset management lending and banking services as well as trading and execution services. The company was formerly known as Arab Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. and changed its name to Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. in 2010. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Emirates Investment Bank P.J.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Al-Futtaim Private Company LLC.

Name: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi
Description: Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi produces imports exports and trades in cables conductors machinery apparatuses tools and equipment and spare parts and accessories worldwide. It offers energy cables communication cables with copper conductors and fiber optic cables; cable for utilities and power grids; telecom; transportation and mobility; and asset monitoring systems and electronics. The company provides medium and low voltage fire performance and building wire cables for trade and installers; cables for industries including renewables water treatment oil and gas oems nuclear mining military and defence marine and crane. It offers its products under the Prysmian General Cable and Draka brands. The company exports its products to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as Turk Pirelli Kablo ve Sistemleri A.S. and changed its name to Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi in September 2005. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Mudanya Turkey. Türk Prysmian Kablo ve Sistemleri Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Draka Holding B.V.

Name: Hod Assaf Industries Ltd.
Description: Hod Assaf Industries Ltd. engages in the production processing and sale of steel products in Israel and Romania. The company offers welded mesh profile fences gates and screens light mesh fences and other fencing products. Its products are used in construction infrastructure security and agricultural sectors and industries. Hod Assaf Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Acre Israel.

Name: Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V. produces distributes and sells nixtamalized cornmeal under the MINSAA brand name in Mexico. The company sells packaged corn and corn flour to mills small producers and industrialists. Its products are used to produce tortillas and other food products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Tlalnepantla de Baz Mexico. Grupo Minsa S.A.B. de C.V. is a subsidiary of Promotora Empresarial de Occidente SA de CV.

Name: Izmir Firça Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Izmir Firça Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells various cleaning materials and painting brushes in Turkey and internationally. It offers brush such as white wash paint and oil based paint brushes; steel including spatula trowel and putty knifes and stuff scratch brush; min size big and special rollers; tapes drop sheets and nylon canvas and auxiliary products; and cleaning products comprises window and floor squeegee brush broom mop handle and bucket as well as hobby directing hardware and thinner products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi engages in the production testing marketing and sale of transformers capacitors separators and electromechanical equipment in Turkey. It offers oil type and epoxy resin current and voltage transformers disconnectors with earth knife and without earth blade insulators components grading and coupling capacitors and 1 and 3 phase earth knifes. The company also exports its products. Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Emek Elektrik Endustrisi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Emek Elektrik USA Inc.

Name: Response Plus Holding PJSC
Description: Response Plus Holding PJSC together with its subsidiaries provides healthcare services in the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Norway the United Kingdom and internationally. It operates in two segments Medical Services and Occupational Health and Training & Consulting. The company provides onsite healthcare services medical emergency services and occupational health solutions. It also engages in the wholesale trading of pharmaceutical supplies; operation of medical warehouses and medical services complex; provision of home health and ambulance services; supply of medically qualified professionals; and healthcare investment business. In addition the company manages hospitals clinics and medical centres; provides onshore and offshore oil and gas fields and facilities services; offers medical staff training services; and technical and occupational skills training. The company was formerly known as Burjeel Medical Centre (Yas Mall) LLC and changed its name to Response Plus Holding PJSC in August 2021. Response Plus Holding PJSC was founded in 2010 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Adel Kalemcilik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Adel Kalemcilik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. produces manufactures and sells stationery products in Turkey. It offers wood-walled pencils crayons and copy pens ballpoint liquid ink pens markers felt-tip pens pastels watercolors erasers sharpeners finger paints play dough and gouache paints; and toys. The company offers its products under the Faber-Castell Graf von Faber-Castell Adel and Panfix and Citizen brands. It exports its products to approximately 40 countries. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Ümraniye Turkey. Adel Kalemcilik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. operates as a subsidiary of AG Anadolu Grubu Holding A.S.

Name: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A.
Description: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of pharmaceutical products in Brazil. It provides pharmaceutical personal hygiene and beauty products. The company operates retail stores under the Drogasmil Farmalife Drogarias Tamoio and Drogaria Rosário brands. Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Koza Polyester Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Koza Polyester Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells polyester fibers polyester chips and plasticizers in Türkiye and internationally. It offers textile and nonwoven type fibers; semi-dull chips; and phthalate-free plasticizers. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Gaziantep Türkiye.

Name: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. provides insurance products in Bahrain. It operates through Non-motor Motor Medical Group Life and Family Takaful segments. The company develops and provides protection coverages for property engineering general accident liability marine cargo marine hull aviation medical group life motor level term assurance and decreasing term assurance. It also manages general takaful and family takaful funds. In addition the company offers travel expat medical visa smart device domestic helper and personal cyber insurance products; life planning services; and savings and protection plans. It offers its services through its online platform. The company was formerly known as Al Ahlia Insurance Company B.S.C. and changed its name to Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. in January 2018. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Manama Bahrain. Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Solidarity Group Holding B.S.C (c).

Name: Purple Group Limited
Description: Purple Group Limited a financial services and technology company engages in trading platforms fractional property and crypto asset investing retirement fund administration and asset management businesses in South Africa. The company operates through EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM); and Easy Group segments. The EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM) segment is involved in the derivatives trading and asset management operations. The Easy Group segment includes EasyEquities EasyProperties EasyCrypto and RISE EasyRetire. It also offers EasyBonds EasyTrader EasyPartnerships EasyCredit and EasyProtect solutions. The company was formerly known as Purple Capital Limited and changed its name to Purple Group Limited in December 2013. Purple Group Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Hareket Proje Tasimaciligi Ve Yuk Muhendisligi Anonim Sirketi provides heavy lifting and transportation services with engineering solutions in Turkey Europe Asia the Middle East and Africa. It offers load out services equipment rental and renewable energy solutions as well as rigging engineering and transport survey consultancy. The company also provides project planning route surveys lift engineering project management and installation services. It serves petrochemical renewable energy and power industries as well as offshore projects. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in professional football activities in Turkey. The company invests in professional football teams; and establishes and operates football facilities. Besiktas Futbol Yatirimlari Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1995 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Grupo Clarín S.A.
Description: Grupo Clarín S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates in the media industry in Argentina an Internationally. It operates through Digital and Printed Publications; and Production and Distribution of Content segments. The Digital and Printed Publications segment includes newspapers with national and regional circulation sports newspapers the edition and publication and distribution of magazines as well as commercial printing; publishes newspapers a sports daily; magazine publishing and editing and distribution. This segment also offers Diario Clarín a national newspaper for the Spanish-speaking world; Olé a sports newspaper for the Argentine market; and Genios a children’s magazine. The Production and Distribution of Content segment offers Canal 13 channels amplitude modulation/frequency modulation radio broadcast stations and Radio Mitre and La 100 as well as produces content for television films and radio and cable television signals; and organizes and broadcasts sporting events. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Grupo Clarín S.A. is a subsidiary of GC Dominio S.A.

Name: Saudi Marketing Company
Description: Saudi Marketing Company engages in the retail trading and importing business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Retail Household and Entertainment Service. The company is involved in wholesale and retail of foodstuffs household consumables toys textiles and stationery products. It also provides marketing services; fast food items and cold and hot beverages; operates and manages bakeries restaurants and coffee shops; and establishes operates and maintains amusement centers. The company operates under the Farm Superstores name. Saudi Marketing Company was founded in 1978 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries develops promotes acquires and invests in education real estate financial and industrial projects in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Academic and Investments segments. The company owns Kuwait Technical College as well as engages in a range of activities including curriculum development course delivery and academic research comprising creating organizing and delivering educational programs to students. It also develops residential commercial and mixed-use properties. In addition the company owns and holds shares of institutions; invests in income generating assets and service sector as well as Islamic bonds and bank notes; and owns stocks of local and foreign companies. The company was formerly known as Gulf North Africa Holding Company – KPSC. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC
Description: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC manufactures distributes and sells spirits alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and other ancillary products. It offers its products under the Guinness Malta Guinness Johnnie Walker Star and Smirnoff Ice brands. Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kumasi Ghana.

Name: Havanna Holding S.A.
Description: Havanna Holding S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the operation and franchise of coffee shops in Brazil Peru Paraguay Chile Spain and Bolivia. The company offers caramel cookies havannets cookies mini line chocolates caramel sauce haired lattes and frappes. It also operates bars and cafés. The company is involved in the distribution activities in the United States Colombia Costa Rica El Nicaragua Europe Israel and Australia. Havanna Holding S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Grupo Multi S.A.
Description: Grupo Multi S.A. develops manufactures distributes and sells electronic products in Brazil. The company offers blenders fryers pans ovens mixer coffee makers kettles sandwich makers food warmer scales omelette maker hood food processors parts and accessories for mixers. It also offers vacuum cleaners circulators heaters fans iron vaporizer drinking fountain popcorn maker wineries and ice machines; and electric toothbrush refill oral irrigator compressor inhaler mesh inhaler air humidifier aroma diffuser oximeter medication spacer essential oils scented candles electric toothbrush irrigator nozzles and accessories. Further it offers digital thermometer infrared thermometer baby thermometer arm blood pressure monitor wrist blood pressure monitor blood glucose monitor lancet blood glucose strips electric racket and electric insect killer; digital scales bioimpedance scales gel and thermal bags knee brace elastic knee pad and elbow pad wristband elastic thigh and ankle strap. Additionally It provides smartphones cell phones tablets computers and notebooks security UPS batteries and accessories; access control automation lighting and security monitoring related products; steering wheel monitor cabinet webcam controls headset keyboard mouse mouse pad microphone VR glasses cables memories and SSD and sound box; and printing supplies sticky-notes-pad staplers punchers organizers digitizing tablets electronic waste bins glues and books and office supplies. It offers household utensils hardware tools sports automotive beauty and skin care products as well as provides toys for pets and infants and health care products. The company provides audio video screen and projectors. Grupo Multi S.A. was formerly known as Multilaser Industrial S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Multi S.A. in April 2024. Grupo Multi S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Bank of Africa Mali SA
Description: Bank of Africa Mali SA provides various banking products and services to individuals business customers and SMEs in Mali. It offers checking current foreign currency and savings accounts and term deposits; house consumer personal and various other loans; cards; financing of activities; investment products; insurance products; and money transfer and digital banking services. The company also provides foreign currency endorsements letter of credit transfers and documentary discounts and credits. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Bamako Mali. Bank of Africa Mali SA is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides wealth management forward trading access to IPOs and advisory services to its clients. It provides its services to individual institutional clients ultra-high net worth individuals high net worth clients family offices sovereigns endowments foundations and corporate. The firm manages customized portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. The firm prefers to invest in companies having enterprise value of at least $100 million invests at least $5 million in companies. It invests in the public equity fixed income and alternative investments markets across the globe with a focus on the MENA region. The firm employs quantitative analysis to make its investments. It makes its investments in the securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was formerly known as Kipco Asset Management Company K.S.C.C. till December 07 2014. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was founded in September 28 1998 and is based in Sharq Kuwait. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Gulf Bank B.S.C. (E.C.).

Name: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology Company
Description: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology Company provides IT solutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers infrastructure solutions including data center infrastructure deployment migrations services and disaster recovery and business continuity solutions; cyber security solutions such as identity and access management privileged access management mobile device management encryption and single sign on and multi-factor authentication solutions; managed services; and system integration services including automation implementation. It serves telecom and service providers banks healthcare manufacturing government military and retail business sectors. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Altinkilic Gida ve Sut Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
