Description: Altinkilic Gida Ve Sut Sanayi Ticaret A.S. produces and sells dairy products in Turkey. It offers milk product cheese and yogurt. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S.
Description: Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. produces and sells forging parts and components for light medium and heavy vehicle manufacturers in Turkey. The company offers body parts such as rear axle shafts shafts front axle beams and front axle assemblies; and engine parts including crankshafts camshafts forged pistons steering knuckles rods pinion forgings various gear forgings spider gears slip shafts and other products and assemblies as well as arms and various parts for different sectors. It also provides axons arms gear blanks cardan shafts and other automotive products as well as undercarriage parts for work machines. It serves automotive agricultural and construction equipment aerospace railway and other industries. The company also exports its products to Germany Belgium Italy France Spain the United Kingdom Hungary Czech Republic Austria the Netherlands Egypt and South Africa. Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. was founded in 1968 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Parsan Makina Parçalari Sanayii A.S. is a subsidiary of Celik Holding A.S.

Name: Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi
Description: Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the hotel management business in Turkey. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Net Holding A.S. Merit Turizm Yatirim ve Isletme Anonim Sirketi opearates as a subsidiary of Net Holding A.S.

Name: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E) develops communities in Egypt. Its flagship project is Sahl Hasheesh a resort located in Red Sea coast. The company acquires land holdings; sells pre-designated land plots to sub-developers for various purposes such as residential communities hotels and entertainment venues office parks schools hospitals and others; and offers infrastructure development and community and property management services. It also provides electricity water and irrigation communication network services and roads and lighting; and develops and operates its own projects including Old Town Jamaran Tawaya and Sawari marina. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Allied Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Allied Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes technology products in Brazil and Latin America. It engages in the wholesale and retail trade of telephone computer electronic devices accessories and peripherals. The company also provides logistics services; delivery and storage services; program development and licensing; image processing and services related to enabling data voice and recharge plans; and payment services deposit transfer and/or withdrawal of funds management of payment accounts issuance of payment instruments and others. It sells its products through digital retail including marketplaces e-commerce platforms and digital operations solutions; physical retail such as brand shops; and distribution channels. The company was formerly known as Dstar Participações S.A. and changed its name to Allied Tecnologia S.A. in November 2015. Allied Tecnologia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: L'azurde Company for Jewelry
Description: L'azurde Company for Jewelry together with its subsidiaries engages in manufacturing forming and forging golden wares jewelry precious stones and golden alloys. It operates in Wholesale and Retail segments. The company also distributes glasses watches men and women accessories pens perfumes and leather products; and exports gold wares alloys and silver. In addition it engages in manufacturing and trading of gold jewellery as well as trading of gold and silver products pearls and precious stones. It primarily operates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Egypt the United Arab Emirates Kuwait the Sultanate of Oman and Qatar. The company sells its products under the L’azurde Instyle Miss L’ and Waves brands. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Disway S.A.
Description: Disway S.A. distributes IT and telecom equipment products in Morocco Tunisia the Middle East and Africa. The company offers desktop PC and laptops; printer scanner point of sale terminal tracer copier fax and consumables; tablet smartphone connected object and headphones and earphones; PC screen TV game console video projector projection screen videoconferencing interactive screen and photo and video; and accessories including cable drive hard drive flash memory luggage storage keyboard and mouse memory stick gaming audio webcam power bank and strip inverter and others and miscellaneous. It also provides solutions for server network data center storage backup software and video surveillance; and solar panels on and off grid solution solar pumping protections and solar accessories. In addition the company offers logistics services; manages stocks; processes orders; and engages in packing and co-packing drop shipping assembly inventory and reporting services. Disway S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme
Description: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme engages in the design manufacture and sale of aluminum alloy profiles for building and industrial needs in Tunisia. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: Puerto Ventanas S.A.
Description: Puerto Ventanas S.A. operates a port in Chile. The company offers warehousing services; and services to the ships including docking and undocking tug and berthing and unberthing. It also provides land transportation services by road or rail; and loading and unloading services. Puerto Ventanas S.A. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Alkim Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret AS
Description: Alkim Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret AS engages in the manufacture and sale of woodfree offset coated and office papers in Turkey. The company’s woodfree offset papers include offset white writing and printing papers and copy quality offset white writing and printing papers; coated papers comprise glossy matt and one side coated papers as well as label papers; and special papers include envelope blueprint drawing map optical reader kraft shopping bag ivory chamois white kraft and wall papers as well as office papers under the Platinum Copy Gold Copy Best Copy and All Copy brand names. It also exports its products to 32 countries. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Izmir Turkey. Alkim Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret AS is a subsidiary of Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.

Name: Mondi Tire Kutsan Kagit ve Ambalaj Sanayi A.S.
Description: Mondi Tire Kutsan Kagit ve Ambalaj Sanayi A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of corrugated containerboards. It offers tray and hood perforated boxes; bottle carrier boxes; corrugated packaging solutions for fresh fruits and vegetables; corrugated wrap around boxes; deppo boxes; octabin boxes; tanker boxes; kit modules; solar panel boxes; and automotive logistic packaging solutions. The company also provides e-commerce packaging solutions such as envelop mailers delight boxes e-grocery boxes sizeme boxes and floral boxes. It offers a range of packaging solution for industrial applications as well as food beverage and retail sectors. The company operates in approximately 30 countries including Turkey Europe Asia North America and Africa. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Mondi Tire Kutsan Kagit ve Ambalaj Sanayi A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Mondi Corrugated B.V.

Name: Baazeem Trading Company
Description: Baazeem Trading Company operates as a FMCG distribution company. It engages in the wholesale of coffee and tea products food items and drinks cosmetics and beauty soaps other soaps and detergents raw plastic materials rubber industrial fibers and tools and other plastic materials. The company also manufactures sanitary papers napkins cleaning wipes towels tissue papers towel rolls and ready-made food packaging products. It offers its products under the MAOG Tanay u-do Shiraa SMAC Fid Fad RIO mare Merito LOOK WC NET Fornet OMINO BIANCO and Camel brands. The company sells its products through business to business discount store and wholesale and retail channels in the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Nascon Allied Industries Plc
Description: Nascon Allied Industries Plc manufactures and sells refined edible and grade salt in Nigeria. The company operates through Salt and Seasoning segments. It offers table pure dried and vacuum tannery butter and edible and non-edible industrial salt; and spices comprising stew mix and curry powder as well as seasoning cubes tomato paste and vegetable oil. The company sells its products directly to distributors who redistribute to wholesalers confectioners supermarkets and retailers under the Dangote and Dan Q brand names. Nascon Allied Industries Plc was formerly known as NASCON Industries Plc and changed its name to Nascon Allied Industries Plc in July 2015. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ikeja Nigeria. Nascon Allied Industries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

Name: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and distributes batteries. Its starter batteries comprising car EFB start-stop taxi agricultural marine defense industry heavy duty and AGM start-stop batteries; industrial batteries which includes AGM motive power gel FFP front terminal motorcycle traction OPZS stationary and OPZV stationary batteries; and lithium batteries. The company markets its products under Platin Helden Akü Tunç Akü Turkuaz Akü Macpower Gentry Vesline Distalong Fierte Probat and Yiğit Akü brand names. Yigit Aku Malzemeleri A.S. was founded in 1976 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Ekos Teknoloji ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ekos Teknoloji Ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi operates as a technology and service provider company for electrical infrastructure in Turkey and internationally. The company offers metal enclosed gas insulated metal clad and metal enclosed air insulated modular switchgears as well as other switching products; prefabricated substations; automation and control panels; NTP/PTP time servers; and GE distribution products. It also undertakes turnkey projects; and primary and secondary site tests. The company serves power producers network operators and industrial and commercial consumers. Ekos Teknoloji Ve Elektrik Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kocaeli Turkey.

Name: Tarkim Bitki Koruma Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Tarkim Bitki Koruma Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces sells and markets plant protection products. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Manisa Turkey.

Name: Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries produces and sells electricity by natural gas combined cycles in Turkey and internationally. The company operates a natural gas combined cycle power plant with an installed capacity of 140 MW; a solar energy power plant with an installed capacity of 0.25 MW; a hydroelectric power plant with an installed capacity of 8.2 MW; and a thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 340 MW. It also produces imports and wholesales natural gas liquefied natural gas (LNG) and compressed natural gas (CNG) to exporters LNG and CNG clients wholesale companies and eligible consumers. In addition the company extracts purchases manufactures imports exports sells and installs various natural stone and mineral ores that primarily include gold silver antimony and coal. Odas Elektrik Üretim Sanayi Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E)
Description: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) provides diversified financial services in Egypt and internationally. It offers leasing solutions including finance and operating leases and sale and leaseback for a range of corporate clients and SMEs; microfinance lending; and investment banking platform to provide market leading capital raising mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory asset management securities brokerage custody fixed income brokerage and research services. The company also provides ECM advisory services such as advisory on capital structuring and capital market activity through public offerings private placements rights issues and pre-IPO transactions; debt raising debt structuring and restructuring services; asset management products comprising fixed income money market equity balanced indexed and Sharia-compliant funds as well as range of mutual funds and saving plans; institutional and individual clients bookkeeping services; and mortgage finance. It offers its services to a client base that include global and regional institutions and family offices large corporates SMEs and high net worth and individual investors. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Sheikh Zayed City Egypt. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) operates as a subsidiary of Banque Misr S.A.E.

Name: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E.
Description: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. together with its subsidiaries provides offshore marine and oil support services in Egypt. The company manages and operates AHTS PSV multi purpose vessel diving support vessel mooring boats and offshore support vessels as well as utility vessels; and under water activities and diving scope of services. It also provides marine work services including oil spill recovery; firefighting capabilities; dynamic positioning; 4-point mooring; and supply installation and maintenance of marine navigation aids such as buoys and navigation light services. In addition the company offers track record EPCI contracts installation engineering laying of sub sea pipelines sub sea coiled tubing submarine power cables mooring systems protective coating and construction work services; and survey services comprising rig positioning ROV inspection pre-engineering survey and construction support services. Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is based in Port Said Egypt.

Name: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi manages and processes fruits and vegetables in Turkey. The company offers concentrate puree concentrate puree deionized concentrate frozen IQF natural peel oils natural fruit FTNF direct pressed fruit juices dried seeds consumer products and fresh fruits products. It offers its products under Fruit Drops Get One and Absolutely brand names. The company exports its products. Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. produces and trades gray and spheroidal cast iron and aluminum castings for the automotive industry in Turkey. The company operates through Pig & Ductile Iron Casting; Aluminum Casting; and Wheels segments. It offers pig and ductile iron; high and low pressure aluminum cast parts; and aluminum wheels. The company also exports its products. It serves heavy commercial vehicles agricultural machinery construction and mining machinery manufacturing e-mobility and railway and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Componenta Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. and changed its name to Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. in April 2018. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bursa Turkey. Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Çelik Holding A.S.

Name: Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the purchase compression transportation and delivery of natural gas in Turkey. It supplies compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) products. The company offers CNG through 13 industrial CNG filling plants consisting of approximately 60000 CNG cylinders a fleet of 35 towing vehicles and 71 industrial CNG compressors and LNG through 6 LNG road tankers 31 LNG storage tanks and 94 evaporators. It also supplies CNG through dispensers to heavy duty vehicles such as logistics trucks garbage trucks and city buses from its auto CNG stations. The company serves industrial establishments factories asphalt plants hotels greenhouses social facilities the chemical industry construction material producers the metal industry the food industry mining operations and other industrial facilities. In addition it operates a solar power plant with an installed capacity of 2.4 MWp located in the Karatay District of Konya Province Turkey. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Naturelgaz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Global Yatirim Holding A.S.

Name: Spur Corporation Ltd
Description: Spur Corporation Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates as a restaurant franchisor in South Africa and internationally. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Spur Steak Ranches Panarottis Pizza Pasta John Dory’s Fish Grill Sushi The Hussar Grill RocoMamas Casa Bella Nikos Doppio Zero Modern Tailor and Piza e Vino brands fast casual brand RocoMamas and three bespoke speciality dining brands The Hussar Grill Casa Bella Nikos Coalgrill Greek Doppio Zero Modern Tailors; Virtual Kitchen brands includes Just Wingz (Spur Steak Ranches) Pizza Pug Bento Reel Sushi Rib Shack RocoFellas and CharGrill Chicken. It is also involved in sauce manufacturing warehousing product distribution training export décor manufacturing and call center businesses. In addition it operates retail company stores as well as provides marketing services. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Willy-Food Investments Ltd
Description: Willy-Food Investments Ltd imports exports markets and distributes food products in Israel and internationally. It offers rice canned fruits canned vegetables canned fish roasted vegetables noodles mushrooms coconut milk rice vermicelli egg noodles chilly and soy sauce pasta lemon juice balsamic vinegar pomegranate sauce cereals and snacks tortillas toasts crackers corn flour and grain products. The company also provides oil cookies and sweets coffee creamer tea and condensed sweet milk characol milk alternative drinks yogurts whipped cream mascarpone twarog cheese margarine and butter Italian products gluten free and frozen soy beans and fruits. It offers its products under Willi Food Valio Wyke Kolios Euro Happy Nuts DAAWAT El Pastor Sera Zanetti and Completa’s coffee whiteners brands. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Yavne Israel.

Name: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and supplies French fries in Turkey. The company offers potato wedges spicy coated potato wedges crinkle potato spicy coated crinkle potato coated cage fries and spicy coated cage fries. It supplies its products to quick service restaurants. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Marmaris Altinyunus Turistik Tesisler A.S.
Description: Marmaris Altinyunus Turistik Tesisler A.S. engages in the operation of tourist hotels in Antalya and Marmaris Turkey. It also provides tourism services; and leases the tourist facilities. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Antalya Turkey.

Name: Rav-Bariach (08) Industries Ltd.
Description: Rav-Bariach (08) Industries Ltd. primarily engages in the development manufacture and marketing of security doors and solutions in Israel and internationally. The company offers entrance interior wooden entrance fire and fire rated high security and steel doors as well as handles and accessories for commercial and residential properties. It also provides dock shelters and levelers roller shutters overhead sectional doors and sliding gates; and reinforced security room doors and windows as well as security room systems under the Lavi+System name. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: Acsion Limited
Description: Acsion Limited engages in property holding and development activities in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through South African Property Operations South African Hospitality Operations and International Property Operations segments. Its investment portfolio includes retail properties including regional shopping centers light industrial property and a mixed-used property as well as an international retail property. In addition the company develops community shopping centers convenience shopping centers as well as industrial residential and hospitality properties; operates hotels; and provides property and asset management services. Further it engages in conferencing business and sale of food and beverage. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Centurion South Africa. Acsion Limited is a subsidiary of Fortutrax Proprietary Limited.

Name: BAAN Holding Group Company
Description: BAAN Holding Group Company for Tourism and Development Company provides hospitality and entertainment services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. It operates through Hotel Entertainment and Other segments. The company operates hotels tourism health resort cafes and restaurants as well as furnished apartments entertainment and recreation centers tourist resorts commercial malls fun cities parks and gardens and related facilities. It also operates and manages electrical games hall children amusement games hall and electronic games as well as establishes and operates sports facilities projects. The company was formerly known as Abdulmohsen Al-Hokair Group and changed its name to BAAN Holding Group Company in November 2024. BAAN Holding Group Company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Britam Holdings Plc
Description: Britam Holdings Plc an investment holding company provides financial solutions in Kenya Uganda Tanzania Rwanda South Sudan Mozambique and Malawi. The company operates in five segments: Life Insurance Business; Non-Life Insurance Business; Asset Management; Property; and Corporate and Other segments. The Life Insurance Business segment provides unit linked products education plans whole life plans and other conventional products; and group life and critical illness products disability products individual pension plans umbrella pension plans and corporate pension plans. Its Non-Life Insurance Business segment offers protection to customers’ assets particularly for personal and commercial business; and aviation engineering fire-domestic risks fire-industrial and commercial risks liability marine motor personal accident theft workmen’s compensation and employer’s liability and miscellaneous insurance. The Asset Management segment offers discretionary/segregated portfolio management and wealth management services as well as unit trust funds. Its Property segment is involved in the purchase and sale of properties as well as buying developing selling and leasing land to third parties. The Corporate and Other segment offers debt-financed investment portfolios. It serves individual and corporate customers through financial advisors partners and digital channels. Britam Holdings Plc was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: The National Bank
Description: The National Bank provides various banking and financial services to retail corporate institutional and public sector customers in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through Retail Accounts; Corporate and Institution Accounts; Public Sector Accounts; and Treasury segments. The company offers current demand savings and time deposits; consumer loans; overdrafts; credit cards and other services. It also provides trading and treasury services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Constructora Conconcreto S.A.
Description: Constructora Conconcreto S.A. operates as a construction company in Colombia and internationally. It offers construction services including consulting services such as pre-construction project management technical management conceptualization and auditing services for project conceptualization; construction design services which include architectural interior structural network geotechnical geometric and bioclimatic designs as well as integration of designs under BIM methodology; services for infrastructure housing buildings prefabricated components triboard panels and aggregates; and asset management services including specialized and public service management maintenance and multiservices and renovation and building adaptation services. The company also develops and sells housing and commercial units; and concessions and real investment projects. In addition it develops builds designs and manages infrastructure building and housing projects such as airport facilities logistic facilities commercial facilities institutions hotelier health facilities industrial corporate and transport. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Dexxos Participações S.A.
Description: Dexxos Participações S.A. engages in the production and sale of thermosetting resins to the reconstituted wood panels industry in Brazil. The company operates through the Chemicals and Steel Tubes segments. It is also involved in the production of formaldehyde and hexamine; resale of methanol and other chemical products; and manufacture of steel tubes for the civil construction infrastructure automobile petroleum and gas markets. The company was formerly known as GPC Participações S.A. and changed its name to Dexxos Participações S.A. in June 2021. Dexxos Participações S.A. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Yibitas Yozgat Isçi Birligi Insaat Malzemeleri Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Yibitas Yozgat Isçi Birligi Insaat Malzemeleri Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. engages in the production and sale of cement. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Yerköy Turkey. Yibitas Yozgat Isçi Birligi Insaat Malzemeleri Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Votorantim Çimento Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Methanol Chemicals Company
Description: Methanol Chemicals Company engages in the production and sale of formaldehyde liquid and urea formaldehyde liquid in the Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers aqueous formaldehyde solution urea formaldehyde concentrate hexamethylene tetramine paraformaldehyde urea formaldehyde powder resin melamine formaldehyde powder resin melamine urea formaldehyde resin sulphonated naphthalene formaldehyde hexane methylene tetramine phenol formaldehyde resins and liquid and powder formaldehyde resins. The company also provides dimethylamine trimethylamine methanol monomethylamine dimethyl formamide pentaerythritol sodium formate carbon monoxide di-methylamine concrete improvers acetaldehyde and penta aritheretol; and formaldehyde liquid and urea formaldehyde liquid and their mixtures trimon-methylamine and di-methyl Formamide. The company was formerly known as Saudi Formaldehyde Chemical Company Limited. Methanol Chemicals Company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Jubail the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the insurance reinsurance and takaful insurance businesses for individuals and corporates in Qatar. It operates through Takaful Investment and Real Estate segments. The company offers comprehensive and third-party insurance products; and property insurance products such as fire and special perils property all risks business interruption terrorism and jewelers block insurance. It also provides engineering insurance products including contractor’s all risk erection all risk equipment machinery breakdown deterioration of stock in cold storage and electronic equipment insurance; and workmen's compensation personal accident fidelity guarantee and money insurance products. In addition the company offers individual/family health household travel and yacht/jetski marine insurance; and public and third-party liability insurance products. Further it provides marine cargo freight forwarders liability marine hull and aviation insurance; inpatient and daycare outpatient credit life and group life and personal accident insurance as well as individual medical insurance plans; and motor fleet and group health and medical insurance products. Additionally the company is involved in the investment and real estate businesses. Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Renaissance Services SAOG
Description: Renaissance Services SAOG together with its subsidiaries operates as an accommodation services solutions and integrated facilities management company in the Sultanate of Oman and rest of the Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services including accommodation solutions facilities management and establishment contract catering operations and maintenance training cleaning and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership building and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; and investment in companies and properties as well as general trading and related activities. The company serves healthcare energy defense education utilities and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. buys builds operates and sells residential and commercial real estate projects. The company develops and manages residential compounds; invests in real estate projects; develops land for resale; engages in the construction project management and real estate marketing activities; and provides property management maintenance and brokerage services. Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A.
Description: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A. engages in the provision of parking services in Brazil. It operates through Leased and Managed Locations Owned Locations Public concessions (Otf-Stíeet) Public concessions (On-Street) Long-term Private Contracts Digital and Other segments. The company operates parking lots in commercial buildings shopping malls hospitals educational institutions banks and land; and outside public roads including airports and underground garages. It is also involved in the investments in parking meters infrastructure signage and initial concessions in the municipalities; and provision of AppZul+ services as well as technical administration advisory and planning services related to vehicle parking. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Ayen Enerji A.S.
Description: Ayen Enerji A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production distribution and trading of electricity in Turkey and internationally. It generates electricity through hydroelectric and wind sources. Ayen Enerji A.S. was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ankara Turkey. Ayen Enerji A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Aydiner Insaat AS.

Name: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) provides drilling and workover services for oil companies in Kuwait and internationally. The company provides integrated maintenance services; transportation support through a fleet of heavy-duty trucks low beds Kenworth forklifts and cranes; workshop; supply chain; and catering services. The company was formerly known as Hamad Al-Hamad and Partners for well drilling trading and maintenance Company and changed its name to Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) in February 2005. The Company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Fahaheel Kuwait.

Name: Koç Metalürji Anonim Sirketi
Description: Koç Metalürji Anonim Sirketi operates in the iron and steel industry in Turkey. It produces construction iron. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd
Description: Shoval Engineering and Construction Ltd a construction company engages in the planning and execution of logistics centers public buildings commercial centers industrial buildings and offices in Israel. The company is based in Nesher Israel.

Name: Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the production of electricity from renewable energy sources in Turkey. The company installs operates and trades in solar power plants as well as manages ground-mounted and hybrid solar projects. It operates 88 unlicensed and 1 licensed solar power plant and 1 geothermal plant. In addition the company is involved in rooftop solar installations for industrial customers. Further it provides EPC maintenance and repair project development and investment services. Naturel Yenilenebilir Enerji Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in managing real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates in Hotel Operations Real Estate and Investment segments. The company invest develop and trades real estate properties as well as manages real estate investment commercial projects investment funds and portfolios. Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Norstar Holdings Inc
Description: Norstar Holdings Inc together with its subsidiaries develops rents and manages real estate properties in Northern Europe Central and Eastern Europe Israel Brazil and the United States. It develops commerce residential and office properties. The company was formerly known as Gazit Inc. and changed its name to Norstar Holdings Inc in May 2011. Norstar Holdings Inc was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Panama City Panama.

Name: Lasco Manufacturing Limited
Description: Lasco Manufacturing Limited manufactures and sells soy-based products primarily Jamaica. The company offers juice drinks water and packaged milk products. It offers its products under LASCO brand name. The company was formerly known as LASCO Foods (Successors) Limited and changed its name to Lasco Manufacturing Limited in May 2010. Lasco Manufacturing Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Hagag Europe Development Z.F. Ltd
Description: Hagag Europe Development Z.F. Ltd engages in the investment and development of real estate properties in Romania. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Al Khaleej Investment P.J.S.C.
Description: Al Khaleej Investment P.J.S.C. operates as a real estate and investment company in the United Arab Emirates. The company engages in the private fund investment commercial enterprises investment institution and management buildings maintenance and detection services for real estate. It is also involved in the real estate enterprises investment development institution and management. The company was formerly known as Livestock Co. (Gulf) PJSC and changed its name to Al Khaleej Investment PSC in November 2014. Al Khaleej Investment PSC was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ras al-Khaimah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Arabian United Float Glass Company
Description: Arabian United Float Glass Company manufactures and sells glass products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers float and pattern glass products and mirrors. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Yanbu the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. operates in the retailing and wholesale business in Turkey. It operates an online store for food; red and white meat fish and aquaculture; milk and breakfast products; cleaning products which include general cleaning washing washing dishes and cleaning supplies; personal care; baby products including diapers detergents foods and toys; fruits and vegetables; non-food and bakery products as well as beverages comprising tea coffee and drinks. The company is also involved in retailing of fast-moving consumer products. Gimat Magazacilik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Jalles Machado S/A
Description: Jalles Machado S/A produces markets and exports sugar ethanol and other by-products from sugarcane. The company offers crystal and organic sugar; hydrated anhydrous industrial and organic ethanol; sanitizing products; and yeast. It also produces clean and renewable energy from cane bagasse and straw. In addition the company engages in industrial automation 4G project agro-industrial control tower and research and development activiries. Jalles Machado S/A was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Goianésia Brazil.

Name: Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C.
Description: Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. engages in the development establishment and management of real estate enterprises in the United Arab Emirates and the Gulf Cooperation Council countries. It is also involved in funds stocks and bonds investments as well as investment establishment and institution in commercial enterprises entertainment agriculture tourism industrial infrastructure educational services health and energy sectors; and owns and invests in classes and units in the buildings of the investment areas. The company was formerly known as Umm Al Qaiwain Cement Industries Company and changed its name to Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. in March 2016. Umm Al Qaiwain General Investments Company P.S.C. was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Umm Al Qaiwain the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Arab Tunisian Bank
Description: Arab Tunisian Bank provides various banking products and services for individuals and companies primarily in Tunisia. The company offers savings accounts; term deposits; bank cards; money transfer services; financing services; and internet and mobile banking services. It also provides abroad transfer foreign exchange transaction placement and portfolio management services. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Arab Tunisian Bank is a subsidiary of Arab Bank PLC.

Name: Agricultural Development Bank Plc
Description: Agricultural Development Bank Plc provides corporate investment and retail banking products and services in Ghana. It offers corporate banking services comprising business bank accounts; business overdraft business invoice factoring import and export documentary credit import and export bills trade and supply chain protection foreign exchange risk management foreign exchange foreign currency account guarantees and export invoice finance services; payments and cash management services; funding solutions; and asset finance services. In addition the company provides retail banking services including current savings deposit salary student save and Mmofra accounts; and electronic banking services. Further it offers risk management services such as market/financial and operational risks and compliance units; treasury management services including foreign exchange fixed deposit call account rediscounting of bill primary dealer and secondary market activities repurchase contract and custody services; agribusiness products and services; executive banking; and commercial/SME short and medium term loans inventory financing facilities working capital lending contractor financing import and export financing and bridge and LPO financing. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Link Bilgisayar Sistemleri Yazilimi ve Donanimi Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a software development company in Turkey. The company offers e-document e-ledger; bank integration software; marketplace integration software; enterprise resource planning software; new generation software for tracking and managing accounting stock current account invoice bill check personnel fixed assets and other processes; techno human resources use for managing and monitoring of human resources and personnel payroll management needs; food production software; and campus software. It also provides organized industry invoicing e-reconciliation e-purchase invoice transfer payment recording device e-export passenger together invoice mandatory bes transactions management güneş warehouse management contractual invoicing e-prescription solution link-POS and link new generation payroll. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C.
Description: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C. invests in utilities and infrastructure sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in two segments Investment and Other. The company engages in investment; electric power generation; manufacturing; and real estate businesses as well as the provision of IT general trading and contracting educational and medical services. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. provides general insurance takaful and related products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain and internationally. It operates through Marine and General Motor Medical and Life segments. The company offers fire general accident engineering group life marine cargo marine hull and aviation special contingency motor third party motor comprehensive and extended warranty medical education protection and savings insurance products. It also provides travel home and life insurance products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.

Name: Combined Motor Holdings Limited
Description: Combined Motor Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the motor retail and distribution business in South Africa. It offers new and used vehicles including parts and accessories; and fleet solutions. The company also provides car rental services. In addition it offers insurance products that includes death disability dread disease and retrenchment of customers and vehicle and component warranties as well as vehicle financing. Further the company is involved in supply and installation of workshop lifting lubrication and diagnostic equipment waterless car wash systems and office consumables services. Combined Motor Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: National Gypsum Company
Description: National Gypsum Company produces and trades in gypsum and its derivatives in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It primarily offers plasterboard products. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Sea Harvest Group Limited
Description: Sea Harvest Group Limited engages in the fishing and fast-moving consumer goods business in South Africa Europe Australia Asia and internationally. It operates through four segments: South African Fishing Sea Harvest Australia Sea Harvest Aquaculture and Cape Harvest Foods. The company is involved catching processing and marketing cape hake horse mackerel pelagic fish anchovy pilchard Spanish mackerel fish trawl prawns scallops crabs and abalone. It also engages in the production distribution marketing and sale of cheese butter powder and convenience food products in retail and bulk forms to the South African retail foodservice co-packing and food product development markets; and manufacture and distribution of chilled and frozen food products. The company was formerly known as Sea Harvest Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Sea Harvest Group Limited in February 2017. Sea Harvest Group Limited was founded in 1964 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Abra Information Technologies Ltd.
Description: Abra Information Technologies Ltd. provides information technology solutions in Israel. The company provides managed research and development services; customer relationship management system solutions such as system specification cross-organizational implantation process automation instruction and training and ongoing support solutions; UX and UI designing studio; enterprise resource planning system solutions including project management training and instruction data migration and support and service center as well as consultancy application and implementation solutions; business intelligence solution; strategy realization such as project management and agile transformation solutions as well as implementing PPM Jira and Atlassian tools; cloud solutions; e-commerce and marketing automation comprising development of e-commerce websites and systems technological specifications and UI/UX and IoT direct sales solutions; cyber consulting solutions including information and cyber security management technological consultancy and test and supply chain security solutions; and operates training center as well as provides courses. It serves health security fintech hi-tech government and commerce and retail industries. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Raanana Israel.

Name: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C
Description: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C engages in the real estate business in Kuwait and internationally. It engages in the purchase sale investment management leasing and renting of real estate properties; and purchase and sale of shares bonds and securities of real estate companies. The company also provides consulting services for real estate; organizes exhibitions for real estate projects; and develops infrastructure projects in the areas of residential commercial and industrial construction as well as projects under the build operation and transfer system. The company was formerly known as Sanam Real Estate Company K.S.C.(Public) and changed its name to SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C in May 2025. SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A.
Description: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. operates as a rural real estate company in Brazil. The company engages in leasing of farms for agricultural production located in various municipalities in Mato Grosso. Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Supergas Power (2019) Ltd
Description: Supergas Power (2019) Ltd markets sells and distributes liquefied petroleum gas natural gas electricity and thermal energy in Israel. Its products are used to operate burners and boilers ovens in bakeries and restaurants for heating institutions and chicken coops in agriculture; and operation of small power stations. The company was formerly known as Electra Power (2019) Ltd and changed its name to Supergas Power (2019) Ltd in October 2025. Supergas Power (2019) Ltd founded in 1953 and is based in Netanya Israel. Supergas Power (2019) Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Elco Ltd.

Name: Beta Glass Plc
Description: Beta Glass Plc manufactures distributes and sells glass bottles and containers in Nigeria and internationally. The company also offers crowns and crates. Its products are used by soft drinks breweries wine and spirits pharmaceutical food and cosmetics companies. The company also exports its products to Ghana Burkina Faso Benin Republic Cameroon Gabon Republic of Congo Angola Mauritius South Africa Côte d’Ivoire Sierra Leone Guinea and Liberia. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Beta Glass Plc is a subsidiary of Frigoglass Industries Nigeria Limited.

Name: Wafrah for Industry and Development Company
Description: Wafrah for Industry and Development Company produces markets manufactures and sells of food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Pastery Sector Vegetable Sector Breakfast Cereals Sector and Meat Product Sector segments. It provides breakfast cereal products including spices salted peanuts corn flakes and peanut products; meat products such as frozen and chilled meat minced chicken chicken franks burgers and cooked meat; pasta products including macaroni; and French fries. The company is also involved in the manufacturing drying packing and sale of dates; and wholesale of food and beverages as well feed production activities. It markets its products under the Wafrah Macolate Caprini Saudi Garden and Aghsan brands. The company was formerly known as Food Products Company and changed its name to Wafrah for Industry and Development Company in 2014. Wafrah for Industry and Development Company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited
Description: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited provides banking and other financial services to residents in Namibia. It offers banking services including account management; overdraft facilities and services; and micro-lending services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Letshego Holdings Limited.

Name: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. develops operates and manages hotels in Mexico Costa Rica Colombia and Chile. The company operates hotels under the City Junior by Marriott City Express Suites by Marriott City Express by Marriott City Express Plus by Marriott and City Centro by Marriott brands. It also provides marketing technical and administrative; real estate development; restaurant operation and catering; and IT server maintenance update and equipment rental services as well as software platforms and applications; and dashboards for hotel managers and operating teams. In addition the company develops Front2Go a property management system; hires personnel or third parties for the development of civil works; and invests in hospitality industry projects. It serves business travelers. The company was formerly known as Hoteles City Express S.A.B. de C.V. and changed its name to Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. in April 2024. Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A.
Description: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. engages in the sale of cars and spare parts in Tunisia. It also manufactures electronic equipment comprising filters for the automotive and real estate development industries. The company was formerly known as Renault Tunisie. Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Ihlas Haber Ajansi A.S.
Description: Ihlas Haber Ajansi A.S. operates as a news agency in Turkey and internationally. It produces visual written and photographic news through live broadcasting services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC
Description: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC operates the duty-free business in the new Bahrain international airport in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Muharraq the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Enda Enerji Holding A.S.
Description: Enda Enerji Holding A.S. owns operates develops invests produces sells and trades in renewable energy projects. It owns and operates a total of 10 power plants comprising 4 hydro 5 wind and 1 geothermal power plants with installed capacity of 180.1 MWe as well as biomass and solar power plants. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Izmir Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company
Description: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company manufactures and trades in various medicines in the Palestinian Authority. The company offers its products in various therapeutic fields comprising alimentary system cardio-vascular system muscolo-skeletal system endocrines central nervous system genito-urinary system obstetrics and gynecology infections dermatological preparations ophthalmic drugs respiratory system and nutrition and metabolism as well as ear nose and oropharynx. It also provides OTC products such as multivitamins and minerals and supplements; and skin/topical care allergy and cold eye care mouth and nose care pain and fever and digestion and gastrointestinal products. In addition the company offers its products in various dosage forms including ampoules capsules tablets and caplets syrups suspensions and granules ophthalmic semi-solids powder vials suppositories and powders. Further it manufactures and trades in cosmetics products; and provides printing and publishing services. The company serves the Ministry of Health as well as health care organizations and programs; and end users through pharmacies and physicians. It also exports its products primarily to Algeria and East Europe. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Darb Saudi Investment Company
Description: Darb Saudi Investment Company together with its subsidiaries manages and leases residential and non-residential real estates in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in the management and leasing of warehouses; brokerage of real estate; management of properties; and real estate investment and development. In addition the company engages in the construction of buildings; financial service activities; wholesale and retail trade; support functions; residence food and beverage service activities; creative activities arts and entertainment; and usage activities. The company was formerly known as Al-Baha Investment and Development Company and changed its name to Darb Saudi Investment Company in June 2025. Darb Saudi Investment Company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Biomm S.A.
Description: Biomm S.A. operates as a biotechnology company in Brazil. The company offers insulin products for the treatment of diabetes including AFREZZA a Human insulin powder for inhalation; GLARGILIN a glargine insulin; WOSULIN N and WOSULIN R; and Lifepen G a reusable insulin injection pen. It also provides Bevyx for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer; HERZUMA for the treatment of early-stage and metastatic breast cancer and metastatic gastric cancer with HER2-positive tumors; GHEMAXAN an anticoagulant for the prophylaxis and treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism unstable angina and in cases of acute myocardial infarction; and RANIVISIO for the treatment of vision problems related to abnormal blood vessel growth or fluid buildup in the retina. Biomm S.A. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Nova Lima Brazil.

Name: Ingevec S.A.
Description: Ingevec S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the engineering and construction business in Chile. The company operates through Engineering and Construction; Real Estate; and Investment and Income segments. It is involved in the study promotion administration and execution of real estate projects and developments which includes homes buildings civil and other related works as well as offers architecture and engineering services; and provision of professional and consultancy services. The company also invests in hotel and office projects located in Chile and Peru. Ingevec S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells leather and leather products in Turkey. It offers leather jackets clothing shoes bags and accessories backpacks suitcases and other leather accessories for men and women. The company markets and sells its products through wholesale and retail sales channels as well as through online store. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Desa Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Çelet Holding A.S.

Name: Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S.
Description: Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S. engages in the manufacturing dyeing and sale of various yarns and fibers in Turkey. It produces viscose tencel modal micromodal microtencel acrylic wool silk linen elastane bamboo and polyester fibers. The company is also involved in real estate leasing activities. Sönmez Pamuklu Sanayii A.S. was founded in 1981 and is based in Bursa Turkey.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: Wataniya Insurance Company
Description: Wataniya Insurance Company provides a range of insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Marine Property Motor Comprehensive Motor Third Party Liability Engineering Accident & Liability and Life Insurance segments. The company offers insurance against losses and liability related to marine vessels and marine cargo; fire and other insurance; insurance against damages to vehicles due to storm tempest flood fire theft and personal accident; insurance against liability to third parties arising through accidents; and insurance for builder's risks construction mechanical electrical electronic and machinery breakdown as well as life insurance. It also provides money insurance fidelity guarantee business all risk business travel and exhibition insurance; and general third-party liability product liability worker’s compensation/employer’s liability and damages to motor vehicles after the manufacturer warranty expires as well as professional indemnity cover protecting the insured’s legal liability arising out of acts of negligence during their business operations. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Melon S.A.
Description: Melon S.A. through its subsidiaries produces markets and supplies cement ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Chile. It operates through two segments Cement and Aggregates. The company’s products are used in high-rise buildings civil and industrial works mining and port works and household. It serves construction material distributors; construction companies; and the real estate infrastructure civil works and mining sectors. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Chile SA and changed its name to Melon S.A. in October 2009. Melon S.A. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Melon S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones Cordillera del Sur II Spa.

Name: Alexandria New Medical Center
Description: Alexandria New Medical Center engages in the operation of a hospital in Egypt. The company’s hospital provides range of medical specialization services including gynecology general surgery pediatrics and other as well as medical diagnostic and treatment services in various medical fields. It also operates children’s neurology sugar liver chest cardiology internal oncology dental nose and ear women’s ophthalmology nutrition dermatology blood disease and rheumatology clinics; specialized units and centers; and dormitories. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Vitro S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Vitro S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries produces processes distributes and markets inorganic chemical products worldwide. The company provides sodium carbonate and bicarbonate calcium chloride and sodium chloride. It serves automotive glass detergent water treatment pharmaceutical food oil road deicing and livestock sectors. Vitro S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1909 and is based in San Pedro Garza García Mexico.

Name: Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company
Description: Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the commercial advertising public relations marketing publishing and distribution businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers road advertising services; and stationeries and books. It is also involved in production trading and retail activities; media and research businesses; and invests in properties. Tihama for Advertising Public Relations and Marketing Company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: HF Group Plc
Description: HF Group Plc through its subsidiaries engages in the mortgage lending banking property development and bancassurance businesses in Kenya. The company operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Property Development Bancassurance and Others segments. It accepts deposits from retail customers; and provides micro and personal loans as well as sources residential mortgages for individual owner occupiers. The company also accepts deposits from corporate organizations; and provides loans to property developers for construction of residential houses office blocks schools hospitals and other related infrastructure. In addition it engages in the development and sale of housing projects; and provision of insurance agency services. It serves individual and corporate customers. The company was formerly known as HF Group Limited and changed its name to HF Group Plc in July 2017. HF Group Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: City Lodge Hotels Limited
Description: City Lodge Hotels Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the operation of hotels for business and leisure travelers in South Africa Botswana Mozambique and Namibia. It owns operates and manages hotels under the Courtyard City Lodge Town Lodge and Road Lodge brands. City Lodge Hotels Limited was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells semi-finished cleaning papers in Turkey. It offers jumbo rolls napkins toilet papers and kitchen towels under the Softy Mare Ritmo Ecco Y.D Dolce and Unico brands as well as private label brands. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Libstar Holdings Limited
Description: Libstar Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and markets branded and private label consumer packaged goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through three segments: Perishable Products Ambient Products and Household and Personal Care Products. The company offers refrigerated or frozen products including dairy convenience meals value-added meats and fresh mushrooms; wet and dry condiments meal ingredients baking and snacking and spreads; and household cleaning products as well as personal care products. It also provides baby food products; and beverages. The company sells its products under the Lancewood Millennium Foods Finlar Fine Foods Denny Mushrooms Umatie Rialto Cape Herb & Spice Khoisan Gourmet Cape Foods Montagu Foods Cecil Vinegar Dickon Hall Foods Cape Coastal Honey Chamonix Amaro Foods Cani Ambassador Foods Contactim and retailer brands to retail and wholesale food service industrial contract manufacturing and export channels. Libstar Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Plattekloof South Africa.

Name: Albaad Massuot Yitzhak Ltd
Description: Albaad Massuot Yitzhak Ltd manufactures and sells wet wipes and feminine hygiene products worldwide. The company offers baby and toddler wipes; facial and cosmetic wipes including refreshing cosmetic exfoliating and make-up remover wipes; household cleaning wipes such as disinfecting and floor wipes; flushable moist toilet paper; and feminine hygiene products comprising G2 plastic and cardboard applicator compact and G4 3-piece plastic applicator and G3 sport plastic applicator as well as digital/compact digital products. It also provides professional wipes consisting of cow udder cleaning wipes pet wipes car wipes restaurant wipes sachets and screen wipes as well as plastic free wipes under the Hydrofine name. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Ashkelon Israel.

Name: United Mining Industries Company
Description: United Mining Industries Company manufactures and sells a range of gypsum products for residential and commercial development in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Gypsum Board & Powder Cement Board and Others segments. It offers gypsum and performance boards; fiber cement boards; gypsum and fiber cement board ceiling tiles; metal profiles and accessories for walls and ceilings; T-grid ceiling systems; and gypsum powder. United Mining Industries Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Egypt Gas Company SAE
Description: Egypt Gas Company SAE operates EPC-based natural gas distribution projects in Egypt. The company offers natural gas services including land survey P and A survey and design of natural gas projects; constructs high pressure transmission pipelines in different materials such as carbon steel and HDPE; and constructs pressure reduction stations and pressure reduction units as well as distribution networks. It also provides internal and external installations of gas meters for residential and commercial units; fabricates and installs the flues required for the system; operates and maintains projects; designs fabricates and installs accessories for natural gas project installations; and performs technical control and inspections on steel pipelines. In addition the company offers services for the design engineering procurement and construction of oil and gas projects; undertakes civil works; and mechanical works comprising supply and installation of pipeline projects storage tanks construction and maintenance installation works fire proofing works electromechanical works abrasive blasting and protective coating works scaffolding works and offshore platforms maintenance and rehabilitation. It serves residential commercial and industrial customers. The company was formerly known as natural gas projects company – SAE and changed its name to Egypt Gas Company SAE in August 2008. Egypt Gas Company SAE was founded in 1983 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Naseej International Trading Company
Description: Naseej International Trading Company together with subsidiaries engages in the manufacture import export wholesale and retailing of carpets and rugs in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company’s products also include flooring furniture and furnishings antiques office furniture blankets kitchens bed sheets curtain fabrics and accessories tuft and yarns. In addition it provides maintenance services for factories governmental and private institutions. The company was formerly known as Al Sorayai Trading And Industrial Group Company. Naseej International Trading Company was founded in 1953 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A.
Description: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. operates as a real estate development company in Brazil. The company undertakes development of residential commercial condominium land and hotel projects; and provides reversible leasing programs. Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co.
Description: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co. manufactures and sells metal engineering products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Transformation Industries Engineering and metal forming industries and Industrial Valves segments. It offers high carbon steel wire products and PC strands for construction and infrastructure projects. The company also provides axles for heavy transport vehicles; and various spare parts for the automotive industry. In addition it offers metal castings including machined castings to the automotive agri and water crushing and mining cement plant oil and gas engineering and general manufacturing industries; and technical and engineering services to the oil and gas petrochemical and general engineering industries. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Jubail the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A.
Description: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. provides industrial infrastructure integrity engineering and inspection services in the petrochemical pulp and paper steel offshore naval mining and infrastructure sectors in Brazil. The company provides access solutions including scaffolding UpPriner LinkDeck Rope access and Web PrinerDeck; mechanical testing chemical analysis metallographic analysis corrosion testing field solutions procedure and welder qualification and failure analysis; execution of injected piles micro-anchoring anchored retaining walls soil nailing shotcrete soil treatment and load testing; pressurized habitat solutions; non-destructive testing inspection of equipment and facilities welding engineering advanced engineering materials engineering and laboratory services training and consulting inspection software and tank inspection services. It also offers Vivax Insertion camera Rovver X and Camera manhole zoom STV-3; conventional removable and reusable PFP hot and cold insulation and thermoplastic coating; industrial park; inspection and RBI finite element analysis engine thermal jackets computational fluid dynamics and fracture mechanics. In addition the company provides CIPP Point repair Steam curing process pressurized networks and UV Line curing process; and resin injection gallery plugging structural repair and reinforcement waterproofing hydrodemolition and priner soil inspection. Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. was formerly known as Mills SI Serviços Industriais S/A and changed its name to Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. in 2016. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: AFMA S.A.
Description: AFMA S.A. provides insurance brokerage services for private and corporate clients in Morocco and internationally. The company offers insurance products for businesses such as civil liabilities operating loss business motor automobile transport damage and credit insurance as well as insurance related to construction; and personal and cyber risk insurance products. It also provides individual insurance solutions comprising car multi-risk home death retirement capitalization individual accident and health insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Cagdas Cam Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Cagdas Cam Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells insulated glass products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers oven and refrigerator glasses; energy saving glass solutions for commercial coolers; and AR coated PV module and greenhouse glasses. It also trades in glass products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Aydin Turkey.

Name: Agma SA
Description: Agma SA engages in the insurance and reinsurance advisory and brokerage business in Morocco. The company offers automobile multi-risk home death accident travel/assistance pension savings insurance products for individuals. It also provides automotive insurance that covers public liability defense and appeal vehicle damage flight fire broken glass collision damage and passenger protection; industrial multi-risk fire/explosions breakage of machinery water damage flight and glass breakage and signs insurance products; construction assembly all risks and civil liability insurance products; and operating losses transported goods credit and cyber security insurance products. The company was formerly known as Agma Lahlou-Tazi S.A. and changed its name to Agma SA in May 2018. Agma SA was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Northern Cement Company
Description: Northern Cement Company produces and sells cement in Jordan. The company offers ordinary Portland Pozzolanic Portland Pozzolanic sulphate resistant Portland low alkali Portland oil well and white Portland cements. It engages in the carbon gypsum and pozzolan griding; investment in other companies; importing white clinker and all kinds; manufacturing and griding of clinker; and importing grinding and crushing of all types of materials for cement and concrete industry. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Northern Cement Company operates as a subsidiary of Northern Region Cement Company.

Name: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.)
Description: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) provides life and non-life insurance products and services for individuals and companies in Kuwait. The company operates through General Risk Insurance Life and Medical Insurance and Investment segments. It offers insurance against the risks related to goods transportation and various marine and aviation vessels; insurance against risks of contractors machine and computer damages and cessation of works; insurance for cash fidelity bonds professional risks work accidents civil responsibility and cars; insurance against fire for buildings stores industrial risks and oil and gas industries; and insurance against accidents for motor vehicles. The company also provides life and health insurance products; and reinsurance services. Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: CSU Digital S.A.
Description: CSU Digital S.A. a technology company for financial services provides digital solutions for payments embedded finance customer experience and loyalty and incentive programs in Brazil. The company operates through two segments: CSU Pays and CSU DX. The CSU Pays segment encompasses solutions in digital payments loyalty and incentives and embedded finance including card processing for issuers and acquirers in the credit debit digital and virtual modalities; the offer of digital wallets instant payments and cryptocurrencies; and others. The CSU DX segment focuses on the development of digital experience solutions with technological and digital density directing efforts to projects with added value and complexity. The company also provides development and operational management relationship and customer acquisition programs; electronic transaction services for companies; information technology outsourcing services; and banking correspondent services to financial institutions. In addition it manages and operates telemarketing and telesales contact centers and credit analysis; captures electronic transactions as means of payment; and develops credit card administration and issuance activities as well as payment account management solutions and activities. The company was formerly known as CSU CardSystem S.A. and changed its name to CSU Digital S.A. in August 2022. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil. CSU Digital S.A. is a subsidiary of Greeneville Delaware LLC.

Name: Financiera Independencia S.A.B. de C.V. SOFOM E.N.R.
Description: Financiera Independencia S.A.B. de C.V. SOFOM E.N.R. a non-bank entity offers micro-lending services in Mexico and the United States. The company provides unsecured loans to individuals with low income and minimum wage informal sector and mothers as well as individuals with proven income as employees self-employed or independent contractors. It also offers consumer credit granting; administrative; and call center promotion marketing and other services. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Gersan Elektrik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Gersan Elektrik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the electrical materials and electrochemical contracting activities in Turkey and Russia. The company offers Power and Lighting busbar systems that are used for buildings and industrial facitlities; hot-dip galvanized pregalvanized stainless steel aluminum normal type and heavy duty cable trays for use buildings airports ships and refineries; and cable carriers cable carrier systems and cable ladder elements.
