It provides earth crossing resistance value current carrying capacity and equipotential bond earthing systems that are used for electrical operating vehicles; and distribution panels including solar panels surface mounted distribution panels and rack cabinets for use in factories hospitals buildings and skyscrapers; and underfloor trunking consisting of underfloor cable tray and raised underfloor cable trays for electricity connection. In addition the company offers electric vehicle charging stations; led-bus lightning systems; and G-Bus automation systems. The company was formerly known as Gersan Ticaret. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A.
Description: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. provides diagnostic imaging and medicine services in Brazil. The company offers diagnostic imaging clinical analysis nuclear medicine genetic testing and vaccination services as well as corporate remote and in-person solutions for hospitals and diagnostic centers in the private and public sectors. It provides clinical analysis services such as blood count cholesterol triglycerides urinalysis 1 stool test detection of sexually transmitted diseases and anatomical pathology; and diagnostic imaging services such as magnetic resonance computed tomography ultrasound x-rays bone densitometry mammography scintigraphy and PET-CT (positron emission tomography – computed tomography). It also offers graphic methods examinations including electrocardiogram cardiotocography Holter ergometric tests and cardiopulmonary tests. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was formerly known as Centro de Imagem Diagnósticos S.A. and changed its name to Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. in April 2023. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was founded in 1992 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Seef Properties B.S.C.
Description: Seef Properties B.S.C. primarily engages in real estate activities in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through four segments: Malls and Properties Serviced Apartments Leisure and Entertainment and Other. The Malls and Properties segment manages real estate properties including the Seef Mall Isa Town Mall and Muharraq Seef Mall as well as other properties in Hamad Town Isa Town Saar and Um-Al Hassam. The Serviced Apartments segment leases Fraser Suites Seef furnished serviced apartments and tourist restaurants. The Leisure and Entertainment segment owns and operates leisure and recreational games facilities in various commercial malls under the Magic Island brand name. The company also manages hotels and amusement parks and theme parks. Seef Properties B.S.C. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Israir Group Ltd
Description: Israir Group Ltd operates as an international tourism and aviation company in Israel. The company operates through four segments:  International tourism and aviation Domestic tourism and aviation Inbound tourism services and Maintenance. It leases aircraft and purchases seats as well as operates scheduled domestic and charter flights. The company is based in Givatayim Israel.

Name: Quds Bank Ltd.
Description: Quds Bank Ltd. provides banking and investment services and commercial solutions to corporate and individual customers. It offers current accounts; personal loans auto financing and real estate financing; credit cards and ATM cards; and e-services money transfer and safe boxes services. The company also provides banking services including treasury and FX services and remittances; financing services such as loans overdraft fixed assets financing project financing purchase and receivable financing discounting bills/cheques and customs financing; international trade services comprising bills for collection letters of credit and letters of guarantees; and mobile and online banking services. It operates through a network of multiple branches and offices in the Palestinian Authority as well as representative office in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P
Description: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P an asset management company engages in the financing and investment activities in Kuwait and Gulf Co-operation council. The company operates through three segments: Finance Investment and Real Estate. It invests in real estate industrial agricultural and economic sectors; acts as an investment portfolio manager; purchases and sells securities and bonds; deals and trades in the foreign exchange market and precious metals market; and owns industrial property rights patents commercial and industrial trademarks commercial designs and literary and intellectual property rights related to programs and writings. The company also invests in Murabaha v and deposit in financial institutions; and offers wealth fund client portfolio and real estate management services. In addition it conducts studies and specializes in analytical research; and engages in the general trading activities. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd.
Description: Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd. produces markets and sells citrus fruit tomato and other non-citrus fruit products in Israel. It also provides natural juices nectars and soft drinks as well as various types of sauces and spreads. The company serves food and beverage industries. It also exports its products to approximately 50 countries worldwide. The company was formerly known as Gan Shmuel Foods Industries (1993) Ltd. and changed its name to Gan Shmuel Foods Ltd. in August 1993. The company was founded in 1941 and is based in Gan Shmuel Israel.

Name: Waja Company
Description: Waja Company engages in the construction business. The company undertakes general construction works for residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals hotels and other projects. It is also involved in the construction and repair of water distribution stations and main pipelines; and design and programming of proprietary software. In addition the company manufactures furniture and wood-based furniture; and offers system analysis artificial intelligence technologies advertising agency and interior decoration design services. Waja Company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Romi S.A.
Description: Romi S.A. develops manufactures and sells machine tools plastic processing machines and cast parts. The company provides machine tools such as machining and turning centers vertical turning centers CNC lathes and vertical CNC lathes CNC borings engine lathes and heavy and extra-heavy-duty CNC lathes; plastic processing machines including plastic injection blowing and molding machines; and casting and machined parts. It also provides presales and aftersales engineering services technical assistance and spare parts; and exports its products internationally. Its products and services are used by various industries such as automotive components manufacturing consumer goods agricultural machinery and implements education and industrial machinery and equipment. The company was formerly known as Indústrias Romi S.A. Romi S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste Brazil.

Name: Syn Prop & Tech S.A.
Description: We are SYN and we have a deep understanding of the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Our business is to make our clients' lives easier so they can focus on their own businesses. We serve various market segments including shopping malls commercial buildings and warehouses. Our services encompass leasing management as well as buying and selling commercial properties. Our team consists of experts in management projects engineering security technology and business with experience autonomy and a lot of talent for innovation to deliver the best solutions. Every day we wake up and dedicate ourselves to ensuring that companies and retailers feel at ease achieve their goals and thrive. We work behind the scenes taking care of people's experiences in SYN spaces while they work shop and have fun.

Name: Saudi Industrial Development Co.
Description: Saudi Industrial Development Co. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells sanitary wares and sponge products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Arab Republic of Egypt. It operates through Mattresses and Sponges; Sanitary Ware; Transportation; Financial Investments; and Other segments. The company offers various pressures and structures of mattresses and beds and its accessories; sanitary ware comprising wash basins showers toilets etc.; wall tiles ceramic flooring and acrylic bathtubs; furniture products from wood; upholstery furniture products; and sist and sponge mattresses. It also engages in the wholesale and retail sale of home furniture and other furniture products; blankets sheets linens and bedspreads; heaters and water tanks; and chairs sinks and devices for saunas. In addition the company acts as a sales agent for furniture and household goods; and rents and manages owned or leased residential and non-residential real estate properties. Further. it is involved in the road transportation of goods and equipment. Saudi Industrial Development Co. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Maytronics Ltd.
Description: Maytronics Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production marketing distribution and technical support of swimming pool equipment in Israel North America Europe Oceania and internationally. The company operates through The Private Pool Robotic Cleaner The Public Pool Robotic Cleaner and Safety Products and Related Pool Products segments. It offers robotic cleaners for private and public pools automatic swimming pool covers alarms and drowning detection systems and other supplementary products for monitoring control and treatment of swimming pool water pumps filters water heaters chemicals to clean the water and other related products. The company offers its robotic pool cleaners under the Dolphin name; and pool alarms under the Aqualarm Premium and Espio names. It sells its products through distributors and e-commerce platforms. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Jezreel Valley Israel. Maytronics Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Kibbutz Yizre'el Holdings 2004 ACS Ltd.

Name: Bor Seker A.S.
Description: Bor Seker A.S. manufactures and sells sugar products in Turkey. It offers granulated sugar sugar cubes stick sugar wet beet pulp bagged beet pulp and molasses. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited
Description: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited engages in the underwriting of various classes of reinsurance and investments activities in Africa the Middle East and Asia. The company offers life and health reinsurance plans; property and casualty insurance policies for the fire marine hull engineering aviation motor and agriculture industries; and Retakaful support services. It also provides training services in the field of insurance and reinsurance industry. Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: YeboYethu (RF) Limited
Description: YeboYethu (RF) Limited acquires and holds shares in Vodacom Group. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes IT products in Turkey. The company’s products portfolio includes computers/tablets smartphones printers consumer electronics software peripherals wearable technologies data storage products smart home products and accessories. It purchases and sells spare parts and home electronics as well as provides logistics and rental services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Quara Finance Company
Description: Quara Finance Company provides financing services in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Retail and SME Financing segments. The Retail segment provides cash loan and microfinance services. The SME Financing segment offers term loans to small and medium enterprises. It also provides lease consumer and small and medium enterprise finance services. The company was formerly known as Maalem Financing Company and changed its name to Quara Finance Company in January 2021. Quara Finance Company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Master Drilling Group Limited
Description: Master Drilling Group Limited an investment holding company provides specialized drilling services to blue chip major and mid-tier companies in the mining civil engineering construction and hydroelectric power sectors. It provides rock boring services including horizontal and vertical raise and box hole boring; slot hole reverse circulation piling and directional drilling; shotcreting; paste holes; and LIDAR scanning for mining civil and energy sectors. The company also offers industrial products. In addition it provides exploration drilling services such as blast hole core mud and air rotary percussion sonic diamond slim and reverse circulation drilling services; de-watering; and geotechnical services as well as mining services. The company also developed new technologies for tunneling shaft sinking and production boring. It operates in Africa Central and North America South Africa South America and internationally. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Fochville South Africa.

Name: Göltas Göller Bölgesi Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Göltas Göller Bölgesi Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells clinker cement and ready mixed concrete in Turkey. The company offers masonry hydraulic blended hydraulic and Portland cement Portland composite cement Pozzolanic cement and sulphate resistant cement. It also provides raw materials and semi-finished products including gypsum trass limestone marn iron ore and bauxite; and Portland cement clinker as well as SR 5 clinker products. The company also exports its products to various countries. Göltas Göller Bölgesi Cimento Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Platform Turizm Tasimacilik Gida Insaat Temizlik Hizmetleri Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Platform Turizm Tasimacilik Gida Insaat Temizlik Hizmetleri Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides personnel and student transportation. The company is involved in the fleet rental; construction equipment and specially equipped vehicle rental; camps and cultural trip organizations; travel agency management; food transportation and distribution services; and metrobus and public transportation services. It also provides personnel support services primarily in the areas of the service sector including cleaning and security such as building and office cleaning auxiliary officer and technical office staff services. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire SA
Description: Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire SA markets and distributes fuels lubricants liquefied petroleum gas and commercial services to mining construction power road transport aviation and marine sectors in Africa. It also provides card food convenience retail and other services. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast. Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire SA is a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell plc.

Name: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Oman and Bahrain. It develops villas and residential buildings; commercial spaces comprising office and retail buildings; and health projects such as medical centers and hospitality projects. The company is involved in the marketing and sales management services; project management services; property management services; portfolio management services; medical services; and real estate brokerage and research services. In addition it purchases owns and sells lands; and operates manages invests in leases and rents hotels health clubs recreational parks gardens exhibition grounds restaurants residential and commercial complexes and tourist and health resorts. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates in the logistics industry in Turkey and internationally. The company offers transportation services including international road transport and air freight national-international rail freight international sea freight intermodal transport domestic full track load transportation domestic distribution furniture distribution and project cargo transportation; and storage services such as conventional dealer shared e-commerce and furniture warehouses. It also provides e-services comprising e-export e-commerce logistics horoz wallet and alibaba membership; and other services consisting of furniture assembly and SSH project management and consulting and customs and insurance services. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Sadr Logistics Company
Description: Sadr Logistics Company manufactures and supplies storage warehousing handling pallets and office solutions in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through four segments: Steel Wood Logistics and Other. It offers storage solutions such as pallet racking systems cantilevers radio shuttle racks shelves clading racks and mezzanine as well as accessories. The company also provides forklifts hand pallets roll containers and conveyors; office solutions comprising mobile shelves carrousel and lockers; wooden plastic and steel pallets; and warehousing services including dock levelers fixed elevators mobile ramps firefighting equipment and epoxy flooring systems. In addition it manufactures prefabricated steel structure units and furniture; forges presses casts and rolls finished and semi-finished metal products; and offers warehousing automation solutions. The company was formerly known as Al Samaani Factory For Metal Industries Company. Sadr Logistics Company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme
Description: Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme processes heavy bitumen crude in Africa. The company offers bitumen and distillates. It exports bitumen to Nigeria Ghana Gabon Senegal Cameroon Mauritania Angola Guinea Conakry Togo Benim and DRC. Société Multinationale de Bitumes Société Anonyme is based in Abidjan Ivory Coast.

Name: Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd
Description: Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd supplies and markets agricultural inputs in Israel. It is involved in the marketing and distribution of inputs for the agricultural sector including plant protection and nutrition materials such as pesticides and fertilizer; industrial and agricultural packaging products that include cartons plastic containers and corrugated cardboards; irrigation and infrastructure solutions; technical equipment including gardening tools home tools synthetic grass clothing and footwear and others; greenhouse and cover solutions comprising polyethylene and nets; and markets seeds and seedlings. The company also operates animal feed production institute and real estate properties as well as markets agricultural tractors. Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd was founded in 1942 and is based in Hefer Valley Israel. Amir Marketing and Investments in Agriculture Ltd is a subsidiary of Amir Supply Ltd.

Name: Jaiz Bank Plc
Description: Jaiz Bank Plc provides non-interest banking services in Nigeria. It offers savings current domiciliary investment and term deposit accounts. The company also provides auto household appliances consumer home working capital project/construction lease to own equity-based import and export financing services as well as school fee hospital and medical bill rent and other financing services. In addition it offers various cards; investment products; letters of credit bonds guarantees acceptances and trade related contingencies that include documentary credits; point of sale; and automated teller machine services as well as online mobile and SMS banking services. Jaiz Bank Plc was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Riyadh Jeddah and Al Khobar. It offers motor out-patient clinic treatment charges property marine cargo engineering burglary comprehensive general liability employers’ liability fidelity guarantee money public and products liability workmen’s compensation and group life and accident insurance products as well as reinsurance products. Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company was formerly known as Gulf Union Cooperative Insurance Co. and changed its name to Gulf Union Alahlia Cooperative Insurance Company in December 2020. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Dammam Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Arabia.

Name: Liva Insurance Company
Description: Liva Insurance Company engages in the insurance and reinsurance businesses primarily in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through six segments: Property Motor Engineering Medical Marine Group Life and Others. It offers car travel home and personal accident insurance products; and small and medium business package solutions motor fleet property marine engineering life workmen’s compensation liability and general accident insurance products. The company was formerly known as Al Alamiya for Cooperative Insurance Company and changed its name to Liva Insurance Company in November 2023. Liva Insurance Company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Liva Insurance Company is a subsidiary of Liva Insurance B.S.C.

Name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)
Description: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries produces and sells a range of branded generic pharmaceuticals food supplements veterinary products and nutraceuticals in Egypt. The company manufactures markets sells and stores pharmaceutical reagents for human and veterinary use and diagnostic reagents for individuals laboratories and hospitals; imports pharmaceutical reagents and raw materials; and produces food supplements for human use. It offers a portfolio of products in various therapeutic areas such as anti-biotics cardiovascular diseases and gastro-intestinal tract disorders anti-infectives alimentary tract and metabolism genito-urinary system nervous system blood forming organs weight management and sex hormones. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC
Description: Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC through its subsidiaries provides steel and cement products in the United Arab Emirates. The company offers wall and ceiling concrete blocks and interlocking tiles; concrete paving products for sidewalks car parks public parks etc.; reinforcing steel services such as steel cut and bend for various sizes and shapes wire mesh products and steel rebar threading and couplers; autoclaved aerated concrete products for the construction of buildings such as residential homes commercial and industrial buildings schools hospitals hotels and other applications; and paving blocks. It also involved in the manufacturing of construction precast concrete and bricks artificial stone articles and hot-rolled steel bars and rods; trading of oilfield and natural gas equipment and spare parts; bricks manufacturing; general trading; and operation of commercial agencies. Abu Dhabi National Company for Building Materials PJSC was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Abu Dhabi the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Oncosem Onkolojik Sistemler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Oncosem Onkolojik Sistemler Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells chemotherapy drug preparation kits medical devices and test kits in Turkey. The company offers OncoCare Monolitik an automated chemotherapy drug preparation device; OncoCare Plus a chemotherapy drug guide; OncoWaste and M-Waste a hazardous waste sealing system chemotherapy drugs cephalosporins penicillins infectious waste and toxic laboratory waste; OncoCare Set a chemotherapy preparation and administration consumables; and Oncocare Infusion Pump. It also provides Oncosem components such as pinch clamps roller clamps 3/4 way connectors vial adapters drip chambers hydrophobic caps male and rotating luer locks spikes taxol filters check valves and covers. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Bonyan for Development and Trade
Description: Bonyan for Development and Trade a real estate investment company acquires operates and leases commercial real estate assets in east and west Cairo. The company is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Penta Teknoloji Urunleri Dagitim Ticaret A.S.
Description: Penta Teknoloji Urunleri Dagitim Ticaret A.S. distributes computer hardware and software goods in Turkey. The company offers Bazinet V3 a B2B e-commerce platform; and Bayinet mobile application for product review and warranty-failure tracking. It offers services including Penta technology center which provides demos PoCs hardware and software presentations and end-to-end business solutions; printing technology center that offers printing solutions and digital printing machines; printing solutions management a printing management model that measures consumables and printer usage of the users; and Penta subscription management which enables to display and manage subscriptions; Penta Mywarehouse for physical storage and online management; Penta Integration a system for storage logistics sales and marketing services; Penta OnAir a communication platform to reach resellers and customers; and 10 to 10 delivery service. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company offers private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical audit services processing of medical bills call center operations claims and hospital network management system licensing and other outsourced healthcare support services. Additionally it engages in mass insurance brokerage through retail channels such as life insurance capitalization home insurance extended warranty financial protection insurance and others. The company facilitates client access to accredited networks of service providers and offers specialized care management services. It provides private collective healthcare plans to members of contracting legal entities offers technical support supports the human resources area in managing plan benefits outsources administrative services manages registration movements checks invoices and provides billing services to beneficiaries by delegation. It also offers consulting services and suggests plan design and management models. In addition the company identifies the target market defines the marketing strategy and distribution model and offers membership plans to potential clients through its own distribution channel or a network of accredited insurance brokers. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. It was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells candies in Turkey. The company provides soft and hard candy chewing gum degree chocolate jelly licorice and marshmallow products as well as surprise eggs and toy products. It also exports its products under the Bebeto and Cosby brand name. Kervan Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1994 is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC
Description: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC engages in the production of palm oil primarily in Ghana. It produces palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Takoradi Ghana. Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC is a subsidiary of Wilmar Africa Limited.

Name: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company
Description: Arabian International Healthcare Holding Company engages in distribution and maintenance of medical devices imaging equipment prosthetics dental and veterinary equipment and cosmetic products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Medical Devices Medical Supplies and Clinical & Pharmaceutical. It offers various products for cardiology intensive care oncology rehab infection prevention technologies hospital infrastructure gene sequencing laboratory anesthesia machines hospital beds and medical furniture lab furniture solution biobanking solution hospital information technology surgical rooms solutions laboratories and ventilation system. The company also provides its products for orthopedics management delivery solutions catheters and syringes and vein thrombosis prevention. In addition it offers medical services at clinics; and sells health and beauty related medicines. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Acrow Misr
Description: Acrow Misr designs manufactures sells and rents formwork and scaffolding products in Egypt Africa South-Eastern Europe Algeria Bahrain Kenya Kuwait Saudi Arabia Morocco Nigeria Oman Qatar Romania Tanzania and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers foundation wall and core wall column slab climbing bridge and façade and suspended scaffolding systems as well as safety equipment access staircase. It also provides engineering solutions formwork sale and rent services site support after sale services and logistics services. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Acrow Misr operates as a subsidiary of Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development.

Name: Golan Renewable Industries Ltd
Description: Golan Renewable Industries Ltd together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures sells and distributes cross-linked polyethylene pipe systems in Israel Europe Latin America Scandinavia North and South America and internationally. The company offers fax and PE-RT pipes and accessories; and installation services for plumbing systems. It serves the residential infrastructure industrial oil and gas aquaculture and mining sectors. The company was formerly known as Golan Plastic Products Ltd and changed its name to Golan Renewable Industries Ltd in May 2024. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Sha'ar HaGolan Israel. Golan Renewable Industries Ltd is a subsidiary of Kibbutz Shaar Hagolan.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Car Rental Business and Leasing Business segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name. It provides replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies as well as other complementary products that include the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. The Leasing Business segment offers services that comprise the leasing of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities. It also provides complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services as well as maintenance plans. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Çates Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi
Description: Çates Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi engages in the production and sale of electricity through its thermal power plant. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Mugla Turkey.

Name: Jazan Development and Investment Company
Description: Jazan Development and Investment Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the aquaculture agricultural manufacturing and real estate businesses in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. It operates through Agricultural Commercial Shrimp Farming and Investment Properties segments. The company is involved in the cultivation of mangoes and fruit seedling; marine shrimp farming; preservation of fish and fish products; cooling and freezing of fruits; production and bottling and distributing of pure filtered water; cutting packing and wrapping fruits and vegetables; operation of hotels and heritage; and animal feed and food storage as well as engages in the road transportation and refrigerated store activities. It also engages in the purchase sale and rental of land and real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Jazan Energy and Development Company. Jazan Development and Investment Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Jazan Saudi Arabia.

Name: Novus Holdings Limited
Description: Novus Holdings Limited engages in the printing production and manufacturing operations in South Africa. It operates through Print Education Packing and Other segments. The Print segment engages in printing of books magazines retail inserts and newspapers for fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector. The Education segment develops educational content for various institutions including government and private colleges. The Packaging segment produces flexible packaging products and prints flexible labels to beverage petrochemical and FMCG markets. The Other segment engages in the non-print/packaging and non-educational related transaction businesses; and provision of jumbo tissue wadding which is used to produce household and consumer products such as toilet paper facial tissue kitchen towels and serviettes. The company was founded in 1905 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Arab Sea Information Systems Company
Description: Arab Sea Information Systems Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the production of software for small medium and large businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers Saudi Administration and Accounting System a management accounting program; SCRIBES System an enterprise resource planning system for medium and large enterprises; 3S POS System a solution for companies with various points of sale such as supermarkets clothing companies footwear pharmacies drug stores and spare parts; and GIC – E-Government solutions a warehouse management system. It also provides consulting and planning installation training and customization service; management and monitoring services for communications and information networks; and cybersecurity services. In addition the company is involved in the repairing and maintaining of engines systems and fixed and portable information storage devices; and retail sale of computers and accessories including printers and inks. Further the company offers information systems and solutions for the government institutions and IT sectors. Arab Sea Information Systems Company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and marketing of manganese minerals and ferroalloys in Mexico and internationally. It is also involved in the electricity generation and mining of precious metals. The company offers ferroalloy and manganese products including high medium and low carbon ferromanganese; silicomanganese; nitrided medium carbon ferromanganese; manganese nodules and carbonates; and other specialty ferroalloys as well as manganese derivatives such as battery-grade natural manganese dioxide ceramic-grade natural manganese dioxide and manganous oxide products. In addition the company generates electricity through hydroelectric plant; and produces electrolytic manganese dioxides. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Autlán Holding SAPI de CV.

Name: Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd
Description: Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd together with its subsidiaries manufactures and markets high-performance spun melt nonwoven materials worldwide. Its products have applications in the adult hygiene baby care construction feminine hygiene filtration industrial medical and transportation sectors. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel. Avgol Industries 1953 Ltd is a subsidiary of Indorama Ventures Spain S.L.

Name: Erciyas Çelik Boru Sanayi A.S.
Description: Erciyas Çelik Boru Sanayi A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel pipes in Turkey. It offers natural gas oil pipes and water pipes. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Vittia S.A.
Description: Vittia S.A. provides fertilizers in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Foliar Fertilizers and Industrial Products; Soil Micronutrients; Soil Conditioners and Organominerals; and Biological Products. It offers biological organomineral foliar bio and concentrated suspension fertilizers; adjuvants; biological pesticides comprising microbiological and macrobiological control; inoculants; sulfur; acaricides; soil conditioners; vegetable nutrition products consist of chloride CoMo phosphite macro nitrate soluble powders and concentrated suspensions; sulphates; and granulated micronutrients and salts for agriculture and livestock. The company was formerly known as Vittia Fertilizantes e Biológicos S.A. and changed its name to Vittia S.A. in May 2023. Vittia S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in São Joaquim da Barra Brazil.

Name: Barem Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Barem Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides packaging solutions in Turkey. It offers corrugated cardboard sheet box paper and offset printed box products. The company serves food electronics hygiene toys textile cosmetics agriculture automotive and other sectors. It also exports its products to 17 countries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company provides insurance services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers property motor marine medical and health general accident engineering and construction visit and tourism travel medical malpractice and other general insurance products and services. Al-Etihad Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2008 and is based in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. engages in the energy and infrastructure business in Qatar and internationally. The company engages in the marketing and sale of products and services related to oil and gas industry; trading and rental of industrial construction equipment; and undertaking water contractor works. It also provides engineering services for geological mining and underground and surface water; and sewage and water draining services. Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1989 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E) provides various corporate retail and investment banking services in Egypt. It offers savings current interest bearing and investment accounts; certificates of deposit; and time deposits. The company provides secured personal auto used cars auto durable goods education syndicated and mortgage loans; revolving overdrafts; loans for small and medium sized businesses; working capital and trade financing; project finance; loans for doctors; and pharmacists lending services. In addition it offers Islamic banking cash management foreign exchange treasury bills and bonds payroll fund margin lending e-statement and online banking services as well as debit credit and internet cards. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Ulusoy Un Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ulusoy Un Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells wheat flour in Turkey. The company offers chapati noodle bread and bagetet rack hamburger toast crown dumplings pizza tortilla filler biscuit wafer cake cracker cookie simit play dough mantilik milfife trako makine rye esmer village bread coating yellow wheat breadcrumbs noodle and soft noodle flour products; and products for high gluten aqua feed and aqua feed as well as home use products. It also manufactures wholesales retail purchases sales and imports and exports of foodstuffs; trading of grains; and warehousing activities for the storage of agricultural products. The company exports its wheat flour to 92 countries in 5 continents from Far East to the Caribbean Islands covering Africa and the Middle East countries. Ulusoy Un Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Samsun Turkey.

Name: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia
Description: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia through its subsidiaries engages in breeding rearing selecting fattening buying and selling of cattle and other species in Brazil. It also engages in agricultural activities buying and selling real estate; engineering services construction and insurance. The company was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Salvador Brazil.

Name: Rimoni Industries Ltd.
Description: Rimoni Industries Ltd. engages in the design engineering and manufacture of molds and precise injection molding and assemblies for the medical automotive agricultural high-tech and consumer industries in Israel. The company offers hardened steel molds including multi-cavity molds molds with hot runner systems prototype molds for complex and intricate products molds for micro-precision parts over-moldings and others. It also provides plastic parts by thermoplastic injection molding; and assembly services for injection molding products. Rimoni Industries Ltd. was founded in 1954 and is based in Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut Israel.

Name: Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd
Description: Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd engages in the construction evacuation and urban renewal activities in Israel. The company was formerly known as BAIT VEGAG GL LTD and changed its name to Bait Vegag Real Estate Development Ltd in April 2022. The company is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Forte Bilgi Iletisim Teknolojileri ve Savunma Sanayi A.S.
Description: Forte Bilgi Iletisim Teknolojileri ve Savunma Sanayi A.S. provides technology solutions in Turkey. Its web-based software applications include FOR-SPLAN that supports the planning and monitoring of the integrated product support process throughout its lifecycle in accordance with S-Series standards; FORS-DOC which enables to write technical documents and compliant with S1000D without having to know XML; FOR-SMM that enables to manage all material and support equipment in compliance with the NATO codification system; FOR-SANALYSIS to perform logistic support analysis in accordance with the S3000L specification; and FOR-SPMTR which enables to create and optimize preventive maintenance tasks and monitor maintenance activities. The company also offers DeskForPM that manages from the project initiation to the closing of the project; DeskForSM which enables organizations to automate service management tasks for equipment licenses and services; DeskForQM that helps organizations to establish and manage a quality and control system; DeskForHR which allows to make personnel plan and tracking and budget adjustment for human resources; and DeskForCRM that enables businesses to communicate with their customers. In addition it provides DOKU a web-based software for materials that are coded in accordance with the NATO codification system and the rules and procedures in the current ACodP-1 documentation; and ELDOK a web application that enables corporate documents to be kept in XML. Further the company offers data center and infrastructure solutions; and services for system solutions. Forte Bilgi Iletisim Teknolojileri ve Savunma Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: E & M Computing Ltd.
Description: E & M Computing Ltd. provides technological solutions in Israel. The company provides software development enterprise applications digital cloud computing on-premises infrastructure business continuity managed services data integration management and analytics security solutions AI and high-performance computing and professional services. It also offers a range of services which include professional services data big-data and analytics hyperscale cloud business continuity cyber security software hosted IT rack-scale systems and data center technologies solutions as well as networking OEM and outsourcing solutions. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S.
Description: Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S. markets and sells building products in Turkey. It provides ceramic sanitary ware armatures bathtubs shower trays built-in reservoirs bathroom furniture ceramic coating products construction chemicals kitchen furniture counters and accessories kitchen appliances and small household appliances under the VitrA Bathroom VitrA Karo Artema Villeroy & Boch and Intema brands. as well as Norm Selena and Punto brand names. The company provides its products through its retail stores as well as through wholesale channels. Intema Insaat ve Tesisat Malzemeleri Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi
Description: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi provides electricity contracting services in Turkey. It offers electrical contracting services for weak current systems LV electrical contract works and MV electrical contract works as well as construction services. The company was formerly known as ORGE Enerji Sistemleri Insaat Metal Ticaret ve Taahhüt A.S. and changed its name to Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi in June 2010. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Arsan Tekstil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Arsan Tekstil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of cotton and synthetic yarn in Turkey and internationally. It offers threads knitted and woven fabrics knitted and woven fabrics and yarn dyeing and finishing products. The company is also involved in the natural gas and electricity distribution tourism marketing and finance activities; and operation of hotel under the A'ija name. Arsan Tekstil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Kahramanmaras Turkey.

Name: Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and selss of steel products in Turkey. The company offers specialty steel products including spring steel flat peeled round and hot rolled round bars in various steel qualities consisting of spring carbon quench and tempering micro alloy boron case hardening free cutting stainless carbon toll and bearing and structural steel. It provides stabilizer bars. The company serves automotive supply wind energy machine manufacturing and defence industries. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey. Çemtas Çelik Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi A.S.

Name: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells bed furniture quilt armchair sofa home textile and home furniture. The company offers beds and mattresses; home textile products that include duvet covers and sets bedspreads blankets sheets and pillow cases bathroom textiles cushions and covers sofa throws and dowry sets; base and headboard sets; and home and sitting room products such as TV blanket slipper pet bed and room fragrances. It sells its products through stores. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kayseri Turkey.

Name: Saudi Networkers Services Company
Description: Saudi Networkers Services Company engages in the implementing establishing maintaining operating installing and managing of telecommunication networks in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Algeria. It offers business process outsourcing permanent solutions managed services provision modular solutions and consulting services. The company provides technical administrative marketing customer care services and technical support for sales centers. It serves telecommunications information technology cyber security banking utilities and other business sectors. Saudi Networkers Services Company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Grupo Sports World S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Sports World S.A.B. de C.V. operates family sports clubs in Mexico. The company offers a range of sports activities and programs as well as training health and nutrition services. Grupo Sports World S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1989 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Al Kathiri Holding Company
Description: Al Kathiri Holding Company together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells ready-mix concrete products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company also supplies transports distributes and sells cement and construction materials such as gravel and washed sand. In addition the company offers three-dimensional concrete panels; real estate contracting and development; telecommunications; construction; yachts and boats; and logistical services and support for the transportation sector. Al Kathiri Holding Company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail sale of technology products in Turkey. It sells its products through its stores; air conditioners and refrigerators through its dealer network; and solar energy systems. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Dardanel Onentas Gida Sanayi A.S.
Description: Dardanel Onentas Gida Sanayi A.S. engages in the seafood business in Turkey. It is involved in the production and sale of canned food including tuna salmon sardines mackerel anchovy and other seafood; frozen food comprising mussels and other seafood; and fish by-products such as fish meal and oil. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Çanakkale Turkey.

Name: Aspen Group Ltd.
Description: Aspen Group Ltd. engages in the purchase initiation improvement management and rental of real estate properties in Israel and the Netherlands. Its property portfolio includes office hotel services trade industrial and logistics buildings. The company was formerly known as Aspen Construction and Development Ltd. and changed its name to Aspen Group Ltd. in July 2009. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Masisa S.A.
Description: Masisa S.A. manufactures and sells wooden boards for furniture solutions and interior spaces in Chile the United States Peru Colombia Ecuador Canada China Vietnam South Korea and internationally. It offers raw and coated panels; medium density fiberboards (MDF); medium density particleboards; one layer boards; particle boards; melamine boards; MDF moldings; sawn timber; finger joint moldings; PVC and ABS edge tapes; melamine ripados veneered and painted interior coverings; and hardware complementary for the development and construction of furniture as well as ECOPLAC and TFL panels. The company also exports its products. It serves the construction industry. The company was formerly known as Terranova SA and changed its name to Masisa S.A. in 2005. Masisa S.A. was founded in 1960 and is based in Santiago Chile. Masisa S.A. is a subsidiary of GN Holding S.A.

Name: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co.
Description: Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. produces and markets agricultural greenfeed in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Al-Sharqiya (Holding Company) Sadu Al Arab and Al Waseet Al Barri Logistics Company (A subsidiary of Sadu Al Arab Trading Company) segments. It is also in involved in agriculture forestry fishing and construction activities; wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles; operation of storage facilities; accommodation and food service activities; real estate activities; art entertainment and leisure activities; and other service activities including growing vegetables in greenhouses and growing uncovered variegated vegetables. In addition the company engages in food security and logistics; and refrigerated and frozen goods land transportation activities. Ash-Sharqiyah Development Co. was founded in 1986 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E
Description: GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E. engages in production of pharmaceutical chemicals. The company is involved in manufacture of general and specialty medicines and vaccines. GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E. was founded in 1981 and is based in London the United Kingdom. GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E operates as a subsidiary of Glaxo Group Limited.

Name: City Cars S.A.
Description: City Cars S.A. distributes transport vehicles and spare parts of Kia brand in Tunisia. The company is involved in storing washing servicing and marketing of spare part accessories and transport vehicle. It also engages in purchase and sale of used vehicles and accessories. City Cars S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in La Goulette Tunisia.

Name: Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C.
Description: Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C. provides banking products and services in Palestine. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury segments. The company offers current savings and financial inclusion accounts; debit and shopping cards; gold-guaranteed loans; and finance programs including auto commodity education health services travel small enterprise corporate and project as well as Ijara Istisna’a and SunRef Energy. It also provides international trade such as letter of credit and banking guarantees; money transfer; foreign currency buying and selling; and cheque books. In addition the company offers e-services including mobile and internet banking; bills electronic and QR payments; SMS video call and pre-booking services; smart soft point-of-sale and point-of-sale; E-SADAD; and digital services center. It operates through a network of branches offices and ATMs as well as a mobile branch. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestine. Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C. is a subsidiary of Bank of Palestine Plc.

Name: Grazziotin S.A.
Description: Grazziotin S.A. engages in the retail and wholesale business in Brazil. The company’s stores offer furniture convenience store merchandise home appliances electronics housewares household clothing and accessories sports articles and perfumery as well as cosmetics foodstuffs decoration camping hygiene and cleaning products. It is also involved in the financial institutions and insurance brokerage as well as manages shopping centers. The company provides its products under Grazziotin Franco Giorgi Pormenos Tottal and GZT brand names. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Passo Fundo Brazil.

Name: Kuvva Gida Ticaret Ve Sanayi Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kuvva Gida Ticaret Ve Sanayi Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi engages in the cinema and TV series production in Turkey. It is also involved in the food cafe and restaurant management activities. The company was formerly known as Serve Film Prodüksiyon Eglence A.S. and changed its name to Kuvva Gida Ticaret Ve Sanayi Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi in September 2022. Kuvva Gida Ticaret Ve Sanayi Yatirimlari Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Egeyapi Avrupa Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Egeyapi Avrupa Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as a real estate development company in Turkey. It undertakes housing office hotel shopping mall and educational institution projects. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aircraft and cargo handling passenger handling passenger profiling and crew transportation services in Nigeria. It operates through Ground Handling Cargo Handling and Other segments. The company engages in ramp services and baggage handling. It also provides cargo documentation services for airlines import and export facilitation through customs bonded warehouses across the network. In addition the company involved in energy and power distribution and leasing of ground handling equipment. Further the company offers aircraft handling disinfection cleaning and aircraft movement control load control baggage/cargo off and onloading GSE supply and utilization unit load device management and baggage reconciliation services. Additionally it provides cargo handling services including warehousing import cargo bulk breaking cargo delivery and customs control-services; and crew transportation as well as aviation training services. Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: C. Mer Industries Ltd.
Description: C. Mer Industries Ltd. provides solutions in the areas of homeland security (HLS) communication infrastructure and defense technologies. The company offers solutions in the areas of cybersecurity border protection command and control platforms emergency response management critical infrastructure smart and safe cities for governments municipalities organizations and other entities. It also provides communication infrastructure solutions such as fiber optic networks wireless networks and indoor communication systems to operators broadcasters municipalities and governments to enable high speed wireless networks and cable TV; and training and consulting services on HLS professions and roles. In addition the company offers defense technologies for tactical communication and threat detection solutions including land solutions consist of mVIS modular vehicle intercom system mACS multi-site audio RoIP solution; CellBox LTE networks in a box and communication platform solutions for shelters UAVs and mission aircraft; sea solutions such as mCMS: vessel integrated communication system RHIBs communication system; C-UAS maritime drone defense system and gas rig communication systems for offshore operations; and air solutions comprising integrated airspace system UAV communication solution and air defense communication. It operates in Latin America the United States Africa Europe Asia and Israel. C. Mer Industries Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is based in Or Yehuda Israel.

Name: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme
Description: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme provides leasing and factoring services in Tunisia Algeria Ivory Coast Senegal Burkina Faso Mali Cameroon Gabon Kenya Zambia and Tanzania. It provides finances auto transport building equipment medical and real estate. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme is a subsidiary of Amen Bank Société anonyme.

Name: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.
Description: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. The company operates through three segments: Chemical Products Paper and Other Operations. It offers paper pulp coated paper and photocopy paper; ivory glass paper wet strength label paper soap paper and special paper for religious books; and label papers soap packaging papers envelope papers and blueprint papers white kraft papers and cup papers. The company also provides sodium sulphate potassium sulphate salt and magnesium chloride liquid. In addition it offers Insurance intermediary services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Anaam International Holding Group Company
Description: Anaam International Holding Group Company through its subsidiaries engages in the agricultural activities foodstuff trading and entertainment and beauty businesses. The company also manufactures medical equipment and healthcare products. Anaam International Holding Group Company was founded in 1980 and is based in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited
Description: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates in the transport sector in South Africa. It operates in two segments Passenger transport services and Vehicle and spares – sales and servicing. The company operates diesel buses electric buses and luxury charter coaches. It also provides public transport school and private tours luxury coaches shuttle services as well as involved in parts and spares sales. The company was formerly known as Hosken Passenger Logistics and Rail Limited and changed its name to Frontier Transport Holdings Limited in September 2021. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited was founded in 1861 and is based in Cape Town South Africa. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited.

Name: Depa PLC
Description: Depa PLC together with its subsidiaries provides interior solutions. The company operates through Vedder; Depa Interiors; Deco Group; and Investments and Others segments. It offers interior contracting services; manufactures and procures customized furniture fixtures and equipment; installs and supplies stones marbles travertines and granites; and manufactures and supplies joinery and carpentry works to the interior fit-out sector. The company also engages in the installation of floors walls and ceilings; procurement of supplies and materials from third parties; and provision of fixed joinery paneling woodwork and doors and frames as well as refurbishment works and space planning. In addition it is involved in the strategic management and real estate business. The company serves hospitality residential commercial luxury retail super yacht private aircraft transport infrastructure private residences cultural and tourism social infrastructure and cruise liner sectors. Depa PLC was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Dmr Unlu Mamuller Uretim Gida Toptan Perakende Ihracat A.S.
Description: Dmr Unlu Mamuller Uretim Gida Toptan Perakende Ihracat A.S. operates bakeries in Turkey and internationally. It offers bagels pastries pizzas croissants and wraps. The company also engages in the wholesale activities. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Zain Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: Zain Bahrain B.S.C. principally engages in the provision of public telecommunications and related products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company is involved in the provision of data roaming gaming streaming social media and call passes; mobile insurance; entertainment plans; and mobile and broadband plans devices home solutions and gift cards as well as trading of handsets and accessories for personal customers. It also offers mobile fiber and wireless broadband dedicated internet local and global connectivity UCaaS business roaming smart vehicle management bulk messaging landline and PABX Internet of Things smart WiFi SD-WAN ATM co-location Microsoft 365 Huawei Idealhub domain registration value added tax solutions and reference interconnect offer as well as cloud and managed security services for business customers. In addition the company provides local and international credit transfer services. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Zain Bahrain B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Soquimich Comercial S.A.
Description: Soquimich Comercial S.A. development production marketing and sale of plant nutrition products primarily in Chile. It offers water-soluble fertilizers; granulated fertilizers; specialty plant nutrition products for foliar application; organic products for use in organic agriculture; custom made soluble and granulated mixes; and other products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Santiago Chile. Soquimich Comercial S.A. operates as a subsidiary of SQM Industrial S.A.

Name: Empresas Iansa S.A.
Description: Empresas Iansa S.A. manufactures and markets various food products in Chile and internationally. It offers sugar sweeteners delicacies expanded cereals premium juices and pet foods under Iansa sugar Iansa Zero K Iansa Agro Tanmaya Fellness Cannes and Biomaster brand name; sugar petfood cossette molasses concentrated juices fruit and vegetable pulps tomato paste and food ingredients under Industrial patagoniafresh and Icatom brand name; and beets tomatoes seedlings wheat and other crops under Agricultural Supplies Agricultural Production Animal Nutrition brand name. Empresas Iansa S.A. was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Santiago Chile. Empresas Iansa S.A. is a subsidiary of ED&F Man Holdings Limited.

Name: Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development
Description: Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development provides steel related products in Egypt. The company offers steel sheets sandwich panels corrugated sheets accessories steel purlins and guard rails. It also manufactures and sells metal formwork and scaffolding storage shelves sheet metal and prefabricated buildings and caravans. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development operates as a subsidiary of AIF Holding Limited.

Name: Sure Global Tech Co.
Description: Sure Global Tech Co. together with its subsidiaries provides technological and consultative solutions for public and private sectors in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Infrastructure Managed Services Digital Services and Products segments. The company offers business technology services including software development infrastructure services information security services and integrated support and operations services for various sectors. It also provides technical financial solutions for businesses and individuals through various electronic payment products and services; invests in startups and develops products for customers need. In addition the company is involved in installation of telecommunications equipment and mainframe; wholesale and retail of computers and accessories including sale of printers and inks; system analysis user interface and experience design robotics virtual and augmented reality application development artificial intelligence cybersecurity blockchain and big data technologies; data science and analysis; and establishing of infrastructure for hosting network. Further it provides data processing and related activities designing and programming special software virtual network operator short messages cloud computing management and monitoring services; installation of TV satellites computers and telecommunications networks; computer consulting experience activities and computer facilities management; and characterizing analyzing and designing software databases and applications. Sure Global Tech Co. was founded in 2004 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Renergen Limited
Description: Renergen Limited an investment holding company engages in the alternative and renewable energy businesses in South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Tetra4 and Cryovation segments. The company explores for develops and sells liquefied natural gas and helium gas. It also develops Cryo-Vacc technology which enables the transportation of vaccines and biologics at low temperature without any electrical power. Renergen Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Zahraa El Maadi Investment and Development Company SAE
Description: Zahraa El Maadi Investment and Development Company SAE develops and sells residential units and lands in Egypt. It engages in the construction real estate development housing investment and tourism businesses. The company is based in New Maadi Egypt.

Name: Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries purchases sells and exchanges land and real estate properties in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in Real Estate Management and Investment Management segments. The company is also involved in the construction and leases of buildings commercial and residential complexes. It also manages properties; purchases and sells securities of companies; develops and builds real estate properties; and invests in equities and other investments. In addition the company undertakes maintenance works of buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and air-conditioning works. Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Gadwa for Industrial Development
Description: Gadwa for Industrial Development operates as an industrial development and investment company in Egypt and internationally. The company manufactures packing materials and papers electrical wires and cables and cheese including white processed Swiss and Italian varieties. It also manufactures installs and assembles electricity water and gas meters. In addition the company engages in contracting and real estate investment pharmaceuticals and financial advisory businesses. Additionally the company provides dairy products manufactures packaging materials and produces self-adhesive tabs corrugated carton boxes and boards. Further it engages in manufacturing copper and aluminum cables and conductors. Gadwa for Industrial Development was founded in 2021 and is based in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica
Description: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica engages in the distribution of electricity in Brazil. It supplies electricity in 72 areas of the 497 municipalities that covering an area of approximately 87101-kilometer square. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil. Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica is a subsidiary of Equatorial Participações e Investimentos S.A.

Name: Av-Gad Holdings Ltd
Description: Av-Gad Holdings Ltd. engages in real estate development activities focusing on urban renewal projects in Israel. The company is involved in improving upgrading strengthening and protecting residential buildings as well as upgrading public areas and infrastructure. Av-Gad Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Ra’anana Israel.

Name: Inovest B.S.C.
Description: Inovest B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the asset management private equity and venture capital specializing in growth capital and real estate investment businesses in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The firm operates in a Shariah-compliant manner. It invests in direct investments and securities; establishes invests in and manages various investment funds; and undertakes contracting activities. The company also develops maintains leases and manages commercial and industrial centers residential buildings and other properties; purchases and sells properties; and constructs and maintains villas as well as offers project management and related advisory services. In addition it deals in financial instruments in the local regional and international markets; offers financial services and investment consultation services; provides information and studies related to various types of investments; and imports exports and sells electronic and electrical equipment and appliances. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited
Description: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited manufactures and sells steel products in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Steel Operations and Non-Steel Operations segments. The company offers flat steel products such as hot rolled plate hot rolled coil – pickled and oiled cold rolled coil galvanized coil color coil and electrogalvanized coil; light bay and heavy bay steel castings; long steel products including fencing profiles forgings heavy structural sections hexagon bars hollow bars mining bars rails reinforcing/Y bars round and square bars special profiles window sections wire rods and billets and blooms; and hot rolled and cold drawn seamless tube products. It also produces commercial coke and commercial grade coal. The company serves agricultural armament automotive bolt and nut chains construction engineering furniture and appliance mining packaging piping renewable energy roofing and cladding and tubing industries. It was formerly known as Mittal Steel South Africa Limited and changed its name to ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited in October 2006. The company was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Vanderbijlpark South Africa. ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited is a subsidiary of Arcelormittal Holdings AG.

Name: Lamasat Company
Description: Lamasat Company operates a chain of beauty centers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also manufactures and supplies beauty and cosmetic products. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Al Madinah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Unilever Ghana PLC
Description: Unilever Ghana PLC manufactures and markets sells fast-moving consumer goods in Ghana. It operates through the Nutrition Home Care and Beauty & Personal Care segments. The company provides laundry and household care products; and skin cleansing skin care oral and deodorant products. It is also involved in investment management; real estate development; and manufacturing importing and exporting goods wares and merchandise. The company is headquartered in Tema Ghana. Unilever Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

Name: Shaniv Paper Industry Ltd
Description: Shaniv Paper Industry Ltd engages in the production and marketing of paper cleaning automotive and personal care products in Israel and internationally. It offers toilet paper towels tissues and napkins as well as a new line for the institutional market. The company also produces and imports aluminum foils and molds nylon products packaging and various paper products. In addition it develops manufactures and markets cleaning products including cleaning materials products for treating fabrics and carpets perfumes and air purifiers and products for renovation and home maintenance insecticides and pests under the Touch TNX and Magic brand names; and car products comprising car fragrances cleaners upholstery repair preparations oils and additives industrial aids auxiliary materials for professionals hand cleaning pastes maintenance sprays and others under the Maxol-Max brand. Further the company manufactures and markets personal care products and cosmetics under the Novo and Beauty Calcir brand names such as face and body care creams oils perfume hair care products deodorants and spa products; and offers shampoos and hair nutrients as well as body lotions under the MB Miki Buganim brand. Additionally it offers technical/contracting services under the MD Clean brand; beauty care products under the BABE brand; ecological products under the Touch Green Care brand name; and professional products under the Touch Professional Company brand. The company serves home personal care automotive sector and institutional markets. Shaniv Paper Industry Ltd was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Ofakim Israel.

Name: Orma Orman Mahsulleri Integre Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Orma Orman Mahsulleri Integre Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells particle and melamine coated particle boards in Turkey Asia Europe Africa and internationally.
