Description: Credit Rating and Collection Company K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries engages in the credit rating collection and investment businesses in Kuwait. It offers invoice management service a pre-collection program designed for clients to hand over their invoices and contracts; direct collection service that directly collects from debtors for new overdue or bad debt accounts; special and executive collection service a program targeting collection of overdue debts from individuals and corporates on behalf of corporate clients; and skip tracing service to determine the location of the debtors. The company also provides legal action services that offers legal advice regarding filing claims before the law courts against civilians travel ban orders arraignment and arrest warrants assets seizure orders foreclosures and other legal aspects; international collection service to collect debt globally; debt remedial and risk management services; and credit rating service which provides investors with critical information to enable them to take informed investment decision based on their risk-return preferences. In addition it engages in the renting and leasing of land and real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Credit Rating and Collection Company K.S.C. (Public) operates as a subsidiary Investment Dar Company K.S.C.

Name: Grupo Nutrisa S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Nutrisa S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a holding company in the retail sector that produces and sells healthy and natural food products in Mexico. It offers yogurts; sweets beverages and snacks; yogurt ice cream; and coffee-based beverages. It sells its products through Nutrisa Moyo Cielito Querido Café and Chilim Balam brands. It operate primarily through stores located in Mexico and markets in Central America and Spain. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Mexico City Mexico. Grupo Nutrisa S.A.B. de C.V. operates independently of Grupo Herdez S.A.B. de C.V. as of September 18 2025.

Name: Pinar Entegre Et ve Un Sanayii A.S.
Description: Pinar Entegre Et ve Un Sanayii A.S. produces and sells meat and by-products of bovine and ovine animals poultry and fish as well as frozen dough products and ready meals under the Pinar brand in Turkey. It offers delicatessen products including soudjouks salamis sausages hams smoked meats and roasted raw meat products; frozen meat products such as burgers meatballs and doner kebabs; frozen dough products comprising pizzas puff pastries mantis and boyoz products. The company also provides frozen seafood products consisting of shrimps and squids as well as anchovy sardine and haddock products; and unprocessed meat products such as unprocessed beef turkey and lamb products. It offers its products through stores and e-commerce platforms. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. Pinar Entegre Et ve Un Sanayii A.S. is a subsidiary of Yasar Holding A.S.

Name: ITMAM Consulting Company
Description: ITMAM Consulting Company provides business transformation and management consulting solutions to various industries. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Alfa Holdings S.A.
Description: Alfa Holdings S.A. engages in the provision of financial products in Brazil. It engages in the credit to legal entities and individuals private banking wealth management asset management investment banking and insurance. The company was formerly known as Real S.A. and changed its name to Alfa Holdings S.A. in April 1999. Alfa Holdings S.A. was incorporated in 1959 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Alfa Holdings S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco Safra S.A.

Name: Champion Breweries Plc
Description: Champion Breweries Plc engages in the brewing and marketing of Champion lager beer and Champ Malta in Nigeria. The company also provides contract brewing and packaging services. It offers its products under the Champion Lager Beer Champion Lager Beer with Ginger Extract Champ Malta Champ Malt with Butter Cookies Flavour and Champ Malt with Tiger nut brands. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Uyo Nigeria. Champion Breweries Plc is a subsidiary of Raysun Nigeria Limited.

Name: Pinar Süt Mamülleri Sanayii A.S.
Description: Pinar Süt Mamülleri Sanayii A.S. through its subsidiaries processes produces and sells milk and dairy products in Turkey. It offers milk butter cheese yoghurts kefir ayrans creams fruit juices and drinks ketchup mayonnaise chocolate topping mustard hot and BBQ sauce whipped cream milk powder lemonade frii pinar sausage salami kavurma ham smoked meat convenience foods sea foods bottled water and out-of-home consumption products under the Pinar brand name. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey. Pinar Süt Mamülleri Sanayii A.S. is a subsidiary of Yasar Holding A.S.

Name: Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji Üretim A.S.
Description: Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji Üretim A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the establishment construction commissioning renting generation and sale of electrical energy and/or capacity to transmission and distribution companies in Turkey and internationally. The company generates electricity through solar hydroelectric and biomass power plants. Its installed capacity includes 7822.76 kilowatts peak (kWp) of solar power plants; 12100 kWp of hydroelectric power plants; and 10500 kWp of biomass power plants. The company was formerly known as H26 Solar Enerji Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji Üretim A.S. Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji Üretim A.S. was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S.
Description: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S. together with its subsidiaries owns and operates hospitals in Turkey. It is also involved in designing platform to compare the content presentation form and prices of the services provided by the contracted health services; and operation of medical units. In addition the company offers insurance and brokerage services; health services; milk and livestock breeding; and laboratory services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Assurances Maghrebia SA
Description: Assurances Maghrebia SA provides insurance and reinsurance products to individuals professionals and companies in Tunisia. The company offers car home travel pleasure boat health school accident provident borrower all risk business transport fishing vessel hull comprehensive computer equipment and civil and public liability insurance as well as savings and retirement unit-linked investment savings plan and complementary pension insurance products. It also provides real estate services to corporate and individuals; and engages in the capital investment activities. In addition the company offers software development services for insurance IT outsourcing and business processes outsourcing for clients in Tunisia and internationally. Assurances Maghrebia SA was founded in 1973 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S.
Description: Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. develops real estate properties in Turkey. The company was formerly known as Mutlu Yatirim Proje ve Gayrimenkul Gelistirme A.S. and changed its name to Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. in May 2015. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Türker Proje Gayrimenkul ve Yatirim Gelistirme A.S. is a subsidiary of Türker Yatırım Holding A.Ş.

Name: Senergy Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Senergy Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides oilfield services in Kuwait Bahrain and Pakistan. It operates through two segments Investment Management and Drilling and Maintenance. The company’s solutions include open hole logging including petrophysical formation testers and micro-resistivity formation imagers services and mechanical sidewall coring tool conveyance options and wellbore logging solutions; cased hole logging consisting of internal and external corrosion analysis data acquisition tools saturation monitoring and mechanical services such as through-tubing bridge plugs explosive-free pipe cutters and free point indicators and gyro measurements; and perforations services including wireline and tubing-conveyed perforating systems. It also offers geosciences services such as complete well integrity assessment four phase flow analysis advanced production logging in horizontal well with ICD completions production logging using jet pump in artificial lift wells reservoir flow evaluation in water injection wells and evaluation of water injection profiles in horizontal wells with open hole completions; and surface well testing and slickline services. In addition the company provides drillstem testing solutions and offers various tools such as full-bore test packers tension safety joints hydraulic jars gauge carriers tester valves circulating valves exit valves and expansion joints. Further it offers slickline services including removing unwanted obstructions; removing wax scale sand and fill build-ups; perforating; fishing; swabbing; packer setting; and other mechanical interventions. The company also offers maintenance of oil facilities wells and refineries; and provides general trading and contracting and engineering services as well as well testing services for oil and gas sector; and offers wireline services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Al Ahmadi Kuwait.

Name: Livestock Transport and Trading Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Livestock Transport and Trading Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in purchasing transporting and selling livestock in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates Australia and South Africa. It operates through Commercial Food processing and Investments segments. The company offers livestock frozen and chilled meats fresh cuts fertilizers and carcasses. It also provides meat products such as burger meatball sausage minced meat mortadella pastrami kebab roast beef and frankfurter. In addition the company is involved in purchasing transporting ranching and selling of live and slaughtered sheep and various skins and intestines; purchasing and selling of fodders; and wholesale and retail of chilled and frozen meat products. Further it engages in the trading of livestock and meat products; establishment and management of commercial and industrial projects; and sea transportation of miscellaneous goods. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Amana Cooperative Insurance Company
Description: Amana Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical/Health Motor and Property & Casualty segments. It offers engineering - all risk fidelity guarantee general and product liability healthcare marine cargo money motor personal accidents property travel and workmen compensation insurance products. The company also provides reinsurance services. Amana Cooperative Insurance Company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A.
Description: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A. engages in the developments leasing and management of real estate assets in Brazil. It operates convenience centers corporate buildings shopping centers hotels and parking lots as well as provides self-storage units +Box built to suit rent agreements and sale lease back services. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes Brazil.

Name: Zarka Educational & Investment Co.
Description: Zarka Educational & Investment Co. operates education centers. It engages in the establishing and managing of kindergartens; establishing of schools for various educational levels entitlements and medical claims training in technological skills rehabilitation auditory and verbal training speech therapy and training in the use of computers and computer programs. It is also involved in satellite broadcasting activities. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Az Zarqa Jordan.

Name: MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals
Description: MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals produces medicines chemicals medical and dental supplies cosmetics veterinary and herbal medicines and dietary supplements in Egypt and internationally. It operates through Biological Production Drug Production and Other Pharmaceuticals segments. The company provides its products for the treatment of acne alopecia analgesics and anti-inflammation atopic dermatitis autoimmune disease bone health cardiovascular cerebral insufficiency diabetic neuropathy and retinopathy dyslipidemia gastroenterology and hepatology glaucoma hematoma and thrombosis hemorrhoids haemostasis immuno-stimulants and immunomodulatory and infertility as well as for iron deficiency anemia labour induction menopause nausea and vomiting ocular infection and inflammation osteoporosis post operative management pregnancy and lacation probiotic and gut health psoriasis respiratory tract infection rheumatoid arthritis supplements topical antibiotics topical muscle relaxant and venous disease. MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A.
Description: Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development and construction businesses in Chile. The company operates through two segments Real Estate and Construction for Third Parties. It develops and sells houses and apartments under the Moller & Pérez-Cotapos brand; and constructs hospitals clinics and centers. The company was founded in 1961 and is based in Santiago Chile. Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones 957 Spa.

Name: Tam Development Company
Description: Tam Development Company operates as a management and digital solutions consultancy in Saudi Arabia. It offers advisory services in the areas of innovation and entrepreneurship delivery acceleration public engagement and change management mass capability development and organizational/functional setup. The company also engages in the activities of advertising; public relations and communications; incubators and accelerators business; provision of marketing services for third parties; market research; conducting of opinion polls; and management consulting activities. In addition it offers digital products and managed services including engagement hub innovation hub and product operation; customized solutions such as app development public engagement solutions artificial intelligence and emerging technology; and CX and digital transformation including digital experience data analytics technology integration and process engineering. It serves the tourism culture education entertainment health and business industries. Tam Development Company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tek-Art Insaat Ticaret Turizm Sanayi ve Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi
Description: Tek-Art Insaat Ticaret Turizm Sanayi ve Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi engages in the tourism business in Turkey and internationally. It invests builds and operates hotels resorts golf facilities restaurants cafeterias casinos and entertainment venues beaches amusement parks marinas yacht docks tourist goods outlets and regulation schools and related facilities. The company operates Zigana Hotel resort. In addition it offers tourism transport and car rental services as well as acts as a travel agent. Further the company operates stores display areas and warehouses in ports and free zones. Tek-Art Insaat Ticaret Turizm Sanayi ve Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Wifack International Bank Société anonyme
Description: Wifack International Bank Société anonyme engages in Islamic banking operations in Tunisia. The company offers accounts; short medium and long-term financing services; bank cards; and digital banking services. It also offers insurance services that include sharia compliant products. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Medenine Tunisia.

Name: Technos S.A.
Description: Technos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing and wholesale distribution of wristwatches. It also provides technical assistance services for watches. The company sells watches through retail stores as well as websites under the Technos Mormaii Michael Kors Dumont Touch Allora Fossil Euro Mariner and Condor brands. The company was formerly known as GMT Participações SA and changed its name to Technos S.A. in 2011. Technos S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Sanko Pazarlama Ithalat Ihracat Anonim Sirketi
Description: Sanko Pazarlama Ithalat Ihracat Anonim Sirketi develops purchases imports exports markets and sells dyed and non-dyed yarns and artificial and synthetic fibers in Turkey and internationally. It offers hydrophilic cotton weaving knitting and clothing of industrial goods and other textile products. The company also provides ring carded and combed melange slub core spun dyed core twist and organic cotton yarns; and knitted fabrics such as single jersey rib interlock two and three thread fleece terry and towel and pique fabrics as well as knitted fabrics with elasthane. In addition it offers woven fabrics including stretch novelty and overdyed denim fabrics; sportswear; cotton woven fabrics; cot-stretch fabrics; color woven products; and curduroy fabrics as well as printed fabrics. The company was formerly known as Temko Pazarlama Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi and changed its name to Sanko Pazarlama Ithalat Ihracat Anonim Sirketi in March 1998. Sanko Pazarlama Ithalat Ihracat Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Grimoldi S.A.
Description: Grimoldi S.A. manufacturing import marketing and distribution of footwear accessories and clothing. It offers footwear such as sneakers sandals shoes clogs tacos boots comfort outdoors running and flip-flops; and accessories including bags backpacks wallets socks toiletry bags fanny packs cleaning and belts. The company also provides services related to logistics storage custody deposit etc. It offers its products under the Hush Puppies Vans Kickers Cat Merrell Walking Arezzo Jansport New Balance Caterpillar The North Face a-pie Stitching and Grims and Dr. Martens brands through its stores third-party stores franchises and online. Grimoldi S.A. was founded in 1895 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells medical devices in Turkey. The company offers breathing sytems products including breathing circuits breathing filters catheter mounts gas sampling lines accessories masks and connectors. It also provides hospital products such as barrier cream surgical hand brushes for skin disinfection hand and skin antiseptics and skin and mucosa antiseptics. In addition the company engages in the manufacturing and sale of anesthesia and intensive care circuits; installation operation and design of oncology drug preparation and delivery systems; production sales and technical service of infusion pumps and sets; and manufacturing of biocidal products. It also exports its products to 80 countries under its Altech brand name. Meditera Tibbi Malzeme Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Dofer Yapi Malzemeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Dofer Yapi Malzemeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells iron steel mesh and reinforcing bar products in Turkey. It also offers cold drawing rods and pipe ducts as well as prefabricated reinforced concrete structure and concrete substation mesh products. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: CM Hospitalar S/A
Description: CM Hospitalar S/A engages in the distribution of hospital materials medicines and nutrition products in Brazil. The company offers ophthalmic agent adrenergic and thrombopoietin agonist aminoglycosides painkiller anesthetics receptor antagonist anti-hemorrhoidal antihypertensives systemic antihistamine and orthopedic therapy materials; and anti-inflammatories anti-TNF antacid antiandrogen antianemic anti-asthmatic antibiotic anticoagulant anticonvulsant monoclonal antibody anti-growth antidepressant antidiabetic antidiuretic antidote antiemetics and antinauseants anti-migraine antiepileptics antiestrogens antifibrinolytic antiflatulent antifungal antihemorrhagic antimicrobial antineoplastics antiparathyroid drugs antiparkinsonian antipsychotic systemic antipsoriasis antirheumatics anti-varicose and antiviral medicines. It also provides beta blocker carbohydrate cycloplegic contraceptive contrast special control corticosteroid topical debrider diuretic electrolyte pancreatic enzyme erythropoietin uterine and cardiac stimulant growth factor granulocyte colony stimulating factor gastroprokinetic systemic hemostatic heparins hepatoprotector and lipotropic hormone adeno-pituitary and growth hormone immunoglobulin immunosuppressant labor inducer proton pump and phosphodiesterase inhibitor bone resorption inhibitor platelet aggregation inhibitor adenosine diphosphate receptor antagonist proton pump and interleukin inhibitor proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 inhibitor and calcium reabsorption inhibitor medicines. In addition the company distributes orthopedic products compression socks and diapers; and transports medical and hospital cargo. Further it provides support infrastructure and assistance as well as pharmaceutical monitoring to patients at home; and wipes and wet towels. CM Hospitalar S/A was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Ribeirão Preto Brazil.

Name: Isbir Sentetik Dokuma Sanayi A.S.
Description: Isbir Sentetik Dokuma Sanayi A.S. operates in the industrial packaging and technical textile sectors in Turkey Europe the United States and internationally. The company offers big bags carpet backing PE-PP fabrics compound fillers additive masterbatches and masks as well as PE films including shrink and stretch hoods. It serves the food pharmaceutical chemical and mining industries. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Balikesir Turkey. Isbir Sentetik Dokuma Sanayi A.S. is a subsidiary of Isbir Holding A.S.

Name: Alisra for Education and Investment Company (PLC)
Description: Alisra for Education and Investment Company (PLC) engages in the establishment and building of private university under the name of Isra University in Jordan. It also provides education services as well as invests in the field of tourism agricultural and commercial sectors. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: First Takaful Insurance Company - KPSC
Description: First Takaful Insurance Company - KPSC provides takaful insurance solutions to individual commercial and industrial sectors in Kuwait. It operates through two segments Takaful Insurance and Investment. The company offers life and medical insurance products including domestic helpers policy; and fire and general accident insurance products such as house holder’s comprehensive fire and allied perils Insurance property all risks loss of profit hotel comprehensive energy terrorism burglary fidelity guarantee money glass workmen’s compensation general public and product liability professional indemnity decennial liability and directors’ and officers’ liability insurance products. It also provides engineering insurance products including contractor’s and erection all risk contractor’s plant and equipment all risks electronic equipment machinery breakdown deterioration of stock boiler and pressure vessel and loss of profit following machinery breakdown insurance products. In addition the company offers marine and aviation insurance products comprising hull aviation marine cargo and freight forwarder’s and ship/liner agent’s liability insurance products; and motor insurance products that consists of comprehensive vehicle third party liability driver’s license personal civil liability and orange card insurance products as well as fleet and vehicle total loss insurance policy products. Further it engages in the real estate business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. First Takaful Insurance Company – KPSC is a subsidiary of International Financial Advisors Holding – KPSC.

Name: Bonus BioGroup Ltd.
Description: Bonus BioGroup Ltd. a clinical-stage biotechnology company develops products based on tissue engineering and cell therapy. The company’s products under development include BonoFill for the treatment of bone tissue regeneration in maxillofacial and orthopedic indications and defects in limb and jaw bones which is in Phase II clinical trial as well as in a preclinical stage for the treatment of bone augmentation in osteoporosis patients. It also develops MesenCure for the treatment of COVID patients suffering from pneumonia and ARDS which is in phase III clinical trial as well as in preclinical stage for the treatment of other inflammations and tissue damage including chronic kidney diseases osteoarthritis and cytokine release syndrome. The company was formerly known as Oceana Advanced Industries Ltd. Bonus BioGroup Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Haifa Israel.

Name: Alexandria Spinning & Weaving Co.
Description: Alexandria Spinning & Weaving Co. manufactures and trades in textiles cast cotton felt and accessories in Egypt. The company offers compact gassed final and coarse combed and carded yarns. It also exports its products to European and Arab countries as well as to the United States Canada and the Far East. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: AIICO Insurance Plc
Description: AIICO Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting and related financial services in Nigeria. It operates through Life Insurance General Business Health Management and Asset Management segments. The life insurance segment offers whole life term assurance guaranteed pensions endowment pensions mortgage endowment savings and protection products as well as other long-term contracts. The General Business segment provides auto household commercial and business interruption insurance; and general insurance to individuals and businesses. The Health Management segment offers prepaid health plans to cater for the health needs of individuals and corporate organizations. The Asset Management segments offers portfolio management services structured investments and mutual funds for corporate and individual clients. In addition the company offers annuity property marine fire personal accident pure risk home and travel insurance as well as marine manufacturing agricultural and oil and gas insurance; and various risk plans. It markets its products through insurance brokers and agents. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Kutahya Seker Fabrikasi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kutahya Seker Fabrikasi A.S. produces and sells crustal sugar from beet in Turkey. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kütahya Turkey.

Name: Tureks Turunc Madencilik Ic ve Dis Ticaret A.S.
Description: Tureks Turunc Madencilik Ic ve Dis Ticaret A.S. produces and sells marble natural stone travertine onyx and related products in Turkey and internationally. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Afyonkarahisar Turkey.

Name: InterCure Ltd.
Description: InterCure Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research cultivation production marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical-grade cannabis and cannabis-based products for medical use in Israel and internationally. The company offers dried cannabis inflorescences and cannabis extract mixed with oil. It also invests in the biomed sector. The company has a strategic alliance with Cannasoul R&D Ltd. for the research development and commercialization of evidence-based cannabis therapeutics. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Mecure Industries PLC
Description: Mecure Industries PLC manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals in Nigeria. The company develops produces and markets generic drugs as well as specialty pharmaceuticals. It offers tablets capsules and syrups; and multivitamins and dietary supplements. The company was incorporated 2005 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S.
Description: Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S. engages in journalism printing advertising publishing and internet broadcasting activities primarily in Turkey and Europe. The company publishes newspapers and other periodical or non-periodical publications in printed and electronic form. It is also involved in the production sale distribution and promotion of programs and audiovisual materials films and advertisements and other works. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Hürriyet Gazetecilik ve Matbaacilik A.S. is a subsidiary of Demirören Medya Yatırımları Ticaret A.Ş.

Name: Tat Gida Sanayi A.S.
Description: Tat Gida Sanayi A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of tomato and canned products in Turkey and internationally. Its products include tomato pastes sauces convenience food and pickles. It also offers food beverages agricultural and animal foodstuffs and products; and frozen dried and powdered raw materials including processed varieties and auxiliary and additives as well as engages in the production distribution and marketing of domestic and semi-finished products of sugar-free juice. Tat Gida Sanayi A.S. was formerly known as Tat Konserve Sanayii AS. and changed its name to Tat Gida Sanayi A.S. in November 2013. Tat Gida Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Middle & West Delta Flour Mills
Description: Middle & West Delta Flour Mills engages in the manufacture storage trading importing and exporting of grain and its products and alternatives. The company provides bread towels foodstuffs in general yeast ice refrigeration and freezing feed and their components; and pasta. It also offers packaging supplies. In addition the company invests in securities real estate sector logistical areas and hotel and tourist places. Further it provides commercial agency services for others. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tanta Egypt.

Name: Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A.
Description: Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A. operates as a manufacturer of engine components for light vehicles utility vehicles trucks agricultural machinery motorcycles and products for railway and marine transportation in Brazil. It offers spare parts such as camshafts pistons valve guides injector sleeves valve tappets cylinder liners valve seats combustion pre-chambers rocker arms piston rings engine valves reamers piston with ring valve springs and crankshaft rings; specialized tools for railway maintenance; and casting models. The company also exports its products. Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Rio Do Sul Brazil.

Name: Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in investment and manufacturing and trading activities in Kuwait and internationally. The company invests in various sectors such as industrial utilities services and other related sectors. It manufactures cement blocks; and invests in and develops real estate projects. In addition the company owns shares and equities of Kuwait and foreign shareholdings as well as limited liability companies or participates in the association of these companies. Further it engages in lending activities for companies and owns rights of industrial property such as patents industrial trademarks industrial fees or other rights to lease them to other companies. The company was formerly known as Boubyan International Industries Holding Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Mayar Holding Company
Description: Mayar Holding Company engages in the manufacturing selling trading installing and maintaining of elevators and escalators and their spare parts in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Elevators and Escalator; Feed Poultry and Agriculture; and Plastic segments. The company also produces and trades in feed for poultry and livestock; trades in agriculture; and produces various plastic products such as drip irrigation systems plastic semi-finished plastic compound PVC compound EVA shoes and sandals products. In addition it engages in trading of irrigation systems; and manufacture of food as well as rubber soles for shoes. Mayar Holding Company was founded in 1999 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Balwin Properties Limited
Description: Balwin Properties Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the development and sale of residential properties in South Africa. It operates through Sale of Apartments; Provision of Services to Balwin Residential Estates; Bond Commission; Residential and Commercial Property Rental; and Balwin Foundation segments. The company sells sectional title apartments. It also engages in various businesses including fibre infrastructure and related services; mortgage bonds; clean energy and treated water; security and access control supply and services; internet services; and maintenance services to body corporates. In addition the company is involved in the rental of residential properties; investment and management of commercial properties; management of lifestyle amenities within developments; rental of digital advertising and cell tower infrastructure; online sale of sports equipment; and resale of previously owned Balwin apartments. Balwin Properties Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aviation handling services in Nigeria. Its services include aircraft/ramp handling cargo handling passenger handling premium lounge aviation security and baggage reconciliation as well as ground and flight dispatch services. The company also operates SAHCO Training Academy that offers aviation training courses; and provides equipment rental and maintenance services. Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Ikeja Nigeria.

Name: The Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd.
Description: The Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd. produces sells and imports vegetable ghee and oil products in Palestine. It offers soya oil corn oil and sunflower oil products. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Konfrut Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Konfrut Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates in agricultural and food sector. It also sources and trades in agricultural products such as fruits vegetables and various pulses as well as provides integrated storage and logistics solutions for agricultural products. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Konfrut Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Döhler Gida Sanayi A.S.

Name: Upper Egypt Mills Company J.S.C
Description: Upper Egypt Mills Company J.S.C produces and sells flour in Egypt. It also imports and manufactures bread; exports grain products; and operates in real estate and trading business. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Sohag Egypt.

Name: Ithmaar Holding B.S.C.
Description: Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides financial services in the Middle East Africa Asia and internationally. It operates through Retail & Corporate Banking; Asset Management/Investment Banking; and Others segments. The company offers retail commercial investment and private banking; wealth asset and fund management; and real estate development services. It serves retail and corporate clients. The company was formerly known as Ithmaar Bank B.S.C. and changed its name to Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. in January 2017. Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Manama Bahrain.

Name: Turk Ilac Ve Serum Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Turk Ilac Ve Serum Sanayi Anonim Sirketi produces and sells pharmaceutical products in Turkey. It offers IV Parenteral Solution (Serum) ampoule/vial products and dialysis solutions. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Dagi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Dagi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiary produces markets and retails ready-to-wear products for men women and kids in Turkey and internationally. The company primarily produces and sells underwear pajamas nightgowns tracksuits plus size maternity clothes and swimsuits and swim shorts. It also offers casualwear including T-shirt crop tops/tanks shorts sweatshirt/jacket pants sweatpants dress shirt and maternity casual wear; home-sleepwear; beachwear such as bikini bikini tops and bottoms beach dress mayokini and pareo; and sportswear. In addition the company provides accessories such as lingerie and hair accessories socks sunglasses bag towel slippers hat and beanie. It sells its products through online retail stores wholesale channels and franchises. Dagi Giyim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company Limited
Description: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company Limited produces and sells injection molding extrusion film blow molding and thermoforming disposable plastic products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers film products such as car seat covers and floor mats; green house jumbo shrink and wrap rolls; grip-hole jumbo loop-handle medical trash shopping T-shirt trash and wicket hole bags; and slitted sheets. It also provides thermoform plastic packaging products including cups trays containers dishes lids lunch boxes and bowls as well as PP/PET sheet rolls; and blow molding products comprising a range of bottles and cans. In addition the company offers injection molding products such as pails food and microwave containers cups baby slider and ladder battery containers buckets various caps and lids crates bowls and dishes drinking water caps/covers pallets and wash basins. Arabian Plastic Industrial Company Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Space-Communication Ltd
Description: Space-Communication Ltd. provides satellite communication services worldwide. The company offers on-the-move connectivity solutions; satellite broadband services including high-speed two-way internet broadband internet access B2B and B2C point-to-multipoint streaming congestion-free IP trunking and on-demand services; and satellite broadcasting services such as DTH and TV/audio origination and distribution redundancy and backup encryption satellite news gathering video signals packaging and up-linking TV channels retransmission and satellite TV programs broadcasting services. It provides hybrid cellular-satellite internet solutions; cross-region connectivity services; and satellite teleport services. In addition the company offers government network solutions comprising local area network interconnection VSAT network satellite VPN and data transmission services as well as delivery of video voice and data to remote locations including videoconference telephony fax transmissions etc. Further it provides point of sale applications such as ATM and inventory reports; and internet applications. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel. Space-Communication Ltd. is a subsidiary of Eurocom Holdings (1979) Ltd.

Name: Birlesim Mühendislik Isitma Sogutma Havalandirma Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Birlesim Mühendislik Isitma Sogutma Havalandirma Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides heating cooling ventilation and other mechanical installation services. The company also offers plumbing fire protection and fire stop systems natural gas distribution systems and medical gas systems as well as testing adjusting and commissioning solutions. It serves hospitals and medical buildings industrial facilities business and life centers commercial buildings hotels shopping centers and residences. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Cambuci S.A.
Description: Cambuci S.A. manufactures and sells soccer equipment in Brazil Africa South and Central America Asia and Europe. The company produces balls footwear accessories and apparel. It sells its products under Penalty and Stadium brands. The company operates through stores and e-commerce channels to direct customers and retailers. Cambuci S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in São Roque Brazil.

Name: Horizon Food Company Limited
Description: Horizon Food Company Limited engages in the cutting processing packing and packaging of meat and poultry in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers meat shawarma doner kabab and chicken shawarma. It also provides sausages and hamburgers; and chilled and frozen poultry rabbits birds and meat. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Otto Holding A.S.
Description: Otto Holding A.S. through its subsidiaries engages in the development and maintenance of agriculture and livestock in Turkey. It is also involved in the production if media film and content; investment and marketing of copyright publication broadcast reproduction dissemination and other financial rights; development of informatics games and electrification technologies; and development and lease of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Taç Tarim Ürünleri Hayvancilik Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Otto Holding A.S. in November 2021. Otto Holding A.S. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Cornerstone Insurance Plc
Description: Cornerstone Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries offers risk underwriting and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life Insurance Life Insurance Takaful Insurance Fin Insurance Leasing and Life Deposit Administration/Investment Contracts. It offers property-casualty and life/health insurance products. The company also provides motor vehicle aviation marine engineering all risks asset protection liability to third party oil and gas group life credit life mortgage protection term assurance wealth creation Takaful fire and burglary gadget protection goods in transit home personal accident and travel insurance products. In addition it offers leasing services; and investment products. Cornerstone Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: N.R. Spuntech Industries Ltd.
Description: N.R. Spuntech Industries Ltd. produces markets and sells non-woven fabrics in Israel the United States Canada Europe Central and Southern America and internationally. The company offers dry disinfecting hard surface scrubbing window bathroom automobile and glass wipes; medical swabs and gauzes bleach wipes bandages and tapes germicidal wipes and medicated wipes; pads face masks make-up removal soap impregnated facial face care and feminine hygiene wipes; baby wipes; commercial multipurpose and hard surface scrubbing wipes; and HVAC filters. Its products are used for household medical cosmetics and feminine care baby and industrial applications. N.R. Spuntech Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Tiberias Israel. N.R. Spuntech Industries Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Nissan Medical Industries Ltd.

Name: Jerusalem Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd.
Description: Jerusalem Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd. develops manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products in Palestine the Middle East North Africa and internationally. It offers range of over-the-counter prescription pharmaceutical and nutritional supplements products. The company produces approximately 300 pharmaceutical products in various dosage forms such as tablets capsules sterile injectables suspensions syrups powders suppositories ovules creams ointments and ear and nose drops as well as solutions. It also produces detergent cosmetic personal hygiene veterinary and agricultural products. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: AlMuneef Company for Trade Industry Agriculture and Contracting
Description: AlMuneef Company for Trade Industry Agriculture and Contracting trades in seeds and agricultural products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Agricultural Sector and Transportation Sector segments. The company engages in the operation of quarrying cutting and sawing of marbles; and renovation of non-residential and residential buildings. It is also involved in the wholesale of chemical fertilizers and soil conditioners insecticides and pesticides; retail sale of agricultural seedlings and pesticides seeds and fertilizers and soil improvers; retail of fuel for cars and motorcycles; land transportation of goods; and storage of grains flour and agricultural products in silo warehouses. The company sells its products through online. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Derluks Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi
Description: Derluks Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries manufactures and retails leather textile knitwear and weaving products for men women and children in Turkey and internationally. It also manufactures clothing accessories; trades leather and textile chemicals fabric yarn and apparel materials; and distributes and markets water soft drinks alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and food products. In addition the company exports its products. Further it produces and sells electricity through solar energy sources. The company was formerly known as Derluks Deri Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Derluks Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi in March 2021. Derluks Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ram-On Investments and Holdings (1999) Ltd
Description: Ram-On Investments and Holdings (1999) Ltd engages in development production and marketing of plastic compounds and products in Israel. The company was formerly known as Poliram (1999) Ltd and changed its name to Ram-On Investments and Holdings (1999) Ltd in September 2015. Ram-On Investments and Holdings (1999) Ltd was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Gilboa Israel.

Name: EI- Nile Co. for Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries
Description: EI- Nile Co. for Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries develops produces and sells pharmaceutical products in Egypt. The company offers tablets capsules ampoules powders gels and creams syrups suppositories lotions shampoos ointments mouthwashes powder solutions and nasal and midodrine drops. It also exports its products to the countries in the Middle East. The company was founded in 1962 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: South Valley Cement Company
Description: South Valley Cement Company produces and sells cement and its associated products in Egypt. The company provides Portland cement clinker Portland ordinary cement and ready-mix concrete. It also owns and manages a portfolio of multi sector direct and indirect investments. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Panelsan Cati Cephe Sistemleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Panelsan Cati Cephe Sistemleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells sandwich panels EPS insulation materials and other products in Turkey. The company offers facade roof acoustic and cold room panels; EPS products including thermal insulation boards injection sheets EPS blocks light filling products mold injection products decorative ceiling coverings and geopans; trapezoidal overlays; solar power plant solutions; and complementary products. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Epitomee Medical Ltd
Description: Epitomee Medical Ltd a biomedical company develops and commercializes ingestible therapeutic devices worldwide. Its capsule is used for weight management waist circumference reduction and cardiovascular risk factors reduction. Epitomee Medical Ltd has a strategic partnership with Nestlé Health Science S.A. for the development and commercialization of the weight loss capsule. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Caesarea Israel.

Name: International Meal Company Alimentação S.A.
Description: International Meal Company Alimentação S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates restaurants bars and cafes that offers food and beverages in Brazil Colombia and the United States. The company also for airlines; operates food courts at service stations and restaurant chains along highways; sells fuel for vehicles; provides services to franchisees of the KFC and Pizza Hut brands; and subletting stores and spaces for promotional and commercial purposes in its chain stores as well as provides general services. The company operates its restaurants under the Frango Assado Viena Brunella Margaritaville KFC Pizza Hut Batata Inglesa and RA Catering brand names. International Meal Company Alimentação S.A. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Fontana Limited
Description: Fontana Limited engages in buying selling and retailing of pharmaceutical and associated products in Jamaica. The company’s product portfolio includes baby and toddler beauty caregiver essentials electronics gifts gift ideas groceries health home party and special occasions personal care school and office supplies seasonal and stationery products as well as digital gift cards and toys. It also offers its products through online. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Mandeville Jamaica. Fontana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Burbank Holdings Limited.

Name: Misr Chemical Industries Co.
Description: Misr Chemical Industries Co. produces and sells in various chemical products in Egypt and the Middle East. The company offers sodium hydroxide solutions and liquid chlorines. It also provides compressed hydrogen gases caustic soda flakes commercial and pure hydrochloric acid sodium hypochlorite and ferric chloride products. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt. Misr Chemical Industries Co. operates as a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Isbir Holding A.S.
Description: Isbir Holding A.S. through its subsidiaries primarily engages in the production of home furnishing products in Turkey. The company provides canvas greenhouse covers under-carpet and lined products unlined valve bags mesh bags and heavy-duty bags made of polyurethane; flexible sponge; and foam products for used as basic input of beds armchairs sofas and sitting groups home textiles manufacturing sector auto upholstery packaging heat and sound insulation applications. It also manufactures and sells cow mattresses under the trade names of mattresses bed bases and ranchbeds; and under the brands of ÄÅŸbir Bedding and ÄÅŸbir Ziraat. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Güler Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: Güler Yatirim Holding A.S. engages in the investment activities in Turkey. The company was formerly known as Baskent Menkul Kiymetler Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. and changed its name to Güler Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi in August 2011. Güler Yatirim Holding A.S. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: S.A. San Miguel A.G.I.C.I. y F.
Description: S.A. San Miguel A.G.I.C.I. y F. engages in cultivation processing producing and commercializing citrus products in Argentina. The company is involved in harvesting packing and grinding activities. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Vicente López Argentina.

Name: UPDC Plc
Description: UPDC Plc together with its subsidiaries develops sells and manages real estate assets in Nigeria. The company operates in two segments Property Development Sales & Management; and Hospitality Services. It acquires develops sells leases and manages commercial and residential accommodation properties and retail spaces as well as offers advisory services. The company also provides facilities management services to residential and commercial properties; and hotel management services such as sale of rooms and conference halls as well as food and beverages. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. UPDC Plc is a subsidiary of Custodian Investment Plc.

Name: Grupo Mexicano de Desarrollo S.A.B.
Description: Grupo Mexicano de Desarrollo S.A.B. develops and operates infrastructure projects in Mexico. The company develops and operates port maritime and inland terminals; hydraulic infrastructure systems for potable water supply and wastewater treatment; maintenance and operation of highways and roads; and tourist destinations including marinas residential developments and hotels. It also produces metallic structure and precast concrete; and offers engineering and construction services in various industries. In addition the company involved in the operation of energy sector projects including renewable power generation and hydrocarbon storage tanks activities. Grupo Mexicano de Desarrollo S.A.B. was founded in 1942 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Artemis Hali Anonim Sirketi
Description: Artemis Hali Anonim Sirketi designs manufactures and sells carpets in Turkey and internationally. The company operates under the Artex Baroque Bella Couture Dior Dream Gothic Charisma Mina Murano Allegra Palace Romantic Runner Samoa Silk and Vanessa names. It also offers its products through online. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bahadir Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Bahadir Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and distributes oils and aerosol products in Turkey. It offers lubricants for cars commercial and heavy commercial motorcycles and gear and transmission oils; greases; aerosol sprays; brake hydraulic fluids; and other products. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Kirikkale Turkey.

Name: Minupar Participações S.A.
Description: Minupar Participações S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the provision of slaughterhouse services in Brazil. The company operates through two segments Industrialized and Slaughterhouse Services. It is involved in the industrialization and commercialization of industrialized meat; and poultry slaughter and processing. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Lajeado Brazil.

Name: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops constructs and sells residential and commercial real estate properties for middle-class and upper middle-class customers in Brazil. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Thimar Development Holding Company
Description: Thimar Development Holding Company together with its subsidiary Wasmi and Thimar Meat Company produces wholesales and retails meat products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also manages invests in holds real estate and movable properties and provides general and specific borrowings guarantees and funds for its subsidiary to finance its projects. The company was formerly known as National Agricultural Marketing Company and changed its name to Thimar Development Holding Company in October 2021. Thimar Development Holding Company was founded in 1987 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Deniz Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Deniz Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. operates as a real estate investment trust in Turkey. The company engages in real estate investment and development activities. Its property portfolio consists of residential hotel and commercial units in Istanbul Ankara and Bodrum. The company qualifies as a real estate investment trust for federal income tax purposes. It generally would not be subject to federal corporate income taxes if it distributes at least 90% of its taxable income to its stockholders. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Deniz Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a subsidiary of Denizbank Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Amar Finance and Leasing Company - KPSC
Description: Amar Finance and Leasing Company - KPSC engages in the real estate related activities in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: Islamic Financing Investment and Real Estate. It is involved in the real estate purchase and development activities as well as sale of land. The company provides investment placement services as well as other investment services. In addition it offers working capital solutions. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: PC Iletisim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: PC Iletisim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. provides media and integrated communication planning services in Turkey and internationally. It offers media planning and purchasing; digital performance agency; terrestrial and digital radio planning and purchasing services; and services in the areas of content marketing collaborations production program purchase and sale brand partnerships and small and medium-sized event organizations and arrangements. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. PC Iletisim ve Medya Hizmetleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Ilbak Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd
Description: Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates in the industrial and agricultural sectors in Palestine. It engages in the manufacturing of feed raising broiler chickens and producing and selling of hatching eggs as well as fresh and frozen chicken. The company also processes and converts cardboard rolls into carton boxes ready for use and marketing; and produces rolls for wrapping furniture and furniture. In addition it produces various type of pipes and semi-finished plastic containers as well as involved in general trading business. Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd was founded in 1995 and is based in Nablus Palestine.

Name: Amwaj International Company
Description: Amwaj International Company engages in distributing and selling electronic and home appliances. It distributes air conditioning units televisions washing and drying machines water coolers refrigerators and freezers stove and cooking appliances heaters and other household appliances. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Amwaj International Company is a subsidiary of Zahran Holding.

Name: Metro Ticari ve Mali Yatirimlar Holding A.S.
Description: Metro Ticari ve Mali Yatirimlar Holding A.S. engages in the travel management facility and hotel management mining and energy businesses in Turkey. The company buys and sells motor land transportation vehicles; sells domestic and international flight tickets; operates hotels under the EUPHORIA HOTEL name; extracts purchases operates enriches refines and leases underground and surface mineral and natural resources; buys imports exports and sells food products; and produces meat and meat products. It is involved in the generation and selling of electricity; provision of road passenger transportation and tourism agency services; selling domestic and international flight tickets; and investment activities. The company was formerly known as Van-Et A.S. Metro Ticari ve Mali Yatirimlar Holding A.S. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Arab Tunisian Lease S.A.
Description: Arab Tunisian Lease S.A. provides financial leasing services in Tunisia. The company engages in leasing of auto construction equipment transport vehicles medical equipment and photovoltaic as well as real estate. It operates through a network of agencies. Arab Tunisian Lease S.A. was founded in 1993 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: FosRich Company Limited
Description: FosRich Company Limited together with its subsidiary O’N’S Mini Mart & Electrical Supplies Limited distributes lighting electrical and solar energy products to retail and commercial customers in Jamaica. The company distributes boxes panels steel wire armoured cables wires wiring devices bulbs contactors breakers switches and similar apparatus; ceiling and standing lighting outdoor lighting fans and electrical supplies; and hardware supplies and related products. It also manufactures PVC pipes fittings and conduits; refurbishes pole mount transformers; and offers technical advice. In addition the company installs solar energy systems solar water heaters and electrical panel boards. It serves the electrical solar energy industrial and hardware industries. FosRich Company Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Sukoon Takaful PJSC
Description: Sukoon Takaful PJSC engages in the insurance and reinsurance business in the United Arab Emirates. The company offers property insurance products such property all risk householder’s cover engineering and business interruption; engineering insurance products including contractors all risks electronic equipment erection all risks and machinery breakdown; and cargo and private pleasure boats and yachts marine insurance products. It also provides liability insurance products comprising public products and employer’s liability as well as workmen’s compensation; personal accident fidelity guarantee jeweller’s block money and professional indemnity; motor insurance products such as comprehensive and third-party cover; group and individual medical insurances; and group family insurance products. The company was formerly known as Arabian Scandinavian Insurance Company (PLC) - Takaful - ASCANA Insurance and changed its name to Sukoon Takaful PJSC in June 2024. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. Sukoon Takaful PJSC is a subsidiary of Sukoon Insurance PJSC.

Name: Pamukova Yenilenebilir Elektrik Uretim A.S.
Description: Pamukova Yenilenebilir Elektrik Uretim A.S. engages in the renewable energy business in Turkey. It is involved in the operation of 2 hydroelectric power plants with an installed power of 6946 MW located in Adiyaman province as well as 7.49 MW located in Tortum district of Erzurum province. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Pamukova Yenilenebilir Elektrik Uretim A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Pamukova Elektrik Uretim A.S.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Tgi Infrastructures Ltd
Description: Tgi Infrastructures Ltd together with its subsidiary produces processes assembles and markets mechanical assemblies made of magnesium for the automotive industry in Israel. The company is involved in the production of electrical cabinets and other copper and metal products; and production of leaf batteries for transporting various liquids such as water steam and thermal oil or gas for heating or cooling purposes. It also offers steering interior powertrain and transmission and structural products. The company was formerly known as Tadir-Gan (Precision Products) 1993 Ltd. and changed its name to Tgi Infrastructures Ltd in March 2022. Tgi Infrastructures Ltd was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Afula Israel.

Name: Ihlas Gayrimenkul Proje Gelistirme ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ihlas Gayrimenkul Proje Gelistirme ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the construction and real estate activities. It constructs residential workplaces and social facilities. The company is also involved in the mining marketing and energy businesses. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Makina Takim Endüstrisi A.S.
Description: Makina Takim Endüstrisi A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of cutting tools in Turkey. It offers twist drills taps dies thread chasers reamers countersinks milling cutters tool bits and saws as well as solid carbide drills end mills and reamers. The company also manufactures specially designed products for automotive defense machine and white goods appliances customers. It also exports its products. Makina Takim Endüstrisi A.S. was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Gebze Turkey.

Name: Al-Fakhera Men's Tailoring Company
Description: Al-Fakhera Men's Tailoring Company engages in the manufacture and sale of tailoring clothes for men and children. It also offers men’s and children’s clothes rings slippers sticks underwear and other accessories. The company sells its product online. Al-Fakhera Men's Tailoring Company was founded in 1976 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: TGS Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: TGS Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides intermediary services to exporters companies in Turkey. Its primary business is to mediate the export activities of the manufacturers and to collect the value added tax refunds on behalf of its customers due to their export transactions in the textile mining and other sectors. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Dogusan Boru Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Dogusan Boru Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells materials related to tiles as well as roof wall and floor coverings in Turkey. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Erzincan Turkey.

Name: Primotec Group Ltd
Description: Primotec Group Ltd engages in the production import and marketing of a range of consumer products in Israel and internationally. The company offers cleaning products hygienic papers disposable products PE bags and rolls household equipment industrial packaging solutions and hotel amenities under the Sea of Spa brand name; and detergents. It is also involved in the business of furniture and equipment for medical and nursing institutions; and design and development solutions for hygienic spaces. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Be'er Sheva Israel.

Name: Hamashbir 365 Ltd
Description: Hamashbir 365 Ltd operates departmental stores in Israel. The company offers gift products for children women men new mother and holiday gift products; electricity products including vacuum cleaners heating and ventilations irons coffee accessories cultivation and kitchen and electrical appliances; home and leisure products for leisure and travel home design bedroom bathroom table and catering and kitchen products; children and youth men’s and women’s underwear and shoes products; and sportswear accessories related equipment products. It offers baby accessories shirts pants interchangeability sweatshirts jackets pajamas swimwear shoes hoodies coats overalls bodysuits and other products for youth boys girls and baby boys and girls. In addition the company provides women’s accessories swimwear lingerie and clothing; and men’s accessories lingerie and menswear as well as beauty products for men’s grooming hair care body care facial care makeups and perfumes for men and women. Further it operates THREESIXTYFIVE a full-service e-commerce platform for online online purchasing and shipping products to the customer. It markets its products under the ABERCROMBIE & FITCH BALI CARCHAREL DELONGH ELEMIS F4 G-STAR HAPPY SOCKS INITIAL J. DEL POZO KANKEN L’OREAL PARIS MAISON FRANCIS KURKDJIAN NAAMAN ORABAIBI PALLADIUM RABANNE SABRINA TEFAL UMBRO V-CANTRO WENGER XERIOFF YVES SAINT LAURENT ZADIG & VOLTAIRE and other various brands. The company was formerly known as Hamashbir 365 Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to Hamashbir 365 Ltd in August 2019. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Netanya Israel.

Name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
Description: Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter Ethical Products and Consumer Healthcare Product. It offers drugs infusions and injectables. The company also provides products for anti infective and anti malaria central nervous system and cough and cold gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions. Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: City People of Rotshtein Group Ltd
Description: City People of Rotshtein Group Ltd engages in the residential construction business in Israel. City People of Rotshtein Group Ltd was founded in 2007 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries manages real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates through Real Estate Activities Haj and Umrah Services and Investment Activities segments. The Real Estate Activities segment invests in real estate properties for the purchase sale development and renting of residential and commercial properties including land and land development properties in various geographical locations. The Haj and Umrah Services segment provides ticketing travel and logistics services to Haj and Umrah. The Investment Activities segment lends to subsidiaries and associates; and invests excess cash flows in investments managed by specialized financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Awj Holding Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. in September 2017. Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: ÜNLÜ Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: ÜNLÜ Yatirim Holding A.S. together with its subsidiaries provides investment advisory and asset management services to investors corporates multinationals and financial institutions in Turkey and internationally. The company offers investment advisory services including mergers and acquisitions equity and debt capital markets loan capital markets and consultancy corporate equity sales services and investment advisory and brokerage services. It also offers asset management services such as portfolio management and non-performing loans services. ÜNLÜ Yatirim Holding A.S. was founded in 1996 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S.
Description: Fonet Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S. provides information technology services in the healthcare sector in Turkey. The company offers information management systems system integration consultancy and turnkey project services in the field of health informatics. The company's products include FONET HBYS that manages medical administrative and financial business processes of health institutions; FONET LIS an information management system software; Fonet PACS an image archiving and communication system; FONET H2H an inter-hospital integration system; and FONET OPİZ an operational business intelligence. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Sanica Isi Sanayi A.S.
Description: Sanica Isi Sanayi A.S. produces and sells radiators towel warmers boilers built-in reservoirs control panels and underground and aboveground pipes in Türkiye. The company offers condensing and combi boilers; standard and design panel radiators; aluminum column stainless steel and steel design radiators; and standard and dizayn towel rails as well as accessories. It offers its products under the Sanica brand. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Istanbul Türkiye.

Name: Land'Or Société Anonyme
Description: Land'Or Société Anonyme manufactures processes and trades in meat products and their offal seafood cheese ready meals and agro-food products worldwide. Land'Or Société Anonyme was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Enka de Colombia S.A.
Description: Enka de Colombia S.A. manufactures and sells resins and fibers in North America Central America South America and Europe. The company offers nylon tire cord fabrics for reinforcement in automobile tires application; high tenacity yarns and twisted yarns; and products made from recycled PET bottles. It also produces polyester and polyamide (nylon) fibers filaments and yarns polyester and polyamide (nylon) polymers and polyester and polyamide (nylon) and recycling of PET and polyolefins. It serves nets strings narrow wovens sewing threads chemical industries of tires textiles plastics beverages and other industries. Enka de Colombia S.A. was founded in 1964 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Sanifoam Endustri ve Tuketim Urunleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Sanifoam Endustri ve Tuketim Urunleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries produces and trades in industrial and cleaning products. It offers Basotect; Firex foams; Echobon a high-density ecological insulation material; Echopol a low-density flexible foam product; SaniFilter material; SaniShine a high strength flexible polyurethane foam; SaniHydro comprises Hydro-F31 Hydro-M35 and Hydro-G; SaniFelt a fibre felt products; SaniSeal a sealing material; SaniTape a self-adhesive tape; coating and layering products; and SaniWood a plywood and compact laminate products. The company also provides scrubber sponges cleaning clothes bath sponges and scouring fibers as well as car sponges with shampoo under the Sanitex Star and Blues brands; and microfiber clothes stainless steel scourers and melamine and cellulosic sponges. In addition it offers polyether and polyester sponges scouring fibers and packaging and raw materials. The company’s products are used in automotive household appliances sound insulation and acoustic arrangement industrial insulation cleaning and technical applications. Sanifoam Endustri ve Tuketim Urunleri Sanayi Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tekirdag Turkey.

Name: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company
Description: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company manufactures and sells cement in Tanzania. The company provides portland limestone cement with limestone extenders for construction with high strength application; portland composite for structural and non-structural cast foundations columns beams walls girdles paving slabs kerbs interlocking pavement slabs and bricks; and portland composite cement for road stabilization and enhancing properties of soil. It offers its products under the Simba Cement brand. The company was formerly known as Tanga Cement Company and changed its name to Tanga Cement Public Limited Company in June 2014. Tanga Cement Public Limited Company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Tanga Tanzania. Tanga Cement Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of AfriSam Mauritius Investment Holdings Limited

Name: SMART Tunisie SA
Description: SMART Tunisie SA engages in the import wholesale and distribution of IT and computer equipment and accessories in Tunisia. It also provides after sales services. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Carbacid Investments plc
Description: Carbacid Investments plc an investment holding company engages in the mining processing and marketing of carbon dioxide gas in Kenya. The company operates through Trading and Investments segments. It invests in properties shares and bonds and financial assets. Carbacid Investments plc is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Uniwax SA
Description: Uniwax SA manufactures and sells wax cloth in Ivory Coast. It offers wax block wax print sublime wax custom fabrics and signature under the Uniwax brand. Uniwax SA was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Yopougon Ivory Coast.

Name: Naseej for Technology Co.
Description: Naseej for Technology Co. provides digital transformation solutions and services in learning and knowledge management. The company offers internet electronic communications maintenance of computer devices and network services. It also retails library and office furniture. In addition the company provides education portfolio solutions comprising of campus and learning management student information system and talent management solutions; data management and analytics enterprise portal development and business process automation. Further it offers library management museums and archives management knowledge management information resources smart and robotics solutions. Naseej for Technology Co. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Israel Petrochemical Enterprises Ltd.
Description: Israel Petrochemical Enterprises Ltd. together with its subsidiaries operates in the petrochemicals industry in Israel and internationally. The company offers various petroleum products such as gasoline naphtha diesel kerosene fuel oil LPG and bitumen. It also produces raw materials for the plastic industry such as polypropylene and polyethylene; and aromatic material used as fillers for chemical and petrochemical industry. In addition the company leases tankers to transport fuel products. The company serves fuel and gas marketing companies and gas stations. It sells its products through agents and distributors. Israel Petrochemical Enterprises Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv Israel. Israel Petrochemical Enterprises Ltd. is a subsidiary of Alverstone Ltd.

Name: Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E.
Description: Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E. operates as a technology-driven financial services investment company in Egypt. The company offers consumer and structured finance solutions; and IT solution platform services. Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E. incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: York Timber Holdings Limited
Description: York Timber Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the forestry sawmilling plywood wholesale and farming businesses in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Processing Plants Forestry and Fleet Wholesale and Agriculture. It operates sawmills that produces and sells various structural and industrial sawn timber products; and plywood plant that manufactures and sells plywood timber products. The company owns plantations that grows pine and eucalyptus trees; and provides fleet solutions that owns heavy motor vehicles that are used to transport logs.
