In addition it is involved in operating distribution centers that sells timber-related products from the sawmills plywood plants and external suppliers; and owns land with avocados and citrus and macadamias orchards as well as fruit packaging facility. The company was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Sabie South Africa.

Name: Société Tunisienne de Réassurance
Description: Société Tunisienne de Réassurance operates as a reinsurance company in Tunisia Maghreb Arab countries Africa Europe Asia and internationally. It underwrites fire miscellaneous accidents and engineering agricultural risks marine and energy civil liability emerging risks and life insurance; Tunis Retakaful; and decennial liability aviation and marine pool insurances. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A.
Description: Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A. provides port services in Chile. The company operates the Calbuco and Coronel port terminals. It also offers chips and pellet shipment; unloading of coal clinker and bulk-agri food; liquid bulk transfer; hydrocarbons discharge; general cargo services. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Valparaíso Chile. Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A.

Name: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited
Description: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited an investment holding company engages in the food healthcare financial services and property and enterprise development businesses in South Africa Australia Europe and internationally. It operates through two segments Food and Investments. The company offers reinsurance and retrocession intermediary services; healthcare solutions to private and public healthcare sectors; and equity growth capital services to small and medium sized enterprises. It also engages in catching processing and procurement of pilchard sardine anchovy redeye herring lobster horse mackerel squid tuna hake and other deep-sea species as well as Cape hake sole monkfish and kingklip; and packaging of its catch into frozen and chilled seafood. In addition the company owns and manages property funds with a portfolio of properties in the retail convenience sector; and holds interests in a chain of franchised fast-food retail outlets as well as an ice cream manufacturing business. Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Çelik Halat ve Tel Sanayii A.S.
Description: Çelik Halat ve Tel Sanayii A.S. produces and supplies steel wire ropes and wires worldwide. The company offers steel wire ropes such as general purpose ropes plastic coated core wire ropes rotation resistant wire ropes non-rotation resistant wire ropes marine and mining ropes pre-stretched elevator wire ropes fishery and forestry ropes  and oil and gas ropes that are used in the construction maritime fishing oil mining and in elevators chair lifts and cranes. It also provides industrial steel industrial galvanized steel and patented wires for use in the automotive white goods agriculture defense industry furniture and construction sectors. In addition the company offers pre-stressed and post-tensioned bridge beam manufacturing prefabricated building elements ground and mine anchors nuclear power plants silo construction and residential and commercial building construction sectors. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Izmit Turkey. Çelik Halat ve Tel Sanayii A.S. is a subsidiary of Artas Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Raydan Food Company
Description: Raydan Food Company operates and franchises restaurants in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Traditional Meals Catering Services and Other segments. The company also provides catering services; and invests in real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Raydan Company. Raydan Food Company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Jeddah Saudi Arabia.

Name: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc
Description: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc operates as a securities exchange in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers a platform that assists companies in raising capital through the issuance of equities and debt securities; and securities market to investors who intend to invest in the listed companies. Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Paper Home Company
Description: Paper Home Company engages in manufacture and sale of corrugated cardboard products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers point-of-sale displays die cut boxes wrap-around boxes trays regular slotted containers jumbo boxes half slotted containers mill run sheers and dividers and pads; and C B E BC and BE corrugated flutes. It also manufactures folded or single bags made of paper or corrugated cardboard; and molds strips and filter films from paper pulp. The company serves poultry industrial material fashion delivery retail and other sectors and industries as well as producers of bottled water. Paper Home Company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: abc S.A.
Description: abc S.A. operates a chain of department stores in Chile. The company's stores provide clothing footwear beauty sports children's electronics technology and household items under the La Polar name as well as operates online stores. It also offers financial retail services including credit cards such as La Polar Card and La Polar Visa Card as well as insurance products and services. The company was formerly known as Empresas La Polar S.A. and changed its name to abc S.A. in July 2024. abc S.A. was founded in 1920 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Klimasan Klima Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Klimasan Klima Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of refrigeration products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers beverage coolers such as counter tops back bars; single double triple horizontal and sub zero coolers; supermarket cabinets freezers and wine coolers under the Metalfrio Klimasan and Senocak brand names. It serves beverage ice cream and food service/retail sector. Klimasan Klima Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1915 and is based in Manisa Turkey.

Name: Dinamik Isi Makina Yalitim Malzemeleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Dinamik Isi Makina Yalitim Malzemeleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic tubes pipes hoses and their fittings in Turkey. The company offers insulation products such as NPE-polyethylene products rubber crosslinked polyethylene sheets valve jackets glass wool rockwool ceramic wool acoustic and sound insulation and auxiliary products; and HVAC products including ventilation elements fans flexible air ducts anemostat and louver connector flow adjustment damper and auxiliary products. It also provides packaging products comprising packaging profiles corner protectors mattresses sheets special design products and entertainment and sports products; industrial foam products; and furniture forming products including high and low-density flooring profiles and high-density flooring wicks. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Consus Enerji Isletmeciligi ve Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Consus Enerji Isletmeciligi ve Hizmetleri A.S. operates as an energy service company in Turkey. It operates biomass power plants with a total installed capacity of 29.2 MW; and cogeneration trigeneration and solar plants totaling 54.1 MW. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Consus Enerji Isletmeciligi ve Hizmetleri A.S. is a subsidiary of Global Yatirim Holding A.S.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Anatolia Tani ve Biyoteknoloji Ürünleri Ar-Ge Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Anatolia Tani ve Biyoteknoloji Ürünleri Ar-Ge Sanayi Ticaret A.S. a biotechnology company engages in the design development and manufacture of real-time PCR kits nucleic acid extraction kits and automated nucleic acid extraction instruments in Turkey. It offers microbiology genetic disorder panel sequencing and food testing kits; and manual spin column and magnetic bead nucleic acid extraction kits and automated NA extraction instrument kits. Anatolia Tani ve Biyoteknoloji Ürünleri Ar-Ge Sanayi Ticaret A.S. is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Lider Faktoring A.S.
Description: Lider Faktoring A.S. a factoring company provides various financing solutions industrial and commercial companies in Turkey. It offers factoring and asset management services; and collection and financing services for tracking of receivables. The company was formerly known as Lider Faktoring Hizmetleri A.S. and changed its name to Lider Faktoring A.S. in July 2013. Lider Faktoring A.S. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Vera Konsept Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Vera Konsept Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi engages in development and management of housing projects. The company was founded in 2018 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Innosa Teknoloji A.S.
Description: Innosa Teknoloji A.S. operates in the paint and hardware markets in Turkey. The company produces and distributes PPG architectural coatings potassium silicate based mineral paints wood protection paints and varnishes water repellents anti-graffiti products color enhancers floor protectors concrete and wooden floor and surface cleaners metal varnishes insulation materials powder paints paint covers silicones brush and roller group products and spray paints. The company also offers iron oxide powder coatings sanders protective coverings insulation materials marine and yacht paints toxic dyes gilding paints wallpaper glues optima glues technological paint application systems construction paints and isolation materials. It markets and sells its products under the Beeck Beeck SP Plus Bondex Green Lacquer Pozzi-Colors Nu-Guard AG Incralac Historical Artifact Cleaning and Aries brands. The company was formerly known as Uzertas Boya Sanayi Ticaret ve Yatirim A.S. and changed its name to Innosa Teknoloji A.S. in April 2024. Innosa Teknoloji A.S. was founded in 1894 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Innosa Teknoloji A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Innosa Teknoloji A.S.

Name: Shalfa Facilities Management Company
Description: Shalfa Facilities Management Company provides operation and maintenance facility management security and firefighting and environmental services to public and private organizations. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: ARAM Group Company P.J.S.C.
Description: ARAM Group Company P.J.S.C. engages in the investment and leasing of real estate properties in the United Arab Emirates. It also engages in investing in financial instruments; investing and managing agricultural industrial and commercial projects; and general trading and contracting; and purchase and sale of shares and bonds. The company was formerly known as Sharjah Group Company P.J.S.C. and changed its name to Aram Group Company P.J.S.C. in November 2021. ARAM Group Company P.J.S.C. was founded in 1976 and is based in Sharjah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Matriks Finansal Teknolojiler A.S.
Description: Matriks Finansal Teknolojiler A.S. produces and sells software and hardware and offers consultancy services for broadcasting and transmitting data in financial markets to third parties and institutions. It offers data of financial markets in real time with analysis and transaction possibilities; presentation of news explanations and reports concerning the markets; trading platforms; order and risk management systems; mobile apps; smart data solutions; commodity trading and data tools; artificial intelligence supported analysis and trading platforms for energy markets; and HFT and algorithmic trading platforms. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Selçuk Gida Endüstri Ihracat Ithalat A.S.
Description: Selçuk Gida Endüstri Ihracat Ithalat A.S. produces and sells dried fruits in Turkey. It offers dried figs raisins apricots mulberries and cherries; and energy balls and energy discs under the EAGLE brand and various private labels through hyper-supermarkets and discount chains. The company also exports its products to approximately 30 countries. Selçuk Gida Endüstri Ihracat Ithalat A.S. was founded in 1932 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: BENA Steel Industries
Description: BENA Steel Industries manufactures and sells steel products. The company is involved in the production of galvanized metal sheets ribbed and non-ribbed metal structures and sheets ribbed and non-ribbed aluminum sheets chromed metal sheets electro plated steel silicon steel and aluminum pre-painted corrugated steel sheets as well as pipes and tubes and wheelbarrows. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Payment Financial Technologies Ltd
Description: Payment Financial Technologies Ltd. operates a payment platform in Israel. Its platform sells retail credit through businesses. Payment Financial Technologies Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Omer Israel.

Name: Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I.
Description: Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. manufactures and sells food products in Argentina. It offers biscuits oils and dressings olives oatmeal frozen products mini cracker cookies flour legumes corn breadcrumbs butter and mashed potatoes. The company was formerly known as Francisco Morixe e Hijos Sociedad Colectiva and changed its name to Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. in 1914. Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. was founded in 1901 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. operates as a subsidiary of Sociedad Comercial del Plata S.A.

Name: The Arab Drug Company
Description: The Arab Drug Company engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. It offers anti-infectives central nervous system drugs dermatological drugs and cardiovascular drugs as well as animal health products in powders and solutions. The company exports its products to approximately 40 countries including China Korea Turkey Kazakhstan Iraq Syria Jordan Lebanon Libya Sudan Somalia Yemen and Morocco. The Arab Drug Company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Park Elektrik Üretim Madencilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Park Elektrik Üretim Madencilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. through its subsidiary Konya Ilgın Elektrik Üretim Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. generates and sells electricity in Turkey. It focuses on establishing a thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 500MW in the Ilgın District Konya. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Park Elektrik Üretim Madencilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Park Holding A.S.

Name: Koleksiyon Mobilya Sanayi A.S.
Description: Koleksiyon Mobilya Sanayi A.S. designs manufactures and sells home and office furniture products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers poufs sideboards cabinets coffee tables sofas and armchairs nightstands and dressers buffets chairs and tools tables group desks book cases and shelfs working cabinets TV units dining tables dividers and screens work stations and accessories as well as storage bedroom furniture lighting and home textile products. Its products are used in public spaces corporate education finance health IT and communication residential tourism and other sectors. Koleksiyon Mobilya Sanayi A.S. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: B-Gaming S.A.
Description: B-Gaming S.A. develops technological solutions for capturing communicating validating and processing large volumes of information. The company also installs security computer centers communication networks and equipment VSAT antennas online and mobile lottery terminals printers and other supplies. In addition it develops communication and transaction management software. The company was formerly known as Boldt Gaming S.A. and changed its name to B-Gaming S.A. in February 2018. B-Gaming S.A. was incorporated in 1934 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: E-Data Teknoloji Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
Description: E-Data Teknoloji Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi engages in the distribution of technology products and solutions to institutions and organizations in Turkey. It offers network products printing solutions cyber security products server-storage products data center infrastructure products and other hardware and software solutions. The company also provides technical consultancy installation and other pre- and post-sales services. It offers its solutions to telecommunication finance insurance manufacturing health education entertainment and other industries as well as in SMB market. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Kafr El Zayat For Pesticides & Chemicals Co.(S.A.E)
Description: Kafr El Zayat For Pesticides & Chemicals Co.(S.A.E) operates in the pesticides and chemicals industry in Egypt Africa and the Middle East. The company offers insecticides fungicides herbicides nematicides and mineral oils. It also provides fertilizers bioinsecticides biofungicides and organic fertilizers as well as pest control services. In addition the company offers products for public health and household applications. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Kafr Al-Zaiyat Egypt.

Name: Alphaville S.A.
Description: Alphaville S.A. engages in residential subdivision business under the Alphaville brand in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Private Equity AE Investimentos e Participações S.A. Alphaville S.A. was founded in 1973 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd
Description: Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd engages in the investment real estate and urban renewal business in Israel. The company was formerly known as Cannomed Medical Cannabis Industries Ltd and changed its name to Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd in January 2023. Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: Ege Seramik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ege Seramik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells ceramic floor and wall tiles worldwide. The company also provides glazed porcelain. Its products are used in domestic spaces home outdoors and commercial/heavy use applications. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Kemalpasa Turkey. Ege Seramik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Ibrahim Polat Holding A.S.

Name: United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E.
Description: United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E. operates as a real estate developer in Egypt. The company buys sells and divides land as well as prepares and supplies land with utilities and services. It also invests in infrastructure foods dairy products and water treatment as well as real estate investment. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt. United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.)

Name: Özsu Balik Üretim Anonim Sirketi
Description: Özsu Balik Üretim Anonim Sirketi operates as a food company in Turkey and internationally. It produces and sells sea bream and sea bass fish products. Özsu Balik Üretim Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo
Description: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo engages in publishing business in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through High Performance Fibers Editorial and Real Estate segments. It offers editorial and children's and educational title books. The company engages in developing and managing forests through pines and eucalyptus plantation activities. In addition it is involved in the production of cellulose fibers and other pulps for paper fibers used in the carton tissue specialty papers carpets and packaging. The company is involved in buying developing constructing managing selling and rental as well as sub-division of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo Ind. de Papel and changed its name to Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo in August 1994. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Société Maghrébine de Monétique
Description: Société Maghrébine de Monétique engages in the development integration and maintenance of electronic-payment solutions in Morocco and internationally. It offers payment solutions such as merchant solutions payment gateways payment channel management issuing cards risk and fraud management prepaid and loan management as well as payment activity management.; e-wallets and mobile banking and payment services; outsourcing services that includes turnkey service and fraud detection and prevention system. The company also provides card personalization and instant issuing BNPL Islamic payment management tokenization 3D Secure-ACS solution multi-currency card cashback program soft POS solutions instant payment and agency banking. It serves financial institutions mobile network and money transfer operators oil companies aggregators/billers and universities as well as e-gov retail and insurance sectors. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Société Maghrébine de Monétique operates as a subsidiary of SA MEDTECH.

Name: Rawasi Albina Investment Co.
Description: Rawasi Albina Investment Co. provides infrastructure works for telecom electricity and water projects in Saudi Arabia. It offers GSM civil new sites relocation and dismantle IBS installation FTTH/OSP power project operation and maintenance telecom implementation and rehabilitation project services as well as supplies materials. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: VFD Group PLC
Description: VFD Group PLC a proprietary investment company provides alternative funding and investment channels accessible to individuals small businesses and operators in Nigeria and Ghana. The company engages in microfinance banking investment and fund management issuing house and investment adviser stock and insurance brokerage auto and financial leasing real estate and hospitality development logistics and haulage lending and technology IT infrastructure development digital product development building construction services comfort-food style restaurant relaxation leisure and homestyle cooking’s activities. It offers its services to the financial services capital market technology security services banking remittance real estate and hospitality leasing media and entertainment infrastructure and energy sectors. VFD Group PLC was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Infracommerce CXaaS S.A.
Description: Infracommerce CXaaS S.A. provides digital solutions for various brands and industries in Brazil Mexico Colombia Peru Chile Argentina Uruguay and Latin America. It offers e-commerce platforms for Business to Consumer and Business to Business e-commerce operation services. The company operates infra.digital infra.shop infra.data infra.pay and infra.log. It also provides omnichannel technology used in artificial and data intelligence payment and credit solutions and logistics. Infracommerce CXaaS S.A. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Kristal Kola ve Mesrubat Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kristal Kola ve Mesrubat Sanayi Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of soft drinks in Turkey and internationally. It offers sodad beverages spring water non-coggated beverages mineral water energy drink and balsa soda. The company distributes and markets its products through distributor companies and dealers under the Kristal COLA CHAT COLA HOT LINE Kristal Balsa and Rival brand names. Kristal Kola ve Mesrubat Sanayi Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1994 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Enterprise Group PLC
Description: Enterprise Group PLC through its subsidiaries provides insurance services in Ghana Nigeria and the Gambia. It operates through the Non-Life Insurance Business Life Assurance Business Health Insurance Pension Administration Real Estate Funeral Services and Investments segments. The company offers personal insurance products including pet home advantage third party amplified compExtra enhanced motor comprehensive policy motor home travel and personal accident; and corporate insurance products including assets all risk employers liability erection all risk fidelity guarantee product liability electronic equipment consequential loss or business interruption professional indemnity marine public liability money motor household content contractors-all-risk custom bonds goods-in-transit burglary cash in transit fire and allied perils group personal accident and special risk insurance solutions. Name: Inversiones Tricahue S.A.
Description: Inversiones Tricahue S.A. operates as an investment company in Chile. It acquires and sells shares of Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche SA. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Tarya Israel Ltd
Description: Tarya Israel Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates an internet platform in Israel. Its platform provides brokerage services between borrowers and lenders. The company is also involved in granting of credit activities. Tarya Israel Ltd was founded in 2014 and is based in Ros Ha'ayin Israel.

Name: Santova Limited
Description: Santova Limited provides logistics services in Africa the Asia Pacific Europe North America and the United Kingdom. The company operates through Logistics Services and Financial Services segments. It provides international trade services including supply chain engineering logistics global project management client sourcing and procurement express courier and financial services; and development implementation analysis management and supply chain optimization services through cloud-based technologies and software packages. The company also offers business intelligence solutions that enables digital transformation through cloud-based technologies to unlock data for analysis or predictive analytics; insurance solutions; and value add services that delivers a range of tailor-made services and solutions. Santova Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: Automated Systems Company - KPSC
Description: Automated Systems Company - KPSC provides IT infrastructure and software solutions in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Services and Solutions Investments and Training Services segments. The Services and Solutions segment engages in consulting implementing upgrading and managing applications in the areas of enterprise resource planning and customer relationship management; and managing projects and human capital outsourcing as well as sells software. The Investments segment invests in local equity funds and shares as well as funds managed by portfolio managers. The Training Services segment offers training services under the franchise agreement with the franchisor. The company’s IT infrastructure solutions comprise data center infrastructure network infrastructure and cyber security as well as provides professional services including project implementation solution architecture and design on demand support and annual maintenance contract services. It also offers software solutions including infrastructure and engineering software solutions; and student and learning management systems. In addition the company provides healthcare information system solutions such as PANMEDICA a solution for medium and large size hospitals with inpatient facilities; PANLAB a system that handles the issue of maintenance and printing of various lab reports; PANPHARMA a system for pharmacies; and PANCLINICA a system for polyclinics and medical centers as well as trades in automation equipment and secondment of staff. Further it offers services and solutions to government/semi-government oil and gas banking and finance telecommunications education and training healthcare engineering construction retail and logistics and travel industries. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Automated Systems Company - KPSC is a subsidiary of Kuwait Airways Company K.S.C.

Name: Mayberry Group Limited
Description: Mayberry Group Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services and products to corporations financial institutions governments and individuals. The company offers strategic financial advisory; mergers and acquisition; debt and equity restructuring; investment management; brokerage; and cambio and research services. It is also involved in the equity and securities trading business; and managing equity portfolio pension funds and foreign exchange cambio as well as invests in unquoted securities. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: Brand Group (M.G) Ltd
Description: Brand Group (M.G) Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in metal construction and infrastructure energy facilities petrochemical facilities and other industrial facilities in Israel. The company constructs large industrial plants high-rise steel buildings public buildings residential buildings and commercial and business buildings; supply assemblies to stations for producing electrical power with coal gas and other technologies; provides construction for transport and infrastructure made of steel; and produce steel accumulators and containers of different sizes and bodies. The company was formerly known as Brand Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Brand Group (M.G) Ltd in November 2021. Brand Group (M.G) Ltd was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Yeruham Israel.

Name: Escort Teknoloji Yatirim A.S.
Description: Escort Teknoloji Yatirim A.S. provides technology-based products solutions and services in Turkey and internationally. The company develops mobile and computer games and application software; develops safe driving and accident prevention system for mobile platforms; creates an operating system to combat climate change and sustainability under the Ekofoni brand; operates online sports and sports facilities and trainers; operates cosmetic laboratories; develops software for financial technologies; operates blockchain technology platform; and produces solar-based renewable energy. In addition the company produces nickel-based cathodes for secondary batteries and develops software for use in battery materials as well as engages in venture investment activities. Escort Teknoloji Yatirim A.S. was founded in 1991 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

It offers Q JectUltra an insulin syringe serving as a tool in diabetic care; Q Flow for infusion therapy; Q Need a single use hypodermic needle; Q Ject a single use syringe for the curative medications; and Q Safe a re-use prevention syringe. The company also trades in medical consumables equipment tools and supplies and furniture. In addition it provides healthcare training. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Description: Trafco Group B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries trades in food products primarily in the Kingdom of Bahrain and other Gulf Cooperation Council countries. The company operates through six segments: Wholesale Operations; Investments; Dairy Products and Beverages; Fruits and Vegetables; Storage and Logistics; and Livestock. It engages in the production bottling and marketing of sweet drinking water and beverages under the TYLOS Selsabil MARWA and Cloud9 brands; import and distribution of canned frozen and dry and nonfood products as well as general commodities eggs livestock and chilled and frozen meat; provision of storage and logistics services; and trading of fresh fruits and vegetables and other food products. The company also produces and supplies fruit juice and drinks and fresh milk under the Noor brand; UHT milk under the Awal brand; and ice creams under the Fabion brand. In addition it provides bananas; and produces and supplies tomato paste. Further the company invests in quoted and unquoted securities; trades in potato chips; and operates a chain of supermarkets. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Inter Gamma Investment Company Ltd
Description: Inter Gamma Investment Company Ltd through its subsidiaries operates in the real-estate sectors worldwide. It owns operates markets and leases portfolio of real estate assets such as industry commerce offices industry crafts parking lots storage and logistics. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Herzliya Pituach Israel.

Name: Arab Developers Holding
Description: Arab Developers Holding engages in the planning investment development and operation of real estate properties in Egypt the Middle East and North Africa. It develops mixed-use and family oriented destinations as well as mansions villas and serviced apartments; and operates hotels shopping malls and restaurants as well as Golf courses. The company was formerly known as Porto Group Holding SAE and changed its name to Arab Developers Holding in February 2022. Arab Developers Holding was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Fujairah Cement Industries PJSC
Description: Fujairah Cement Industries PJSC together with its subsidiary manufactures and sells clinkers and hydraulic cement and ready mixed and dry mix concrete and mortars in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. It also offers sand and pebble as well as crusher services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Fujairah the United Arab Emirates.

Name: Agrometal S.A.I.

The company provides coarse grain planters comprising TX MEGA GEN 3 TX PIVOT 2 and APX SEED PRO; ADX and FX fine grain planters; and ADX Magna and MX Max multipurpose planters as well as DX Pro multi-seed meters TWIN FORCE double chamber actuator and monitors for planting security of crops. Name: Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries provides food catering services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Investment Trading and Food Catering segments. The company provides computer programming and operations general trading consultancy and food catering services as well as engages in the utilization of franchising and property ownership and investment activities. Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Hulamin Limited
Description: Hulamin Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of rolled and extruded aluminum products in South Africa North America Europe Asia the Middle East Australasia South America and rest of Africa. The company operates through two segments Hulamin Rolled Products and Hulamin Extrusions. The Hulamin Rolled Products segment offers aluminum sheets plates and foil products. This segment also manufactures and supplies fabricated and rolled semi-finished aluminum products as well as aluminum foil containers and related products. The Hulamin Extrusions segment manufactures and supplies extruded aluminum products. It serves automotive building electrical general engineering packaging renewable energy and transport industries. The company was formerly known as Hulett Aluminium (Pty) Limited and changed its name to Hulamin Limited in 2007. Hulamin Limited was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Pietermaritzburg South Africa.

Name: G.F.C Green Fields Capital Ltd.
Description: G.F.C Green Fields Capital Ltd. does not have significant operations. The company focuses on searching for real investments. Previously it was involved in developing plant traits for the agriculture and biofuel industries. The company was formerly known as Rosetta Green Ltd. and changed its name to G.F.C Green Fields Capital Ltd. in September 2013. G.F.C Green Fields Capital Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Bnei Brak Israel.

Name: Manas Enerji Yonetimi Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Manas Enerji Yonetimi Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the development of smart metering systems and solutions in Turkey. It offers electro-controlled gas water heat and electricity meters for municipalities water administrations and gas and electricity distribution companies as well as private and public institutions. The company also provides gas regulators network and communication products as well as software solutions. In addition it offers information systems programming and software and consultancy services to defense industry sector. Manas Enerji Yonetimi Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Sincan Turkey.

Name: Euro-Cycles S.A
Description: Euro-Cycles S.A manufactures assembles and sells two-wheeled cycles in Tunisia. It offers kids mountain road BMX/trick commuting folding and electric bikes as well as beach cruisers. The company also provides frames and works welding hubs with phosphating complete line rims production hubs saddles production and assembling hubs powder painting hubs and wheels semi-automatic assembly hubs. It exports its products to various European countries including the United Kingdom Germany Italy the Netherlands Denmark Greece France and Spain. Euro-Cycles S.A was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Sousse Tunisia.

Name: Birman Wood & Hardware Ltd
Description: Birman Wood & Hardware Ltd imports produces and markets wood panels hardware products kitchen electrical appliances and laminate flooring parquets. The company provides wood products such as plywood MDF chipboard hardboard flexboard pine edge glued panel panel for construction and decoration solid lumber and light weight panel products as well as designs various products with special overlays. It also imports and markets professional and decorative hardware products for furniture branches. The company imports fabricates and installs products made of solid surface such as kitchen tops bathrooms and sinks and projects in the healthcare food and offices sectors; and supplies kitchen electric appliances such as refrigerators ovens hobs cooker hoods coffee machines and dishwashers under the Fulgor Milano Bellini and Best brands. It operates in Israel the Palestinian Authority and Gaza. Birman Wood & Hardware Ltd was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tiberias Israel.

Name: Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P. engages in takaful insurance investment and car rental businesses in Kuwait. Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Name: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc
Description: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc operates as a derivatives exchange of Kenya. The company operates through two segments Cash Equities and Interest Rate Market and Derivatives Market. It offers equities bonds exchange traded funds real estate investment trusts derivatives data and training services as well as operates a digital academy. The company also provides a platform for the issuance holding trading and settlement of securities of unquoted companies under the Unquoted Securities Platform name; and Ibuka an incubation and acceleration program to support companies to reach their next stage of growth. In addition it offers clearing and settlement services for transactions in derivative securities whether carried out on or off a securities exchange as well as engages in mobile and online trading. The company was incorporated in 1921 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Frigo-Pak Gida Maddeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Frigo-Pak Gida Maddeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells frozen and canned fruit vegetable juice fruit juice fruit and vegetable purees and tomato pastes in Turkey. It offers apple orange cherry mango tomato pineapple pomegranate and black grape juices under the Sunpride brand as well as carbonated beverages such as soft drinks colas and sodas. The company also provides frozen fruits and vegetables including blackberry raspberry strawberry sour cherry black cherry pomegranate orange grapefruit mandarin orange peel plum fig pepper and roasted eggplant; canned foods such as mandarin grapefruit orange black cherry pomegranate sour cherry plum and strawberry; and fruit and vegetable purees including pastes and sauces. The company also exports its products to approximately 30 countries including Germany England France the United States and Japan. Frigo-Pak Gida Maddeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Senkron Siber Güvenlik Yazilim ve Bilisim Cözümleri A.S.
Description: Senkron Siber Güvenlik Yazilim ve Bilisim Cözümleri A.S. operates as an electronic security systems integrator in Turkey and internationally. Name: Sumas Suni Tahta ve Mobilya Sanayi A.S.
Description: Sumas Suni Tahta ve Mobilya Sanayi A.S. produces and sells chipboards in Turkey. The company offers OSB wood sheets OSB firetex pellets and glue. Sumas Suni Tahta ve Mobilya Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Balikesir Turkey.

Name: Amanet Management & Systems Ltd.
Description: Amanet Management & Systems Ltd. through its subsidiaries operates as a multidisciplinary systems house in Israel. The company also provides logistics management IT consulting outsourcing and managed Offshore / Nearshore center ERP system and quality assurance and software testing services; technological and methodological services in the fields of testing quality and automation; and end-to-end management solutions (E2E) in the areas of managing the organization and related systems such as initiation planning implementation and even outsourcing. Name: Jordan Loan Guarantee Corp.

Name: Rekah Pharmaceutical Industry Ltd.

Name: PBT Group Limited
Description: PBT Group Limited together with its subsidiaries provides consulting services to finance insurance medical healthcare retail telecommunication and other sectors in South Africa Europe Australia and the United Kingdom. In addition the company offers software development digital web and mobile application development software testing and cloud computing solutions. PBT Group Limited was founded in 1998 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Euro Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: Euro Yatirim Holding A.S. offers financial services in Turkey. The company also provides portfolio management services to individuals and corporates. Euro Yatirim Holding A.S. was founded in 1996 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Global Knafaim Leasing Ltd
Description: Global Knafaim Leasing Ltd an aviation company acquires leases and trades in used commercial aircraft. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel. Global Knafaim Leasing Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Knafaim Holdings Ltd.

Name: Dalqan Real Estate Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Dalqan Real Estate Company K.S.C. (Public) engages in the real estate activities in Kuwait and internationally. It invests in and develops real estate properties. Name: Plastikkart Akilli Kart Iletisim Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E
Description: Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E engages in manufacturing and packaging solid and liquid fertilizers in Egypt. It also trades in fertilizers agricultural chemicals agricultural crops and related raw materials; and manufactures and trades fodder and related raw materials seeds agricultural seeds and compound fertilizers. Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Riyal Investment and Development Company
Description: Riyal Investment and Development Company operates as a car rental company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also leases vehicles including sedans trucks SUVs vans and buses. In addition the company provides vehicles with drivers; mobile van and petromin services; services for oil filter and other regular maintenance; and other services such as roll over bar GPS tracking system and fixing cooling system. Name: Raya Customer Experience
Description: Raya Customer Experience operates as a business process outsourcing (BPO) and contact center outsourcing company. It offers CX management solutions including customer services technical support collections cross selling and upselling customer acquisition customer retention back office and CX advisory services. The company also provides digital solutions such as robotic process automation data analytics omnichannel and Al- chatbots; call central seat rental solutions; and human resources outsourcing services. The company serves retail and ecommerce automotive banking services FMCG games healthcare travel and leisure white goods media and communication and government service industries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Raya Customer Experience is a subsidiary of Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E).

Name: Lachish Industries Ltd
Description: Lachish Industries Ltd engages in the development manufacturing and marketing of various food mixers for the dairy farming and feedlot industry in Israel and internationally. It offers self-propelled and stationary mixers vertical trailers and delivery trucks. The company also provides spare parts. In addition it sells its products through distributors and dealers under the RMH brand. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Sderot Israel.

Name: General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited
Description: General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited a general insurance company provides underwriting services for commercial personal property and casualty insurance products in Jamaica Trinidad and Tobago and Barbados. It operates through Motor; Fire and Allied Perils; Marine; Liability; Engineering and Machinery Breakdown; and Miscellaneous Accidents segments. Description: Dhofar Food & Investment SAOG together with its subsidiaries primarily engages in the production and packaging of dairy products in the Sultanate of Oman and internationally. It offers fresh and long-life dairy juices mineral water products soft drinks energy drinks and food products. The company is also involved in the rearing cattle for beef meat; milling and sale of animal feed from various raw materials; growing of grass; sale of plastic products; and poultry livestock hatching growing processing and selling activities. In addition it trades in equity investments and invests in private equity; and manufactures and sells vegetable oils. The company was formerly known as Dhofar Cattle Feed Company SAOG and changed its name to Dhofar Food & Investment SAOG in October 2022. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salalah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: General Investment Co. Ltd.
Description: General Investment Co. Ltd. manufactures and sells alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks in Jordan and internationally. The company invests in financial assets and real estate buildings. It is also involved in the rental of real estate properties. The company offers its products through off-trade on-trade and duty-free outlets as well as e-commerce platform. It exports its products to Iraq Palestine and Syria. General Investment Co. Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Razor Labs
Description: Razor Labs operates in the artificial intelligence (AI) industry in Israel Australia and internationally. It offers DataMind AI an Software as a Service (SaaS) solution that provides actionable insights by analyzing various operational states of fixed and mobile assets unscheduled operational downtime and predicts malfunctions in mining industry; and Enterprise AI an customized solution for solving organizational problems for organizations as well as industrial organizations. Description: Macro Group Pharmaceuticals (Macro Capital) S.A.E operates as a cosmeceuticals manufacturing company in Egypt and internationally. Name: Synel M.L.L Payway Ltd
Description: Synel M.L.L Payway Ltd together with its subsidiaries provides software integrated hardware solutions for workforce management in organizations in Israel and internationally. It offers workforce management solutions including time and attendance management system job costing shift scheduling absence management and smartphone application solutions as well as dashboard reports and analysis and biometric attendance hardware solutions. The company also provides security solutions such as access control visitor management muster and fire roll dashboard automatic number plate registration and CCTV and intercom solutions. In addition it offers biometric time and attendance hardware; and biometric access control hardware including fingerprint recognition and smartcard access control devices. Further the company provides training and professional and technological consulting services for payroll controller and labor law topics. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Yokne'am Israel.

Name: CalBank PLC
Description: CalBank PLC provides various banking products and services in Ghana. It operates through Corporate Banking; Retail & Business Banking; Treasury; and Asset Management segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers loans and other credit facilities as well as deposits and other transactions and balances to corporate clients institutional clients and public sector entities. This segment also provides corporate finance mergers and acquisitions advice specialized financial advice and custody services. The Retail & Business Banking segment provides loans and overdrafts as well as handles the deposits and other transactions such as funds transfers standing orders and ATM card services for small and medium enterprises and individual customers. The Treasury segment invests in liquid assets including short-term placements and government debt securities as well as trades in foreign currencies. The Asset Management segment offers asset management investment portfolio management cash management money management and other investment advisory services to institutional investors businesses and high net worth individuals; and manages mutual funds. The company holds and administers securities and other assets as a custodian; and manages pension funds on behalf of beneficial owners. CalBank PLC was founded in 1990 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: National Investment Company Limited
Description: National Investment Company Limited engages in the investment in shares of listed and unlisted companies government securities corporate bonds and other financial instruments. It also establishes and manages business enterprises in manufacturing financial services real estate telecommunications agriculture mining and other service sectors. In addition the company is involved in real estate investment including the acquisition development and management of commercial properties student hostels and shopping malls. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Penguen Gida Sanayi A.S.
Description: Penguen Gida Sanayi A.S. engages in the production and sale of fruit and vegetable products in Turkey. The company’s products include jam preserved vegetables ready meals preserved boiled legumes tomato and pepper pastes pickles sauces and pastes roasted products fruit preserves and frozen vegetables and fruits. It offers its products to national and local market chains and middle-sized retailers as well as mass consumption channels such as hotels restaurants and cafeterias. The company exports its products to approximately 35 countries including Germany the United States France the Netherlands Switzerland Russia and Sweden. Penguen Gida Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Bursa Turkey.

Name: Pulse Investments Limited
Description: Pulse Investments Limited engages in the development and production of media content model agency representation and live show production businesses in Jamaica and internationally. The company is also involved in the sub-letting of leasehold properties; property development; and hospitality and leisure activities. It owns and operates studio filming and editing facilities as well as shoot locations; and sells its TV shows to cable television stations free-to-air television stations and internet broadcasters. Further the company engages in development of real estate holdings which includes construction of residences. Pulse Investments Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Nextcom Ltd.
Description: Nextcom Ltd. operates in the communications infrastructure and renewable energy sectors in Israel and internationally. It engages in the installation of multi-channel TV over cable/satellite/IPTV high speed internet wired and wireless computer networks VOIP telephony telephone switchboards closed circuit TV cameras IP and SDH communications lines and PRI circuits; and provision of underground infrastructures and laying of fiber optic cables. The company also offers various turnkey solutions; wired and wireless data systems information security and IP telephony solutions security cameras unified communications and monitoring and control systems; data infrastructure wireless network access network and multimedia solutions; and smart home intercom wired and wireless internet solutions computer systems and cloud services. In addition it is involved in the planning construction operational and maintenance services for solar energy wind energy and bio-gas facility projects; and conversion distribution and transport of natural gas. Further the company engages in the planning and implementation of water sewage and drainage infrastructure; landscape development; laying roads; and planning erecting managing and maintaining low and high voltage electrical systems. It serves telecom cable public transportation public and private defense and high-tech companies as well as municipal authorities and entities government bodies construction and civil engineering sectors and institutions. Nextcom Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Jezreel Valley Israel.

Name: Middle Egypt Flour Mills
Description: Middle Egypt Flour Mills manufactures stores fumigates maintains packages prepares distributes transports trades in and exports grains in Israel. The company also offers bakery products slurries food products feeds and yeast; packaging and packing supplies; and capital equipment and spare parts. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Minya Egypt. Middle Egypt Flour Mills is a subsidiary of Food Industries Holding Company SAE.

The company also offers ready meals ketchup soy sauce liquid dressings sweet sauces pastry sugar cinnamon powder baking soda grated coconut pastry flavorings and salts for industry. The company was founded in 1901 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Compañía Introductora de Buenos Aires S.A. is a subsidiary of F V Sociedad Anonima.

Description: Ad-Dulayl Industrial Park & Real Estate Company P.L.C develops and manages industrial estates/zones in the Kingdom of Jordan. The company builds factories warehouses and dormitories. It also leases and sells various plots. In addition the company offers infrastructure and utilities support services. Description: Yukselen Celik Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells steel products in Turkey Europe the Middle East North Africa and internationally. In addition the company operates as steel service centre and offers tool steel steel flat plate steel plate and forged steel. Name: Dkhoun National Trading Company
Description: Dkhoun National Trading Company produces and sells Arabic perfumes. It offers body perfumes home fragrances oud oil and wine oud and incense and perfumes under the Dkhoun brand through its online and offline stores. The company is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Finbond Group Limited
Description: Finbond Group Limited operates as a financial services institution. It operates through Deposit and Debt Finance Products Lending Property Investment and Transactional Banking segments. The company offers short-term consumer lending services; transactional banking products; personal banking; overdraft facility; business banking products such as commercial business and small enterprise accounts; business credit services; savings and investment products; online and mobile banking; and secured lending as well as insurance products. It operates through branches in North America and South Africa. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Pretoria the Republic of South Africa.

Name: Aveng Limited
Description: Aveng Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in construction engineering building and contract mining activities in South Africa Australia New Zealand and Pacific Islands Southeast Asia and internationally. It operates through the Infrastructure Building and Mining segments. The company offers civil and structural mechanical and electrical marine pipelines rail and tunneling and underground construction services to transport water and wastewater ports and coastal energy and resources markets. It also provides design consultation and management construction and fit out services to the sport health and science defense education residential commercial retail industrial and infrastructure sectors. In addition the company engages in contract mining operations that include open cut mining shaft sinking and access development and underground mining projects. Aveng Limited was founded in 1889 and is based in Boksburg South Africa.

Name: GSD Denizcilik Gayrimenkul Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Zedur Enerji Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi
Description: Zedur Enerji Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi primarily engages in the production distribution and sale of electricity in Turkey. The company generates electricity through hydroelectric and solar power plants. It is also involved in the provision of construction and contracting services for superstructure and infrastructure projects; and the supply and sale of construction raw materials. The company was formerly known as Utopya Turizm Insaat Isletmecilik Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Zedur Enerji Elektrik Üretim Anonim Sirketi in September 2022. Description: Orad Ltd provides security and perimeter protection safety and fire detection infrastructures electromechanical systems automation communications and control and solar energy systems in Israel and internationally. It offers security solutions comprising perimeter protection and fence closed circuit television and video analysis access control and biometric systems radar and night vision systems intrusion detection systems command and control software video motion detection-based perimeter security systems and drone defense systems. The company also provides fire detection and extinguishing systems smoke management systems fiber optic fire detection systems suction systems and smoke detector systems; and photovoltaic solar energy solutions comprising rooftop solar systems ground solar systems and independent/hybrid solar systems. In addition it undertakes projects including planning operation heating ventilation and air-conditioning for building management systems; and provides services in the fields of industrial control and building automation in various configurations. Orad Ltd was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Holon Israel.

Name: Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG
Description: Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG engages in selling desalinated water in the Sultanate of Oman. The company develops owns and operates the Al Ghubrah independent water plant a seawater reverse osmosis desalination plant with a contracted capacity of 191000 cubic meters per day located in North Ghubrah Muscat Governorate Sultanate of Oman. Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

It offers toilet paper towels napkins box tissues wet towels and cologne under the Premia Lily Senso Select Pufla Terra and Select Nature brand names. Description: Sasini PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in growing processing packing marketing and selling of tea coffee macadamia nuts and avocado in Kenya and internationally. The company is involved in the dairy operations and livestock; commercial milling and marketing of coffee; forestry; value additions of related products; renting of growing land; and the leasing of plant and machinery activities. Sasini PLC was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

It offers fire natural hazard accident medical and marine vehicles cargo during transportation other damage of properties liability of land based vehicles general liability ships ships liability aircraft aircraft liability and life insurance products and services. The company also provides motor home family and critical income protection travel engineering cash workmen’s compensation public and product liability and bankers blanket bond insurance products. Description: Leen Alkhair Trading Company engages in the farming producing and supplying vegetables and fruits in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It also provides meat dairy and poultry products as well as retail of flowers and roses. The company is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

It also engages in promoting and offering financial products and services in the real estate market. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Watlington Waterworks Limited
Description: Watlington Waterworks Limited through its subsidiary Bermuda Waterworks Limited engages in the production and distribution of water in Bermuda. The company operates through Utility Bottled Water and Others divisions. It manufactures and sells bottled water under the Pure Water brand through grocery stores and directly to customers as well as offers piped drinking water for homes businesses hotels cruise ships occasional ships and residents requiring water for specialized equipment; and purifies drinking water. The company also distributes drinking water through a network of underground pipelines to the central and western parishes of Bermuda. In addition it operates retail store for plumbing supplies such as PVC and CPVC pipe and fittings as well as well pumps and accessories water treatment equipment pressure tanks water heaters in- ground covers for supporting heavy wheel loading larger size pipes pipe repair clamps mechanical couplings deep and shallow wells submersible well pumps sump pumps and others; and sells and rents water coolers as well as provides water services. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Koroplast Temizlik Ambalaj Ürünleri Sanayi ve Dis Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Korozo Ambalaj Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi.

Description: Wadi Kom Ombo For Land Reclamation Co. engages in the infrastructure business in Egypt. It also undertakes land reclamation road station and housing works. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Kron Teknoloji A.S.
Description: Kron Teknoloji A.S. provides technology solutions for the operational efficiency and security needs of the corporates in the finance energy healthcare and telecommunications sectors worldwide. It offers Kron PAM a privileged access management suite; Kron PAM Password Vault a centralized password management; Privileged Session Manager that monitors and controls privileged sessions on critical systems; Database Access Manager a single point of access control management for the database layer and secures data access; Privileged Task Automation that provides a single interface to configure the ability of network business flows; Endpoint Privileged Management that allows IT administrators to control and monitor privileged users; User Behavior Analytics which monitors user behavior and sessions; Multi-Factor Authentication that enhances data access security; Unified Access Manager which offers built-in and pre-integrated TACACS+ and RADIUS servers that provide authentication authorization and accounting (AAA) services; and AAA Server & Subscriber Management an authorization authentication and accounting platform. Kron Teknoloji A.S. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Access Financial Services Limited
Description: Access Financial Services Limited provides retail lending services to the micro enterprise sector for personal and business purposes in Jamaica and the United States. The company offers personal loan products to private and public sector employees for school expenses home improvement medical expenses payment of utility bills and motor vehicle purchases and repairs. It also provides business loans to micro small and medium sized businesses operating in the agriculture manufacturing trading and service sectors for working capital support or to facilitate the purchase of fixed assets. In addition the company operates a money services division that offers bill payment services. Access Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Description: Egyptian Transport and Commercial Services Company S.A.E. provides transportation and logistics services in Egypt. It offers sea freight services including consolidation chartering vessels for large shipments direct import and export and other supply chain solutions; land transport; and air freight services comprising direct import and export consolidation and hanging garment containers. It also engages in piggery business. Ellah Lakes Plc was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Benin City Nigeria.

The company engages in the production processing distribution and retailing of beef chicken meat pork fish milk dairy eggs edible oil flour day-old chick and stockfeed products.
