The company also offers medicated shampoos; and sterile products including eye ear and nose drops as well as ear and nose ointments. In addition it exports its products to the Middle East and North Africa region Europe Central Africa and South East Asia. The company was formerly known as Jordan Chemical Laboratory. Beit Jala Pharmaceutical Company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Beit Jala the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Averbuch Formica Center Ltd.
Description: Averbuch Formica Center Ltd. through its subsidiaries produces markets and trades in raw materials for wood and by products and furniture industry in Israel. The company offers wood products including plywood and coated plywood shades and textures hard wood and solid wood medium density fiberboard particle and coated particleboard kits for assembling kitchens kitchen and furniture doors and acoustic ceilings. It also distributes flooring and related equipment such as solid wood parquet three layer and multi-layer wood parquet wooden beams laminated parquet and wall cladding panels. In addition the company engages in real estate activities as well as operates showroom for its customers. Further it serves its products to raw material traders carpenters furniture and kitchen manufacturer and casual customers. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Ramla Israel.

Name: MMC Sanayi Ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S.
Description: MMC Sanayi Ve Ticari Yatirimlar A.S. trades in fruits and vegetables from agricultural products in Turkey. The company also provides domestic and international transportation and agency services; buys sells and rents domestic and international real estate; and imports and exports in the field of pharmaceutical industry. In addition it engages in the marketing and participation investments of all kinds of goods and services using various communication channels in the field of electronic commerce. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Mega Polietilen Köpük Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Mega Polietilen Köpük Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces and sells foam products in Turkey and internationally. It manufactures imports and exports polyethylene foam EVA natural and synthetic rubber plastic materials auxiliary chemicals dyes polyethylene foam rubber and industrial mineral oils. The company also provides slippers shoes artificial and natural leather cloth yarn sole lining sole adhesives polyethylene plates porous foam plates EVA plates and EVA sole products. In addition it produces textiles and textile auxiliary materials including knitted and clothing textile products and manufactures weaves knits and crochets outerwear such as coats jackets trousers suits anoraks raincoats and evening wear. The company serves customers in the footwear promotion textile and related industries. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Adiyaman Turkey.

Name: Hannibal Lease SA
Description: Hannibal Lease SA an independent financial institution provides leasing services to professions one-person businesses and large groups in Tunisia. The company provides passenger and utility vehicles; transport vehicles; construction and construction site machinery; materials and equipment; real estate; and long team rental activities. Hannibal Lease SA was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited
Description: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited develops and manages integrated residential properties in South Africa. It operates in two segments Residential Property Development and Memorial Parks. The Residential Property Development segment engages in mid to high income housing and integrated housing developments. The Memorial Parks segment develops and manages memorial parks as well as provides burial rights and associated burial and maintenance services. It also invests in real estate properties. Calgro M3 Holdings Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa.

Name: Eminis Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Eminis Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic and metal packaging solutions in Turkey and internationally. Its products are used for paint and chemical mineral oil construction chemicals pool chemicals confectionery marmalade and chocolate powder beverage and cosmetics industries. Eminis Ambalaj Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Dilovasi Turkey.

Name: Elspec Engineering Ltd
Description: Elspec Engineering Ltd develops manufactures and markets power quality solutions and services to the industrial commercial and utility sectors worldwide. The company offers metering and protection products such as multi-functional digital fault recorders; energy meters; and hand-held portable and fixed power quality analyzers as well as phasor measurement units. It also provides PQSCADA Sapphire an open programmable platform that offers functionality and performance for data exploration analysis and visualization; and power factor solutions. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Caesarea Israel.

Name: Rainbow Polikarbonat Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Rainbow Polikarbonat Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides polycarbonate polymer plastic and related products. It offers polycarbonate roof panels polycarbonate H and U shape products rainbow 27/200 products and polycarbonate hollow sheets. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Kayseri Türkiye.

Name: Société Tunisienne Industrielle du Papier et du Carton
Description: Société Tunisienne Industrielle du Papier et du Carton operates in the wrapping paper market in Tunisia. The company engages in the production and sale of kraft paper for bags corrugated cardboard fluting paper and testliner papers for industrial cardboard packaging manufacturers. It is also involved in the generation and sale of electricity. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Ben Arous Tunisia.

Name: Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A.
Description: Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in publishing and distribution of newspapers in Peru. The company produces and markets cardboard folding packages self-adhesive labels; printing of magazines catalogs and books. It also engages in multimedia flexographic and video related services. In addition the company is involved in radio broadcasting and telecommunications services including advertising space through various channels. Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A. was founded in 1839 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Ceo Event Medya A.S.
Description: Ceo Event Medya A.S. engages in the event management business in Turkey. It organizes openings seminars symposiums meetings and concerts and campaigns of private or official offices institutions and organizations in various fields and subjects as well as to organize organizations. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Ceo Event Medya A.S. is a subsidiary of Yeni ve Eski Medya Reklam Ajansi A.S.

Name: Attijari Leasing S.A.
Description: Attijari Leasing S.A. engages in the leasing business in Tunisia. The company provides real estate and movable property for professional industrial commercial agricultural fishing and service uses as well as factoring services. It also engages in equipment leasing that includes agriculture material production equipment specific equipment and hardware; and furniture and real estate leasing business for healthcare professionals independent professionals traders and artisans and farmers. Attijari Leasing S.A. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Attijari Leasing S.A. is a subsidiary of Banque Attijari de Tunisie Société anonyme.

Name: Copper 360 Limited
Description: Copper 360 Limited engages in the mining and exploration of copper in South Africa. The company produces copper concentrate from ore. It also holds 70% interest in the Namaqua Copper Belt project covering an area of 19000 hectares located in the O'okiep Copper District South Africa. The company was formerly known as Big Tree Copper Limited and changed its name to Copper 360 Limited in November 2022. Copper 360 Limited is based in Stellenbosch South Africa.

Name: Pergamon Status Dis Ticaret A.S.
Description: Pergamon Status Dis Ticaret A.S. operates as a mediate in the exports and imports of manufacturers in various industry. The company provides export intermediation services; and tax and foreign trade consultancy services related to tax other financial legislations customs foreign exchange export import inward processing factoring and Exim loans in foreign trade. It offers legislation and bulletin services such as changes and developments in tax and other financial legislation and foreign trade legislation; contact meetings and panels; and information sharing services such as information about the seminars panels or conferences. The company was formerly known as Pergamos Dis Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Pergamon Status Dis Ticaret A.S. as a result of its merger with Status Dis Ticaret A.S. in 2005. Pergamon Status Dis Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Fade Gida Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Fade Gida Yatirim Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the food business. The company provides salted/sulphured sun-dried tomatoes; frozen or dried fruits and vegetables; and manages shopping centers. It sells its organic products worldwide. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Thirdeye Systems Ltd
Description: Thirdeye Systems Ltd. engages in the research and development of high-end object recognition algorithms within the thermal spectrum. It also develops solutions that are in service with the Israel Defense Forces and other defense companies. Its products include Chimera a day-and-night system that incorporates an uncooled LWIR thermal imager and HD Day EO camera in a compact lightweight package; Meduza an electro-optical scanning system that is used in drone recognition; Meduza-S an optical radar to add the accuracy for anti-drone system; and Tesseract a solution that upgrades payloads from passive operated observation devices to state-of-the-art drone detection payload by enabling it to detect recognize and track drones in the sky. The company’s products also include GoIR a flexible solution for outdoor extreme activities designed for difficult conditions and supplies thermal image quality; aEYE C2 a solution with state-of-the-art detection and classification AI algorithm; and aEYE a solution that allows drones to perform fully functional patrolling tasks from takeoff to precise landing using autonomous human detection capabilities and cloud-based AI – with Chimera payload. It serves autonomous vehicles maritime protection critical assets counter terrorism border control search and rescue and airport security Industries in Israel and internationally. The company was formerly known as New Horizon Group Ltd. and changed its name to Thirdeye Systems Ltd. in May 2021. Thirdeye Systems Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Netanya Israel.

Name: Ikeja Hotel Plc
Description: Ikeja Hotel Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the operation of hotels and restaurants. It operates through three segments: Rooms Food and Beverage and Other Services. The company is involved in the sale of rooms and rent of office space; and sale of food and beverages through restaurants and bar. It also operates Sheraton Lagos Hotel and Federal Palace Hotels and Casino. In addition the company provides catering and advisory and consultancy services; develops hotel leisure facilities; apartment letting activities; recreational facilities; and operates night clubs and business centre services. The company was formerly known as Properties Development Limited. Ikeja Hotel Plc was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Nur Ink Innovations Ltd
Description: Nur Ink Innovations Ltd engages in the design development and production of water-based pigmented inks for digital inkjet printing applications in Israel. It offers Digital Sol-Gel a water-based pigment inks for digital printing; and white water-based pigment dispersion and functional inks for direct-to-garment direct-to-film direct-to-textile roll-to-roll printing of indoor and outdoor advertising wallpapers plastic based flexible packaging and corrugated carton packaging applications. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Rosh Ha’Ayin Israel.

Name: E.S. Australia Israel Holdings Ltd
Description: E.S. Australia Israel Holdings Ltd engages in the rental business of building areas and maintenance of properties in Israel. It is also involved in the purchase management and execution of investments in the field of real estate including commercial centers and logistics centers. The company was formerly known as Min Hagoren Development Ltd. and changed its name to E.S. Australia Israel Holdings Ltd in July 2021. E.S. Australia Israel Holdings Ltd was founded in 1970 and is based in Ra'anana Israel.

Name: Iz Yatirim Holding A.S.
Description: Iz Yatirim Holding A.S. engages in the agriculture and animal husbandry activities in Turkey. The company also produces milk; trades in industrial chemicals; offers information technology and computer services; and retails automobiles and light motor vehicles. In addition it produces energy; and apple and apple sapling. The company was formerly known as Iz Hayvancilik Tarim ve Gida Sanayi Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Iz Yatirim Holding A.S. in April 2022. Iz Yatirim Holding A.S. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc
Description: Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc provides banking and related services in Tanzania. The company offers savings and current accounts; and credit products comprising microfinance business mortgage working capital consumer and insurance loans. It also provides treasury services such as money and foreign exchange market; ATM and mobile banking services; insurance services including fire motor travel homeowners credit life and assets all risk cover ; and digital agency mobile internet banking and debit card services. The company serves small and medium sized entrepreneurs companies SACCOS institutions such as schools universities hospitals and corporations. Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Brill Shoe Industries Ltd.
Description: Brill Shoe Industries Ltd. together with its subsidiaries designs manufactures imports procures markets and sells footwear and clothing products and fashion accessories in Israel. It offers sandals sneakers boots shoes high heels and flip flops for women men and children. The company operates under the LIGHT & EASY General Gali Caterpillar Hush Puppies Athletics Brill Comfort Lee Cooper Dockers LA Gear and Polo Club brands. It also sells its products through online and store and retail chains. The company was formerly known as Brill Shoe Industries (1988) Ltd. and changed its name to Brill Shoe Industries Ltd. in December 1988. Brill Shoe Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Rishon LeZion Israel.

Name: Aciselsan Acipayam Selüloz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Aciselsan Acipayam Selüloz Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. purchases produces and sells cellulose and cellulose derivatives and sodium carboxymethyl derivatives in Turkey. The company also engages in the import export and trading of various chemicals. Its products are used in detergents paints adhesives and thickeners textiles foods oil drilling ceramics pharmaceuticals cosmetics and tiles and electrodes. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Denizli Turkey.

Name: National Flour Mills Limited
Description: National Flour Mills Limited produces and sells flour and feed products in Trinidad and Tobago. It operates through three segments: Food Animal Feed and Other. The company manufactures and distributes flour milled cereals and dry mixes as well as feed products for dogs and animals. It also purchases and sells imported dry goods rice and oil products. In addition the company provides its products under the Good N’ Natural Hibiscus Ibis Lion Baking Powder Lotus Lion Mauripan Hibiscus Ibis Pholourie Roti & Doubles SAF Instant Perromax Breading Palm National Bakers National Feeds and Command Performance brands. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Port of Spain Trinidad & Tobago. It also exports its products. National Flour Mills Limited operates as a subsidiary of National Enterprises Limited.

Name: Givot Olam Oil Exploration-Limited Partnership(1993)
Description: Givot Olam Oil Exploration-Limited Partnership(1993) operates as an oil and gas exploration and production company in Israel. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Jerusalem Israel.

Name: Söktas Tekstil Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Söktas Tekstil Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. through its subsidiaries engages in the textile and dairy farming businesses in Turkey and internationally. The company produces and sells raw and finished fabrics. It is also involved in the dairy cow breeding milk production and raw milk sales activities; production of yarns; and transfer and twisting of cotton and fiber yarns. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Aydin Turkey.

Name: Foods Gate Trading Co.
Description: Foods Gate Trading Co. operates restaurants under the Tokyo and Kimono brand names in Saudi Arabia. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Telnet Holding SA
Description: Telnet Holding SA a product engineering company that provides technological solutions to various business domains in Tunisia. It specializes in research and development software engineering products network integration and telecom and product life cycle management services and mechanical studies. The company offers embedded software electronic design mechanical concept internet of things digital application cloud computing and artificial intelligence solutions. It serves the aerospace telecom and media energy and electronic payment sectors. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Abdulaziz and Mansour Ibrahim Albabtin Co.
Description: Abdulaziz and Mansour Ibrahim Albabtin Co. engages in the wholesale of foods and beverages used in the preparation of pastries bakery products and ice cream in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ice-cream products such as soft ice-cream bases powder mixes for ice-cream biscuits gelato products stick ice-cream products and mini cones frozen yogurt and kits; and pastry products including pre mixes chocolate and fruit fillings and toppings ripple sauces glazes dried fruits and candied powder cream caramelized grain and biscuits powder margarine whipping cream chocolates sugar pastes liquid and jelly food colorings classic and special pastes concentrated fruit pastes cream fillings and toppings sugar free products and AMBC trays. It also provides bakery products comprising dry yeast improvers bread mixes seeds and flour; and other products such as coffee specialties lactose free milk flavors mojito/squeeze products smoothies syrups and milkshake bases. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: The Arab Ceramic Co.
Description: The Arab Ceramic Co. designs produces and sells sanitary ware faience tiles and other subsidiary products in Egypt. It offers sanitary ware such as water closets and bidets; baby furniture and wall hung washbasins; and laundry products as well as ceramic floor and wall tiles. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Atlas Elevators General Trading & Contracting Company
Description: Atlas Elevators General Trading & Contracting Company engages in selling supplying installing and maintaining electric and hydraulic elevators and escalators in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Grace Breeding Ltd
Description: Grace Breeding Ltd an agro-tech company develops nitrogenous and climate change stress relief products in Europe the United States South America and Israel. The company’s products portfolio includes Nitrogen Fixation Technology for applications in grains including corn wheat barley and rice; and Wide Defense System an stress tolerance enhancer that improves the plant's root system and uptake of nutrients from the soil. Grace Breeding Ltd was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Rehovot Israel.

Name: Hateks Hatay Tekstil Isletmeleri A.S.
Description: Hateks Hatay Tekstil Isletmeleri A.S. manufactures and exports textile products. The company offers towels bathrobes and bathmats as well as special terry products. It also provides cotton raw dyed and melange yarns; cotton gazed mercerized raw and dyed yarns; bamboo raw dyed and melange yarns; core spun yarns; amicor yarns; and sewing and embroidery threads. The company sells its products to department stores retailers wholesalers and linen brands in European and North American countries. Hateks Hatay Tekstil Isletmeleri A.S. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Hatay Turkey.

Name: Yonga Mobilya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yonga Mobilya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacturing of furniture in Turkey. It offers solid wood furniture under the MYSA DRIS BLUEGROUND EDEL SHALSTONE TERAMO MONZA BOSCO BALLATTA ELLA LUGO RIMINI ASTRUPE BODERNE A232 C35 AMIRA ELKA BLYTHE ARTIE LEAN KAYA AND ELLA SONOMA NORD PETIT AND CUBE CAISSON NOVA PERLE MA WASHPARK VAIL LOFT CASSA LOHI ELWOOD CLEO FOXBURY AND TADWICK names. The company exports its products to the United Kingdom the United States Israel Australia Spain and Denmark. Yonga Mobilya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Denizli Turkey.

Name: Aksu Enerji ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Aksu Enerji ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi produces distributes and trades electricity in Turkey. It operates hydroelectric and solar power plants. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Isparta Turkey.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: A.V.O.D Kurutulmus Gida ve Tarim Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: A.V.O.D Kurutulmus Gida ve Tarim Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides dried vegetables and derivatives and vegetable based convenience foods under the Farmer`s Choice brand name in Turkey. Its products include sun dried tomatoes oven semi dried tomatoes sauces and bruschettas fermented vegetables and grilled products and grilled vegetables. The company serves hotels restaurants and the catering industry as well as retail chains. It also exports its products. A.V.O.D Kurutulmus Gida ve Tarim Ürünleri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 2003 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Egeplast Ege Plastik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Egeplast Ege Plastik Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells plastic pipes fittings and by-products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers building group systems which include wastewater pipes and fittings PPRC sanitary pipes and fittings PVC rain gutters and down pipes and heating system pipes and fittings; and infrastructure group systems such as PVC-U pressure pipe systems PVC-U sewer pipes and fittings Aegean corrugated pipes polyethylene (PE) pipes and fittings natural gas pipes and fittings drainage pipes and fittings and HDPE corrugated and PE telecommunication systems. It also provides sprinkler irrigation systems and drip irrigation systems. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Arab Co.for asset management and development
Description: Arab Co.for asset management and development operates as a real estate development company. The company purchases sells leases and acquires land for the purpose of dividing planning and providing infrastructure to the land under management. It is also involved in the development and management of buildings including residential and commercial units malls hypermarkets office spaces and recreational areas as well as builds and manages tourist villages hotels motels and related activities including entertainment sports commercial and cultural activities. In addition it offers advisory services for the preparation of designs and engineering consultancy and supervision of project execution. The company holds as land bank of approximately 588 thousand square meters in Egypt. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Saudi Parts Center Company
Description: Saudi Parts Center Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail trading of spare parts of trucks and heavy transport agricultural and industrial equipment and construction equipment and machinery in Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in repair and maintenance of engines and electric and steam generators. In addition the company sells spare parts of motor vehicles tractors and marine machinery and equipment; and heavy equipment parts trucks spare parts and turbocharger services. Further it provides its products under Fleetguard ITR IPD CGR GHINASSI KMP SANZ ETP LASO SACHS SLP MOTOR SERVICE KOLBENSCHMIDT OE GERMANY Garrett BorgWarner TURBOTECH and HOLSET brands. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia. Saudi Parts Center Company is a subsidiary of Alkhorayef Group Company.

Name: Gilat Telecom Global Ltd
Description: Gilat Telecom Global Ltd provides communication services through satellite and fiber optic infrastructures and radio systems in Israel and internationally. The company offers data communication services including connection and infrastructure services for the Internet network establishment and operation of internal corporate data communication networks and management of the communication infrastructure of Internet providers and cellular operators; and consulting and characterization of networks and communication solutions on the fiber and satellite infrastructure including the sale of equipment installation routine maintenance and operation. It also provides mobile satellite communication services comprises supply of equipment data communication and telephony services and related services. In addition the company offers broadband connectivity and communications solutions. It serves Internet service providers institutions community organizations armies and security organizations. The company was formerly known as Satcom Systems Ltd. Gilat Telecom Global Ltd was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A.
Description: Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and marketing of matches in Chile. The company also provides safety matches splints popsicle sticks traps paint palettes ice cream sticks and ties coffee stir sticks closet doors stairs security doors blinds moldings paint palettes and wooden rules as well as wooden cutlery products such as spoons forks and knifes. In addition it engages in the development and exploitation of forestry agricultural and fruit plantations. The company also exports its products to the United States Peru Brazil Fiji and Japan. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is based in Santiago Chile. Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones San Martin S.A.

Name: Azevedo & Travassos Energia S.A.
Description: Azevedo & Travassos Energia S.A. engages in the exploration production and marketing of oil and natural gas in Brazil. It holds concession contracts in exploratory fields and blocks as well as partnerships that focuses on the development of onshore oil and gas production in the Potiguar Basin with focus on the Mossoró/RN region. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited
Description: Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited engages in the distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and auxiliary products in Jamaica. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Montego Bay Jamaica. Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited is a subsidiary of Bioprist Holdings Inc.

Name: Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company
Description: Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company owns operates and manages Intercontinental Hotel Jordan in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Amman Jordan. Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company is a subsidiary of Zara Investment Holding Company.

Name: Mena for Touristic & Real Estate Investment
Description: Mena for Touristic & Real Estate Investment engages in the construction real estate investment project management and urban development businesses in Egypt and internationally. Its portfolio includes residential commercial and resort projects. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Maadi Egypt.

Name: CWG Plc
Description: CWG Plc engages in the supply installation integration maintenance and support of computer equipment e-payment hardware and ancillary equipment in Nigeria Ghana Uganda and Cameroon. It operates through IT Infrastructure Communication and Integrated Services Managed Support Services Software and Platform segments. The IT Infrastructure segment supplies installs and supports computer hardware; and operates middleware systems and automated teller machines. The Communication and Integrated Services segment offers VSAT and fiber connectivity metropolitan area networks wide area networks local area networks and systems integration as well as network communications support services. The Managed Support Services segment provides internal and external clients managed/outsourcing services and related accessories for equipment and service maintenance. The Software segment offers services in software deployment implementation and support systems analysis design and implementation and smartcard applications as well as training to clients on the systems and other off-the-shelf packages. The Platform segment provides products and solutions as the foundation for growth and progress in ecommerce and society such as BillsNPay SMERP UCP and Finedge. The company was formerly known as Computer Warehouse Group Plc. CWG Plc was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Themis G.R.E.N. Ltd
Description: Themis G.R.E.N. Ltd a construction company plans develops builds and markets real estate projects in Israel and internationally. The company develops residential construction projects commercial spaces offices and clinics as well as parking lots balconies service areas etc. It also operates fitness and health club in the Czech Republic. The company was formerly known as B. Yair Building Corporation 1988 Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Ihlas Yayin Holding A.S.
Description: Ihlas Yayin Holding A.S. through its subsidiaries engages in media publishing and advertising businesses in Turkey. The company publishes newspaper under the Türkiye Newspaper name; operates news agency which provides video news service in Turkey; and produces and publishes news on the national agenda through TGRT News TV. It also broadcasts live news and programs through digital platforms such as Digiturk D-Smart Teledünya and Tivibu as well as over the internet through tgrthaber.com.tr website; and broadcasts educational relaxing and informative documentaries. In addition the company provides integrated services including prepress printing and post-press services for various products such as newspapers magazines promotional materials and books as well as broadcasts programming through TGRT FM radio. Further the company engages in the digital assets business that offers web design mobile content and applications internet software and social media management services. Ihlas Yayin Holding A.S. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Ghida Al-Sultan Company
Description: Ghida Al-Sultan Company engages in the fast food restaurant and franchise business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers burgers under the Sultan Delight Burger and Foil burger brands; pizzas; and chicken under TNDR Tender brand. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Silverline Endustri ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Silverline Endustri ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells hoods ovens built-in hobs built-in dishwashers washing machines and refrigerators. It also produces a range of accessories such as external motors and curved and standard remote controls. The company was formerly known as Gumusfon Metal Endustri ve Ticaret A.S. and changed its name to Silverline Endustri ve Ticaret A.S. in 2005. Silverline Endustri ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Société Tunisienne d'Automobiles - STA Société anonyme
Description: Société Tunisienne de l'Automobile STA operates as a dealer of the Chery brand automobiles in Tunisia. It offers cars and SUVs. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Ben Arous Tunisia. Société Tunisienne d'Automobiles - STA Société anonyme operates as subsidiary of Kilani Holding.

Name: Vanet Gida Sanayi Iç Ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Vanet Gida Sanayi Iç Ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the production processing purchase and sale of various meat and meat products in Turkey. The company provides sausage salami fried meat bath sujuk and ham and bacon products. Vanet Gida Sanayi Iç Ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1977 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd.
Description: Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd. produces markets and sells cigarettes. It also manages leased and not leased properties. In addition the company exports its products. Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Al Eizariya Palestinian Authority.

Name: Agra Limited
Description: Agra Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the agricultural retail and wholesale business in Namibia. It operates in four segments: Retail and Wholesale Auctions Rental and ProVision. The company offers hardware paint and accessories building materials tools and electrical products; convenience stores which include fast food bread coffee groceries beverages snacks ice and braai essentials such as charcoal and wood; water equipment pesticides and fertilizers animal health products hardware and gardening supplies and equestrian accessories; veterinary pharmaceuticals veterinary medicines and over-the-counter products; hunting camping fishing and safari equipment; firearms ammunition and telescopes as well as expert advice; sports rifles; and agricultural supplies animal feed veterinary supplies fencing materials seed fertilizer tools hardware farming infrastructure personal protective equipment building materials home improvement items automotive products and everyday household essentials. It also provides mentorship programs training courses consultancy services and technological advice for business development farming and production management; and education and training with e-learning platform. In addition the company organizes and facilitates auction and liaison services of livestock and agricultural products; measures the performance of various commercial and residential rental properties; and markets and auctions movable goods and agricultural industrial commercial and residential properties online as well as invests in upgrades and renovates residential and commercial properties. Further it operates Auas shopping mall with retail outlets offering fast-moving consumables outdoor products restaurants personal grooming services medical practitioners pharmacy and DIY and farming essentials; and operates fuel stations. Agra Limited was founded in 1946 and is based in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Ismailia / Misr Poultry Company S.A.E
Description: Ismailia / Misr Poultry Company S.A.E engages in the poultry business in Egypt. It is involved in the raising of poultry broiler broodstock and table egg broodstock as well as day-old broiler chicks producing chicks and broiler chickens; manufacturing of feed such as poultry and fish feed; establishing and managing of automated poultry slaughterhouses; marketing of animal protein and oils; production of whole frozen and chilled chicken; sale and marketing of poultry and its products municipal fertilizer and the output of poultry farms; and attaching units Water treatment and waste treatment cooker. Description: Best Lease SA provides finance leasing services in Tunisia. Description: Smartiks Yazilim A.S. offers business solution software development and consulting services in Turkey. Its solutions include data security outsourcing analysis and process management data science data warehouse customer relationship management human resources and enterprise software development solutions. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Giza General - Contracting and Real Estate Investment S.A.E
Description: Giza General - Contracting and Real Estate Investment S.A.E engages in contracting building and real estate investment businesses in Egypt. The company performs various general contracting civil construction utilities and concrete works. It undertakes construction works for prefabricated houses hotels hospitals houses administrative and public buildings touristic villages health institutes mosques services buildings managerial buildings and factories scientific institutes and educational schools infrastructure works and roads networks. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: I.C.P. Israel Citrus Plantations Ltd.
Description: I.C.P. Israel Citrus Plantations Ltd. engages in properties rental and agriculture businesses in Israel. The company operates in two segments Agriculture and Income-Producing Properties. It is involved in planning development rental and management of areas and buildings. The company also provides agricultural services which include planting maintaining and cultivating orchards as well as fertilization irrigation pest control and spraying fruit orchard species replacement and harvest and orchard management. It sells its fruit products to packing houses. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Jordan Dairy Company Ltd.
Description: Jordan Dairy Company Ltd. primarily engages in the production and marketing of dairy products in Jordan. The company offers pasteurized milk various types of yoghurt ewe and skimmed milk white and yellow cheeses flavored milk and shaninah as well as packaged drinking water. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of plastic containers in various shapes and sizes as well as round plastic cups and covers. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: AgroGalaxy Participações S.A.
Description: AgroGalaxy Participações S.A. engages in the agricultural business in Brazil. It is involved in the retail sale of agricultural Inputs; seed production origination storage and sale of grains; and provision of agricultural services. The company also engages in the sale of agricultural machinery and implements; provision of commercial representations agricultural technical assistance phytosanitary services and seed repackaging; shipment and/or receipt of agricultural products on consignment and/or for deposit; and commercialization and export of cereals such as soybeans and corn. It operates light stores silos soybean plants and tooling units. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Berkosan Yalitim Ve Tecrit Maddeleri Üretim Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Berkosan Yalitim Ve Tecrit Maddeleri Üretim Ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells insulation and isolation materials in Turkey and internationally. The company offers polyethylene polypropylene and cross-linked foams. It also provides a range of services such as interstory screed application wall and roof insulation soundproofing and thermal insulation refrigerated cooler vehicle insulation air conditioning inside and outside tools sound and vibration isolation and heat and noise prevention in mechanical installations. The company sells its products under the Foamex Airpack Polyberk Proberk Airfoam and Reflekt X brand names. In addition it exports its products. The company provides its services to the companies in the construction packaging fitting automotive shoes and bags sea products and sports/entertainment sectors. Berkosan Yalitim Ve Tecrit Maddeleri Üretim Ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Sekuro Plastik Ambalaj Sanayi A.S.
Description: Sekuro Plastik Ambalaj Sanayi A.S. engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic packaging products in Turkey. It offers PE air bubble films such as standard bubble films opaque protection products and insulation products; PE shrink films; PE general packaging films; bag and sheet products; and technical films. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Salada Foods Jamaica Limited
Description: Salada Foods Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in manufacture and sale of instant coffee roasted and ground coffee beans and other consumer products in Jamaica. The company offers coffee under the Mountain Bliss 876 and the Jamaica Mountain Peak brand names; tea under the Jamaica Mountain Peak brand; and juices under the Roberts brand. It also offers private labeling services. The company exports its products. Salada Foods Jamaica Limited was founded in 1958 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. The company is a subsidiary of Resource in Motion Limited.

Name: DCB Commercial Bank Plc
Description: DCB Commercial Bank Plc provides various banking products and services in Tanzania. The company operates through Treasury Retail Banking and Other segments. It offers current savings student joint young saver solidarity group bamba call and royal and corporate customer accounts as well as time and fixed deposits. The company also provides loans such as salaried housing microfinance digital salary advance and school fees; loans for fixed deposits; loans to micro and small business sector and savings and co-operative credit societies; solidarity group lending; equipment/investment loans; and medium entrepreneur micro-individual small entrepreneur and macro/corporate loans. In addition the company offers trade finance asset financing and insurance services; foreign currency services; money market services including treasury bills bond investments fixed income trading and other products; and internet and mobile banking and electronic money transfer services. It offers its products and services to individuals small and medium sized businesses and corporate clients. The company operates through a network of branches and ATMs. DCB Commercial Bank Plc was formerly known as Dar es Salaam Community Bank Plc and changed its name to DCB Commercial Bank Plc in February 2012. DCB Commercial Bank Plc was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Nation Media Group PLC
Description: Nation Media Group PLC together with its subsidiaries operates as an independent media house in East and Central Africa. The company operates through Newspapers and Digital and Broadcasting segments. It is involved in the publication printing and distribution of newspapers; radio and television broadcasting activities; and provision of digital online products in the East African countries such as Kenya Uganda Rwanda and Tanzania. The company also offers advertisements in the digital platforms; and subscriptions of e-paper. In addition it provides courier and third-party printing; print publication and circulation; property development; and ticketing services as well as distributes magazines. Nation Media Group PLC was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: National Insurance Company
Description: National Insurance Company provides various insurance products and services in Jordan and internationally. It offers motor marine and transportation fire and other property damage responsibility medical personal accident and life insurance products. The company also undertakes reinsurance activities. National Insurance Company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc
Description: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc manufactures and markets pharmaceutical and animal health products in Nigeria and Ghana. It provides health care ethical and veterinary related products; and poultry and animal range of anthelmintic products as well as production enhancing medicaments. The company was formerly known as Pfizer Inc. and changed its name to Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc. In 1997. Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Saray Matbaacilik Kagitçilik kirtasiyecilik Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.S.
Description: Saray Matbaacilik Kagitçilik kirtasiyecilik Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.S. engages in the production and sale of stationery products in Turkey. The company offers papers including woodfree offset printing coated photocopy and book papers; exercise books such as PP cover wire-o-spiral single spiral soft cover spiral binding stapled binding glued binding and hard cover notebooks; and calendars. It also provides a range of services comprising printing preparation pre-printing after printing and as well as paper sheeting services; and sheet-fed offset web offset and continuous form printing systems. The company offers its products and services under the Yıldız Yayıncılık Vizyon Papicat and SRYBİL brands. It exports its products to England Sweden Hungary Greece and Israel. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Speedvalue Ltd
Description: Speedvalue Ltd together with its subsidiaries provides information technology services. It offers digital transformation cloud and cyber security solutions. The company also engages in the development of web products and mobile applications; server application development; cloud computing solutions; and development of software infrastructure products. In addition it provides technological architecture consulting services; characterization and architecture services; training consulting services; and mentoring services. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Herzliya Pituach Israel.

Name: Padtec Holding S.A.
Description: Padtec Holding S.A. provides equipment/DWDM and services and software and platforms. It offers network maintenance and management; characterization; SPaaS; fiber monitoring; and training services. The company also provides transceivers lightpads switches and routers standalone and DCI generation products as well as digital solutions. It offers its products and services to regional operators internet and telecommunications providers datacenters network operators IT and multimedia government utilities and integrators finance and research networks. The company was formerly known as Ideiasnet S.A. Padtec Holding S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Campinas Brazil.

Name: Mazhar Zorlu Holding A.S.
Description: Mazhar Zorlu Holding A.S. through its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture marketing and sale of various plastic pipes and components in Turkey. It offers PVC and polyethylene pipes and fittings and spare parts; and construction agriculture and infrastructure related pipes and fittings. The company offers its products under the brands Ege Yıldız and Egeplast. Mazhar Zorlu Holding A.S. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Bahema Educação S.A.
Description: Bahema Educação S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides education services in Brazil. The company operates schools and training centers. It also offers basic and continuing education services; early childhood education courses; entrance exam preparation courses; and elementary secondary and related services. The company was formerly known as Bahema S.A. and changed its name to Bahema Educação S.A. in August 2019. Bahema Educação S.A. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: LASACO Assurance Plc
Description: LASACO Assurance Plc provides various insurance products and services in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life and Life segments. It also offers anticipated plan mortgage protection bond education fire special peril and householders insurance. In addition the company provides contractors all risk burglary public liability plants all risk insurance; business interruption money insurance fidelity guarantee goods in transit employers liability computer all risk and motor insurance. Further it offers marine hull machinery breakdown builders’ liability oil and gas erection all risk group life professional indemity insurance. LASACO Assurance Plc serves heavy engineering and construction banking and finance manufacturing agriculture tourism oil and gas and aerospace sectors; and term assurance investment plan occupiers’ liability personal accident investment linked and lasaco marine cargo insurance. The company distributes its products through various forms of brokers agencies and direct marketing programs. LASACO Assurance Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Cruzados SADP
Description: Cruzados SADP organizes produces markets and participates in professional sports activities related to soccer matches in Chile. It operates through two segments Collection and Commercial. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Ersu Meyve ve Gida Sanayii A.S.
Description: Ersu Meyve ve Gida Sanayii A.S. manufactures and sells concentrates and pulp juices from fruits in Turkey. The company offers concentrate products; puree concentrate; puree/pulp; NFC fruits; tomato paste; organic products; fruit juices; fruit nectars; fruit juice drinks; and flavored drinks as well as manufactures and sells plastic barrels. It also exports its products to Canada the United States Germany England Moldova France the Netherlands Austria Poland the Czech Republic Bulgaria Greece Estonia Israel Qatar South Korea China Japan Thailand Australia New Zealand and Indonesia. The company serves retail sales points as well as military facilities hospital cafes schools and sport complexes catering etc. Ersu Meyve ve Gida Sanayii A.S. was founded in 1968 and is based in Konya Turkey.

Name: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd.
Description: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company develops orally bioavailable small molecule therapeutic products for the treatment of cancer liver inflammatory diseases and erectile dysfunction in Israel. The company's lead drug candidate Piclidenoson which has been completed Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of psoriasis. It develops Namodenoson that is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of liver cancer; and Phase IIa for the treatment of pancreatic cancer; as well as in Phase IIb trial for the treatment of metabolic associated steatohepatitis; and CF602 which is in pre-clinical trial for the treatment of erectile dysfunction. In addition the company develops commercial predictive biomarker blood test kit for A3AR. It has license and collaboration agreement with CMS Medical to develop manufacture and commercialize Piclidenoson and Namodenoson; and collaboration agreement with Univo Pharmaceuticals to identify and co-develop specific formulations of cannabis components for the treatment of cancer inflammatory autoimmune and metabolic diseases. The company was formerly known as Can-Fite Technologies Ltd. and changed its name to Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. in January 2001. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products
Description: The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products produces and sells ceramic and porcelain products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers sanitary ware products ceramic walls and floors houseware vases hotel dishes and ceramic decoration as well as tableware products. The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products was founded in 1955 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Nairobi Business Ventures PLC
Description: Nairobi Business Ventures PLC trades in hardware materials and sodium silicate in Kenya and East Africa. The company trades in cement and steel. It also engages in air direct connect and aviation management solutions maintenance of tires and leasing of hangar as well as repair and maintenance of heavy trucks. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Blender Financial Technologies
Description: Blender Financial Technologies provides financing solutions in Israel and internationally. It offers banking loans car finance payment and investment services. The company was formerly known as V-Financial Technologies Ltd. Blender Financial Technologies was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Lasco Financial Services Limited
Description: Lasco Financial Services Limited provides a range of financial services to customers in Jamaica. The company operates as a Cambio dealer and remittance services provider; and as an agent of MoneyGram International money transfer BOSS revolution money transfer Ria Money Transfer and Skip Di Line Application. It also offers consumer loans to salaried borrowers; business loans and support to micro and small businesses; distribution of Visa prepaid cards; and e-payment solutions. In addition the company provides value added services including bill payment. Lasco Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Avrasya Petrol ve Turistik Tesisler Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi
Description: Avrasya Petrol ve Turistik Tesisler Yatirimlar Anonim Sirketi operates oil facilities and tourism activities. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: BioLineRx Ltd.
Description: BioLineRx Ltd. a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company develops and commercializes therapeutics for oncology and rare diseases. The company’s pipeline includes APHEXDA (motixafortide) a peptide that is in Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of sickle cell disease and Phase 2b clinical trial for the treatment of pancreatic cancer as well as completed Phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of multiple myeloma. BioLineRx Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Hevel Modi'in Israel.

Description: Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company produces and sells writing and printing papers in Egypt. Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company operates as a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Cutix Plc
Description: Cutix Plc manufactures markets and sells electrical automobile and telecommunication wires cables and related products in Nigeria. The company offers polyvinyl chloride (PVC) single flexible flat and power cables; PVC insulated and sheathed house wiring cables; industrial power cables such as armored and non-armored cables; solar cables; and flexible and automotive cables for transmission manufacturing and house-hold electrical appliances. Name: RoboGroup T.E.K. Ltd.
Description: RoboGroup T.E.K. Ltd. engages in the robotics motion control and technology education business in Israel. The company develops manufactures and markets training products and e-learning systems as well as engineering and manufacturing technology training systems; and plans and implements technology laboratories for the education system. It also develops markets and distributes Coderz platform products an experiential gaming digital platform for science and virtual robotics competitions through virtual robots programming languages challenging arenas and curricula designed for learners of various levels and ages in the general science and technology education and home education markets. In addition the company markets and sells products from third parties for the training and education market; and offers installation and maintenance services. It offers its products under the Intelitek Robotec and CoderZ brands. The company was formerly known as Eshed Robotec (1982) Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Rosh Ha'Ayin Israel.

Name: Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc
Description: Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc provides non-life insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Pension Administration and Health Care segments. The company offers fire and special perils motor bond aviation marine oil and gas energy property agriculture personal and group accidents household third party travel workmen’s compensation construction health and other insurance products. It also provides engineering insurance products including contractor’s and erection all risks insurance policies as well as machinery breakdown insurance. In addition it is involved in the administration and management of pension fund assets. The company was formerly known as UnityKapital Assurance Plc changed its name to Veritas Kapital Assurance Plc in April 2018. Name: Rodrigo Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Rodrigo Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. provides clothing products in Turkey and internationally. The company offers its products through online as well as stores. Rodrigo Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was formerly known as Rodrigo Tekstil Turizm Insaat Gida Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Rodrigo Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in July 2012. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Bernabe Cote D'ivoire SA
Description: Bernabe Cote D'ivoire SA engages in the trading and distribution of hardware products tools industrial equipment metallurgical products and construction materials. Description: Sabaa International Company for Pharmaceutical and Chemical Industry engages in the manufacture and sale of generic medicines in Egypt. It provides hard gelatin capsules such as Acitretin; film coated tablets including Saboctic Topiramate and Tolterodine; and tablets such as Claudol and Flamogen E.C.T. The company also offers OTCs food supplements and veterinary products as well as medicine trials services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Meyar Company
Description: Meyar Company manufactures and sells cement products. It offers ready-mix concrete raw material interlock and bardora and blog. Meyar Company was founded in 1960 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: The Egyptian Modern Education Systems S.A.E.

Description: Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited operates as a real estate investment company in the Caribbean region. The company provides flexible financing to real estate markets such as industrial residential commercial and hospitality. It also offers investment banking wealth management wealth advisory and alternative investment platform services including private equity and credit. The company was formerly known as Sygnus Real Estate Investments Limited and changed its name to Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited in January 2019. Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: Unga Group Plc
Description: Unga Group Plc through its subsidiaries engages in manufacture of human and animal nutrition products and distribution of animal health products in Kenya. It operates in two segments Human Nutrition and Animal Nutrition and Health. The Human Nutrition segment produces products for human consumption. The Animal Nutrition and Health segment offers animal feed and mineral supplement products. It also offers wheat flour rice and pulses porridge and maize meal. In addition the company manufactures and sells cakes roles breads and pastries. Unga Group Plc was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Arab Aluminum Company (S.A.E)
Description: Arab Aluminum Company (S.A.E) engages in the extrusion of aluminum profiles in Egypt. It also offers anodizing extrusion and painting services as well as operates a shop that engages in the design manufacture service and maintenance of dies and accessories. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Ra'anana Israel.

Name: Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool
Description: Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool engages in the manufacture and sale of worsted wool textiles in Egypt. It offers suits jackets vests or coats as well as other casual and formal men and womenswear collections. The company also exports its products primarily to Europe and North America. Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited
Description: 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiary engages in the construction and rental of living facilities at the University of the West Indies (UWI). The company is also involved in restoration and reconstruction of traditional halls. 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Arab Real Estate Investment Co.
Description: Arab Real Estate Investment Co. engages in the real estate business in Egypt. Gafisa S.A. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: San-el Mühendislik Elektrik Taahhüt Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: San-el Mühendislik Elektrik Taahhüt Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. designs manufactures and sells electrical panels in Turkey. Name: HomeBiogas Ltd
Description: HomeBiogas LTD develops produces and markets biogas systems for treatment of organic waste into clean energy for households farmers businesses and communities worldwide. Universal Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Embpar Participacoes S.A.
Description: Embpar Participacoes S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the wood and real estate business in Brazil. The company operates through Forestry and Property Management segments. It engages in the industrialization and trade of wood and its derivatives; and the management and administration of real estate property. The company was formerly known as Battistella Administração e Participações S/A – APABA and it changed its name to Embpar Participacoes S.A. in April 2008. Name: Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.)
Description: Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.) invests in real estate and construction industrial and financial services sectors. Description: El Kahera El Watania Investment engages in the underwriting of securities business in Egypt.
