Description: Egyptians for investment & Urban development engages in the real estate and tourism investment businesses. The company is involved in the construction of real estate and tourist villages hotels restaurants and residential villas; land division activities; and purchase sale and rental of real estate properties. It also provides tourist housing complementary works infrastructure import export and commercial agency services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Speed Medical Co
Description: Speed Medical Co a healthcare company that operates medical lab chain in Egypt under the Speed Lab brand. The company also operates polyclinics under the Speed Clinic brand; and a 140-bed hospital in East Cairo. Speed Medical Co was founded in 2015 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: FTN Cocoa Processors Plc
Description: FTN Cocoa Processors Plc engages in the processing and sale of cocoa beans and palm kernel seeds in Nigeria. The company provides cocoa cake cocoa liquor cocoa butter cocoa powder palm kernel oil and palm kernel cake products. It serves manufacturing companies. The company also exports its products. FTN Cocoa Processors Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Buff Technologies Ltd.
Description: Buff Technologies Ltd. operates a loyalty program that rewards gamers for playing. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: Euro Trend Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Euro Trend Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. manages the portfolio of capital market instruments. It monitors the developments related to securities financial markets institutions and partnerships for portfolio management. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Westwing Comércio Varejista S.A.
Description: Westwing Comércio Varejista S.A. operates as an online furniture store in Brazil. The company offers furniture for living and dining rooms other rooms garden and balcony and desks as well as children furniture; bed and bath products beach towels and children’s bed and bath linens; and decorative and lighting items including cushions lighting decorative accessories organizers frames and plates mirrors candles and scents and vases and cachepots. It also provides rugs curtains and blinds; table set products such as dishes cutlery and flatware table textiles glasses and cups serving utensils and bar and coffee utensils; and kitchen items comprising pots baking pans and oven utensils small and home appliances utensils for preparing knives and cutting boards confectionary and patisserie and cooking utensils. In addition the company offers lifestyle products which include food and beverages fashion items children’s products beauty and care accessories and pet products; and seasonal items. It sells its products through its website platforms for mobile applications and physical stores. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Plascar Participações Industriais S.A.
Description: Plascar Participações Industriais S.A. through its subsidiary manufactures and sells plastic pieces and parts related to interior and exterior finishing of motor vehicles in Brazil. The company provides bumpers instrument panels door panels consoles interior trim air vents package trays windows inner fenders spoilers threshold and other aerodynamics elements front grills frames and badges interior trim parts tail lights headlights brake lights interior lights and components applied to the engine compartment. It also offers non-automotive products such as injection molding; and assembles supermarket carts and card machines. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Jundiaí Brazil. Plascar Participações Industriais S.A. is a subsidiary of Padua IV Participações S.A.

Name: Main Event Entertainment Group Limited
Description: Main Event Entertainment Group Limited provides entertainment promotion agency and management services in Jamaica. It also engages in planning coordinating and delivering diverse entertainment and event related experiences as well as provision of advertising marketing digital signage audio film and corporate communications services to clients. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Main Event Entertainment Group Limited is a subsidiary of MEEG Holdings Ltd.

Name: Goto Ltd
Description: Goto Ltd provides mobility solutions in Israel and Germany. It offers shared transportation services including shared electric scooters and shuttle vehicles. The company also provides car rental and leasing services; develops an application and a website for car sharing and rental; and offers support services as well as audio and voice advertising services. Goto Ltd was founded in 2008 and is based in Tel Aviv Israel.

Name: Evogene Ltd.
Description: Evogene Ltd. together with its subsidiaries operates as a computational biology company in Israel the United States Israel Brazil and internationally. The company focuses on product discovery and development in life-science based industries including human health agriculture and other industrial applications through its computational predictive biology (CPB) platform. It operates through three segments: Agriculture Human Health and other Industrial Applications. The Agriculture segment develops seed traits ag-chemical products and ag-biological products to enhance plant performance. The Human Health segment discovers and develops human microbiome-based therapeutics for the treatment of immuno-oncology gastrointestinal inflammatory related disorders and antimicrobial resistance organisms. The Industrial Applications segment focuses on the development and commercialization of improved castor bean seeds for industrial uses. The company also provides medical cannabis products. Evogene Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Rehovot Israel.

Name: O.R.T. Technologies Ltd
Description: O.R.T. Technologies Ltd engages in development production and marketing of smart ticketing and data collection systems for managing public transportation. It also provides smart cards; electronic ticketing payment management and control systems; back office servers database application business logic communications and cash registers; driver consoles vending machines and vehicle validation devices; and manual and automatic devices for validation stations. The company was formerly known as Rapac Electronics Ltd. and changed its name to O.R.T. Technologies Ltd in 2006. O.R.T. Technologies Ltd was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Herzliya Pituach Israel.

Name: National Aluminum and Profiles Company
Description: National Aluminum and Profiles Company manufactures and sells of aluminum profiles in Palestine. The company’s products are used in construction and decorative applications such as windows and doors series kitchens shutters curtain walls industrial profiles decoration fencing gardens standard profiles special profiles for air conditioning openings etc. as well as in residential commercial government curtain wall and thermal break projects in a form of profiles bars plates and aluminum alloys. It is also involved in the coating deposition and painting of aluminum. In addition the company exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Nablus Palestinian Authority. National Aluminum and Profiles Company is a subsidiary of Arab Palestinian Investment Company.

Name: Tropical Battery Company Limited
Description: Tropical Battery Company Limited engages in the distribution of renewable energy batteries in Jamaica the United States and Dominican Republic. It operates in Energy Storage and Renewable Energy Solutions segments. The company offers batteries coolant car-care car-accessories brake-fluid engine-oils solar-products and tyres. It also provides battery maintenance training free battery and electrical testing used battery collection and export mobile response on site installation and repairs and tyre training services. In addition it operates a network of automotive retail stores. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: NPF Microfinance Bank Plc
Description: NPF Microfinance Bank Plc a microfinance bank provides banking and other financial services in Nigeria. The company offers retail banking loans and advances and other allied services. It provides its services to poor and low-income households and micro enterprises such as members of the police community. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. NPF Microfinance Bank Plc is a subsidiary of Nigerian Police Co-Operative Society Limited.

Name: Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited
Description: Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of seasonings sauces spices canned ackee and callaloo primarily for the export market. It operates in two segments Species & Other and Canned Products. The company serves its products to food service markets. Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Afric Industries S.A.
Description: Afric Industries S.A. designs manufactures and markets flexible abrasive papers for manual sanding in Morocco. The company offers dry abrasive papers for machine metal wood plastic paint ceramics stone rubber and leather; and wet sandpaper for wood varnish plastic glass and other hard materials. It also provides aluminum accessories for assembling cut drill and punched profiles as well as building seal and concrete pipe seal. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tangier Morocco. Afric Industries S.A. is a subsidiary of Aluminium Du Maroc SA.

Name: Nictus Holdings Limited
Description: Nictus Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries retails motor vehicles tires furniture electrical appliances and home electronics in Namibia. It operates through three segments: Retail Properties and Insurance and Finance. The company sells multi-brand tires retreaded tires wheels and allied services; and operates as a dealer of Isuzu Suzuki Subaru Tafe and Hero vehicles as well as provides automotive glass solutions including windscreen replacement chip repairs and related rubber fitment solutions. In addition it provides vehicle rental services risk management solutions and financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles and accessories. Further the company operates as a specialist insurer; and invests in properties. Nictus Holdings Limited was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Arabia Investments Holding
Description: Arabia Investments Holding engages in the non-banking financial engineering contracting and manufacturing businesses in Egypt. The company offers bricks and tiles as well as involved in hardscape paving solutions. Arabia Investments Holding was founded in 1985 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: C & I Leasing Plc
Description: C & I Leasing Plc provides marine services in Nigeria Ghana and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Marine Fleet Management/ Hetrz Rent-A- Car Outsourcing and Citracks segments. The company offers onshore and offshore terminal services including berthing and escort mooring line and hose handling pollution control and floating and self-elevating platforms. It manages vehicles and professional chauffeurs that provides pick-up and drop-off reservation airport shuttle and daily rental services under the Hertz-Rent-A car brand. In addition the company provides manpower recruitment and development training business process outsourcing e-business personnel outsourcing and human resource consultancy services. Further it offers fleet management and telematics solutions. Additionally the company is involved in equipment leasing; trading in ships and boats; and provision of chartered vessels. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. C & I Leasing Plc is a subsidiary of Pmt Global Investments Nigeria Limited.

Name: Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Turevleri San. Tic. A.S.
Description: Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Turevleri San. Tic. A.S. engages in trading of commodities in Turkey. It offers gasoline diesel and fuel oil products; and operates fuel stations. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc
Description: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc provides marine and aviation logistics services to the oil and gas industry in Nigeria and Sub-Sahara Africa. The company also offers charter shuttle and maintenance services for helicopters and airplanes; and harbor and general marine services. In addition it provides marine services such as agency service boat building boat maintenance and boat operations services; and training services including training to pilots and engineers of contracting organisations. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc is a subsidiary of Tasmania Investments Ltd.

Name: Real Estate Egyptian Consortium S.A.E
Description: Real Estate Egyptian Consortium S.A.E. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Egypt. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC
Description: Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC engages in the provision of personal and business banking services in Tanzania. It offers personal current foreign currency current and savings semi fixed child saving and career accounts for individual customers; and business banking accounts including corporate current call deposit and club/NGO current accounts. The company also provides loan products comprising personal insurance premium financing global education and MSME business loans as well as salary advances; and business overdrafts and bank guarantees. In addition it offers insurance products such as fire and allied perils; and liability motor marine engineering agricultural and life insurance products. Further the company engages in the foreign exchange activities. Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Blanco y Negro S.A.
Description: Blanco y Negro S.A. focuses on organizing producing marketing and participating in professional entertainment and leisure activities and shows of sports and recreational. It also provides advisory support management and consultancy services as well as engages in the educational activities. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Macul Chile.

Name: Chams Holding Company Plc
Description: Chams Holding Company Plc together with its subsidiaries provides identity management payment collections and transactional systems and solutions in Nigeria. It operates in three segments: Identity Management and Solutions; Payments Collections and Transactional Systems; and ICT Training. The company engages in identity management activities including prometrics and biometrics identification with applications in the financial healthcare corporate and other public fields; the sale and maintenance of Dermalog machines fingerprint scanners BVN machines and data card products; and the design print and personalization of various types of cards products. It also provides payments systems that involve building developing and maintenance of ICT infrastructures; e-payment infrastructure support to other e-payment platforms; Smart and Chip Card a technology for card personalization identity card enrolment logistic and access control. In addition the company offers Argone a retail service provider for the sale of phones laptops and accessories; PenCentral a platform for remitting pensions; PelPay payment platform; Naira.com which provides payment solutions; HR payroll solutions; VOTA an e-voting platform; I’m Alive digital facial recognition service; and Kegow a mobile money solution. The company was formerly known as Chams Plc and changed its name to Chams Holding Company Plc in May 2022. Chams Holding Company Plc was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Sanlam Kenya Plc
Description: Sanlam Kenya Plc a non-banking financial institution through its subsidiaries engages in underwriting life and non-life insurance risks in Kenya. It operates through Life Risk Life Savings Participating Non-Life and Investments segments. The company underwrites life and non-life insurance risks such as death disability credit protection mortgage protection and property protection. It also provides motor home burglary all-risk group personal accident product liability public liability marine construction all risks electronic equipment directors and officers and commercial motor general insurance products. In addition the company offers education cover financial planning investments Flexi Educator Plus FADHILI Funeral Cover personal accident insurance and motor comprehensive private insurance solutions as well as Flexi Hela that offers flexible savings with life cover. Further it provides investment management services. The company was formerly known as Pan Africa Insurance Holdings Limited and changed its name to Sanlam Kenya Plc in August 2016. Sanlam Kenya Plc was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Sanlam Kenya Plc is a subsidiary of Hubris Holdings Limited.

Name: Office Plast SA
Description: Office Plast SA engages in the manufacture and sale of office and school products in Tunisia. The company offers archive and filling boxes storage cartons cardboard folders polypropylene shirts ring binders lever arch files adhesives slates logs and tokens glue book covers and tracing instruments. It also provides office desk trims card and diploma holders cases pouches door blocks books and document protectors white boards dividers and sorters. The company also exports its products to European and African markets. Office Plast SA was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Medjez El Bab Tunisia.

Name: Y.B Urban Renewal - Residential Development Ltd
Description: Y.B Urban Renewal - Residential Development Ltd engages in the cultivation and production of medical cannabis. Its products comprise medical cannabis oils indoor inflorescences select inflorescences value inflorescences and cannavix. The company was formerly known as Cannassure Therapeutics Ltd and changed its name to Y.B Urban Renewal - Residential Development Ltd in July 2024. Y.B Urban Renewal - Residential Development Ltd was founded in 2016 and is based in Ashdod Israel.

Name: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd.
Description: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. a biopharmaceutical company engages in the acquisition and development of pharmaceutical drugs for the treatment of autoimmune diseases in Israel. Its lead drug candidate is hCDR1 which is a Phase II-ready asset for the treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjogren’s syndrome. The company has a licensing agreement with Yeda Research and Development Company Limited for the research development and commercialization of hCDR1 for various indications. The company was formerly known as Xenograft Technologies Ltd. and changed its name to XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. in July 1995. XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan Israel.

Name: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd.
Description: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. a technology company engages in the development of smart multi-spectral 3D vision software solutions and cellular-based applications for the automotive industry in Israel Japan the United States and internationally. It develops in-line-of-sight vision solutions and beyond-line-of-site accident-prevention solutions. The company offers QuadSight automotive vision solution a four-camera multi-spectral vision solution that combines two sets of stereoscopic infrared and visible-light cameras for obstacle detection; DynamiCal an automatic calibration software solution to ensure that automatic calibration calibrated to create accurate and continuous 3D depth perception; and ScaleCam a separated stereo camera solution. In addition it provides Percept3D a 3D point cloud solution that provides 3D raw data for obstacle detection terrain analysis and autonomous vehicle sensor fusion; and Mono2Stereo a solution that enhances existing vision sensor systems by using software-based algorithms to create a 3D perception stereo vision solution. Further the company offers Eye-Net Protect a cellular-based V2X solution that provides real-time pre-collision alerts to various road users such as pedestrians cyclists scooter drivers etc. by using smartphones. Its solutions are used in automotive defense autonomous vehicles and agriculture and heavy industrial equipment industries. The company was formerly known as Asia Development (A.D.B.M.) Ltd. and changed its name to Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. in January 2016. The company is headquartered in Ness Ziona Israel.

Name: Tikun Olam-Cannbit Pharmaceuticals Ltd
Description: Tikun Olam-Cannbit Pharmaceuticals Ltd engages in the cultivation production marketing storage distribution export and import and sale of cannabis-based products in Israel. The company provides medical cannabis products for the treatment and relief of symptoms in a wide variety of medical indications. It also offers training and patient care services. Tikun Olam-Cannbit Pharmaceuticals Ltd was founded in 2006 and is based in Nof HaGalil Israel.

Name: Tigi Ltd.
Description: Tigi Ltd. engages in the provision of heat-as-a-services for commercial and industrial customer in Israel. The company offers its Honeycomb Collector a solar thermal collector that generates heat for space heating industrial process heat domestic hot water in cold climates as well as space cooling. It is also involved in the management and handling design installation integration with current heat generating system and financing and support of the system as well as metering of the energy supplied. The company was founded in 1979 is headquartered in Hod Hasharon Israel.

Name: Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited
Description: Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited engages in the manufacturing and distribution of flavours for beverage ice cream baking and confectionery industries. The company also manufactures fragrances including laundry detergents fabric softeners dishwashing liquids and cleaners for household and general cleaning and sanitation purposes. It has operations in Jamaica Dominica Republic Trinidad & Tobago Barbados Guyana Suriname Dominica St Kitts Nassau Puerto Rico United Kingdom and Canada. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited is a subsidiary of Derrimon Trading Company Limited.

Name: Arab Engineering Industries
Description: Arab Engineering Industries provides wire-on-tube condensers for use in household refrigerators chest and up-right freezers and other refrigeration equipment in Egypt. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Berger Paints Jamaica Limited
Description: Berger Paints Jamaica Limited manufactures and distributes industrial and decorative paints and paint-related processed materials in Jamaica and internationally. The company provides decorative architectural industrial and automotive products. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Lewis Berger West Indies Limited and changed its name to Berger Paints Jamaica Limited in 1972. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Berger Paints Jamaica Limited is a subsidiary of ANSA Coatings International Limited.

Name: Gencell Ltd
Description: GenCell Ltd. engages in the development and production of fuel cell-based energy systems. It offers GenCell BOX a long-duration backup power solution that provides source of 5kW backup power for telecom and critical communications applications; GenCell REX a utility backup power solution that produces 5kW of emission-free electricity for substations during power outages; and GenCell FOX an off-grid power solution for telecom schools homes hospital border protection CCTV water purification and pumps and heating. The company also provides GENCELL EVOX a grid independent EV charging station; and GenCell IoT Remote Manager a backup power solution for utilities telecom homeland security healthcare and other industrial applications. It operates in Israel Mexico the United States Romania Germany Italy and Canada. GenCell Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Petah Tikva Israel.

Name: Sansuy S.A.
Description: Sansuy S.A. engages in the trading of flexible PVC plastics in Brazil. The company offers its products for agribusiness aqua business visual communication transportation architecture and decoration coverings offshore construction and industrialization. It also exports its products. Sansuy S.A. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Embu Das Artes Brazil.

Name: Atlas Menkul Kiymetler Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Atlas Menkul Kiymetler Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. engages in the portfolio management activities related to securities traded on national and international exchanges. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd.
Description: ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd. engages in the production and sale of concrete based products in Jordan. The company offers concrete masonry products including hollow/solid and insulated blocks ribs kerbstones and interlocking tiles as well as plain and patterned concrete tiles retaining wall and industrial building blocks single and double flowerpots and wheel stoppers. It also provides hollow core slabs precast elements pre-stressed/post tensioned concrete ceilings and bridges and glass fiber reinforced concrete products. The company offers its products for government and private projects. ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Al Qastal Jordan.

Name: Identi Healthcare Ltd
Description: Identi Healthcare Ltd provides healthcare inventory management systems. It offers Snap & Go an image recognition technology to record medical implants and consumables used during surgery; RFID SmartCabinet an automated inventory system developed to helps cath labs neurosurgery ophthalmology EP labs orthopedics plastic surgery gastro and other; and Narcotics Cabinet an automated system for the administration of controlled substances and narcotics. The company also provides Kanban & PAR solutions including Smart Weighing Bin a wireless and autonomous smart scale bin that re-orders its own supplies; Stock Pick a solution that counts units taken and triggers an automatic order after reaching a level; Restock Tag a solution that automatically replenishes inventory by clicking a button; and Scan & Restock a mobile App to order and monitor orders. In addition it offers IDENTIPlatform a cloud based platform powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning that connects suppliers to hospitals; and gas cylinder stock management and curtain disinfection and cleaning services. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Netanya Israel.

Name: Jordan Investment & Tourism Transport Co.
Description: Jordan Investment & Tourism Transport Co. provides passenger transportation services in Jordan and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Metro Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
Description: Metro Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. manages a portfolio of capital market instruments on national and international stock exchanges in Turkey. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Transport & Investment Barter Company
Description: Transport & Investment Barter Company engages in the logistics and land transportation business in Jordan. It offers car carriers; land container and crude oil transportation; diesel transportation service; and transportation of heavy loads goods and vegetable oils as well as operates tippers and skeleton trailers. The company also provides land transportation to flatbeds vegetable oil tanks heavy duty tankers-lowboys fuel-diesel tanks crude oil tanks livestock and sheep carriers and foodstuffs and container transport decks. Transport & Investment Barter Company was founded in 1979 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Massivit 3D Printing Technologies Ltd
Description: Massivit 3D Printing Technologies Ltd operates as a provider of industrial 3D printing systems in Italy and internationally. The company offers Massivit 10000 an additive manufacturing system for composite materials; Massivit 5000 an industrial-grade 3d printer for automotive railway and marine sectors; and Massivit 1800 produces full-scale prototypes parts and display; 3D printing materials. It serves 3D printers for use in automotive marine rail theming and entertainment education research and consumer products. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Lod Israel.

Name: International Co. For Investment & Development
Description: International Co. For Investment & Development engages in the investment business in Egypt. The company is involved in investing money in housing and urban expansion projects; leasing real estate properties; and producing and selling animal poultry and fish products. It also engages in the contracting works for housing projects; reclamation and cultivation of lands; division and sale of lands; sale of residential projects; import and commercial agency business; and financial leasing activities. International Co. For Investment & Development was founded in 1981 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Chellarams Plc
Description: Chellarams Plc engages in the trading and distribution of consumer goods durables ingredients and industrial chemicals in Nigeria. The company offers industrial raw materials including propylene glycol isopropanol stearic acid toluene sodium laureth sulfate or sodium lauryl ether sulfate caustic soda ethyl acetate mineral oil petroleum jelly and paraffin wax. Its foam chemicals products comprises TDI polyols silicone surfactants amine and stannous colour pastes methylene chloride kraft papers and nylon mattress and pillow covers. The company supplies its chemicals for sectors such as food processing pharmaceuticals and manufacturing. Chellarams Plc was founded in 1923 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A.
Description: Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A. provides telecommunications services in Tunisia and internationally. Its services portfolio comprises architecture design and engineering audit consulting project management training implementation and integration and support and maintenance. The company is also involved in deployment of networks and fiber optic backbone PDH-SDH and WDM; copper networks and related environmental solutions; implementation of FTTx high speed broadband telecommunications framework; and energy air conditioning and security systems installation testing and measurement activities. In addition it offers communications and information solutions; develops security policy framework; intrusion prevention and advanced detection functions; cloud computing security solutions; and consulting services for analysis implementation and management of content; unified communications and collaboration work tools comprising fixed-line and mobile telephony over IP video telephony audio/video conferencing contact centers and IVRs and office automation tools as well as unified and instant messaging calendars word processing presentation software presence and telepresence web conferencing and document sharing and management systems; multimedia contact screens; surveillance systems; and various television and interactive services. Further the company assists in renovating lighting installations; and provides smart transportation waste-collection management smart irrigation and smart metering solutions as well as managed security services network management platforms and systems and performance management solutions. Société Tunisienne d'Entreprises de Télécommunications S.A. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Lupatech S.A.
Description: Lupatech S.A. provides equipment for the oil and gas sector in Brazil. The company produces industrial valves; valves for oil and gas; synthetic fiber ropes for anchoring oil platforms and various other applications; and composite material artifacts such as poles and tubular sleeves for coating oil pipelines. It also exports its products. Lupatech S.A. was formerly known as Valmicro Indústria e Comércio de Válvulas S.A. and changed its name to Lupatech S.A. in March 1993. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: García Reguera Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera e Inmobiliaria
Description: García Reguera Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera e Inmobiliaria operates department stores in Argentina. The company offers various products for home and personal use. It provides clothing for men women and children; table linens; luggage; and school items. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: T4F Entretenimento S.A.
Description: T4F Entretenimento S.A. operates as a live entertainment company in South America. The company provides a range of artistic scientific and educational content. It also promotes and sells tickets for shows and events such as live music events; produces family events and theater; operates venue; operates in ticketing industry under the Tickets for Fun and Ticketek brands; sells food beverage and merchandise; and offers corporate sponsorship services comprising event promotions. T4F Entretenimento S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Sao Paulo Brazil.

Name: Limuru Tea Plc
Description: Limuru Tea Plc engages in the growing manufacture and sale of green leaf tea. It owns 282 hectares of tea plantations located in the east of Limuru town. The company is based in Limuru Kenya. Limuru Tea Plc operates as a subsidiary of Lipton Teas and Infusions Kenya Plc.

Name: Convertidora Industrial S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Convertidora Industrial S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and conversion of plastic films for use as flexible packaging in Mexico and internationally. It provides metallic balloons and flexible packaging products for food packers health products pet foods meats party items and various industries. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Guadalajara Mexico.

Description: Jordan French Insurance Co. (P.L.C.) provides various insurance products and services in Jordan. The company also provides life insurance products comprising term life educational universal life personal accident and group critical illness insurance products as well as AMAL programs. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Image Plus Consultants Limited
Description: Image Plus Consultants Limited operates as a medical imaging company in Jamaica. The company offers diagnostic X-ray ultrasound computerized tomography scan fluoroscopy nuclear medicine magnetic resonance imaging mammography and interventional radiology services under the business name of Apex Radiology. It operates through Apex Medical Centre Winchester Medical and Surgical Institute 129 Pro (Liguanea) and White River Commercial Complex Shops 89&10 Ocho Rios and St. Ann. Image Plus Consultants Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Cocoa Processing Company Limited
Description: Cocoa Processing Company Limited processes cocoa beans to semi-finished products in Ghana. The company offers semi-finished products such as cocoa liquor butter chocolate coated Peanut chocolate powder choco delight choco bake and cocoa powder under Portem brand name. It also manufactures and markets chocolate bars under the Kingsbite Oranco Akuafo Coffee Choc Portem Nut Portem Pride Tetteh Quarshie and Aspire brand names; chocolate dragee under Pebbles brand; chocolate spread under Choco Delight name; drinking chocolate under Royale Natural Cocoa Powder Alltime and Vitaco name; and chocolate couvertures under Choco Bake brand name. Cocoa Processing Company Limited was founded in 1965 and is based in Tema Ghana.

Name: Nutriplant Indústria e Comércio S/A
Description: Nutriplant Indústria e Comércio S/A engages in the development and production of micronutrients and raw materials for industrial use in Brazil. It also offers inoculants such as azospirillum and bradyrhizobium; biodefensives to protect crops from pests and diseases; and specialty fertilizers under the FTE Supreme Comosol TechNutri Foskalium Original Café Green Top VIP and ATR Power brand names. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Barueri Brazil. Nutriplant Indústria e Comércio S/A is a subsidiary of Tripto Participacoes Ltda.

Name: Maendeleo Bank PLC
Description: Maendeleo Bank PLC provides banking products and services in Tanzania. The company offers accounts such as achievers for students salary Ahadi Wekeza executive saving fixed deposit business current flexi fixed and community accounts. It also provides loan products including executive loan for senior executives managers head of departments directors chiefs and high net worth individuals; agribusiness loan; Jamii loan for projects by religious institutions; poultry financing; house microfinance loan; small group loans; MSME loan for small and medium enterprises; savings and co-operative credit societies loan; salary loans; renewable energy loan; and sepa na bajaji loan which includes insurance. In addition the company offers agency mobile and internet banking as well as other ICT-driven solutions. Maendeleo Bank PLC was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Orçay Ortaköy Çay Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Orçay Ortaköy Çay Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the manufacture and sale of various tea products in Turkey and internationally. It offers packaged bag aged and white-green tea products. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Rize Turkey.

Name: Key Insurance Company Limited
Description: Key Insurance Company Limited operates as a general insurance company in Jamaica. It operates through Motor and Non-Motor segments. The company offers motor commercial and personal property casualty liability engineering travel and personal general and miscellaneous accident insurance products. Key Insurance Company Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica. Key Insurance Company Limited is a subsidiary of GraceKennedy Financial Group Limited.

Name: Erika Carmel-Tech Ltd
Description: Erika Carmel-Tech Ltd develops manufactures markets distributes and sells the B-Cure laser products in Israel and internationally. It offers B-Cure Laser Classic a non-invasive and safe medical device for the treatment of chronic and acute pain for home use; and B-Cure Laser Pro a clinically proven non-invasive and safe medical device for treatment of both acute and chronic conditions. The company treats achilles tendon inflammation burns carpal tunnel syndrome finger joint pain fibromyalgia hip pain post-dental treatment lower back pain neck pain shoulder pain knee pain tennis elbow to joint pain temporomandibular joint disorders upper back pain and wounds. The company was formerly known as Erika B-Cure Laser Ltd and changed its name to Erika Carmel-Tech Ltd in October 2025. Erika Carmel-Tech Ltd was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Haifa Israel.

Name: Berger Paints Nigeria Plc
Description: Berger Paints Nigeria Plc manufactures distributes and sells paints and allied products in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Paints and Allied Products Contract Revenue and Investment Property Rental Income. The company also leases real estate properties; and offers painting services. Berger Paints Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Ikeja Nigeria.

Name: Euro Kapital Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Euro Kapital Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi creates and manages partnership portfolio in Turkey. It monitors developments in financial markets institutions and partnerships; distributes the investment risk through portfolio diversification; and offers portfolio management services as well as conducts research to protect and enhance value of the portfolio. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ankara Turkey.

Name: ABC Transport Plc
Description: ABC Transport Plc provides road transportation and logistics services in Nigeria and Ghana. It operates through Coach Sprinter Shuttle Cargo Haulage Hospitality CTI and Trading segments. The company offers executive express city transit coach West Africa cargo express and courier services. It also involved in the import and sale of vehicle spares; installation of motor vehicle speed governing devices; hospitality business; and assembly of heavy duty trucks. In addition the company operates the City Transit Inn hotel in Utako Abuja. The company was formerly known as Associated Bus Company Plc and changed its name to ABC Transport Plc in August 2011. ABC Transport Plc was founded in 1993 and is based in Owerri Nigeria.

Name: Fica Empreendimentos Imobiliarios S.A
Description: Fica Empreendimentos Imobiliarios S.A together with its subsidiaries develops invests constructs and sells real estate properties in Brazil. The company was formerly known as CR2 Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A. and changed its name to Fica Empreendimentos Imobiliarios S.A in June 2023. Fica Empreendimentos Imobiliarios S.A was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Contempro For Housing Projects P.L.C.
Description: Contempro For Housing Projects P.L.C. engages in the construction and sale of residential apartments in Jordan. The company owns and purchases land; and invests in real estate sector. It is also involved in the tourism and agricultural land investment businesses. Contempro For Housing Projects P.L.C. was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Sequoia Logística e Transportes S.A.
Description: Sequoia Logística e Transportes S.A. provides logistics warehouse transportation supply chain and operation management services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Embu Das Artes Brazil.

Name: Arab Jordanian Insurance Group
Description: Arab Jordanian Insurance Group together with its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Jordan. It operates in two segments The General Insurance Sector and The Life Insurance Sector. The company offers life accident travel fire vehicle marine and transportation health engineering general and domestic workers insurance. It also purchases and sells stocks bonds and securities; buys improves develops separates and sells lands; and owns real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Bubbles Intergroup Ltd
Description: Bubbles Intergroup Ltd engages in the production purchasing importing marketing and distribution of children clothing products. The company sells clothing and accessories footware toys and games products for the age of 0-16 children. It sells its products through online and E-commerce channels as well as operates online platform under the www.bubblesoniine.co.il website; and under the franchise agreements. The company was formerly known as Mobile Max Technologies Ltd and changed its name to Bubbles Intergroup Ltd in August 2022. Bubbles Intergroup Ltd was founded in 2004 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo Israel.

Name: Les Ciments de Bizerte
Description: Les Ciments de Bizerte manufactures sells and exports cement clinker lime and other products in Tunisia. Its products include Portland cement and limestone; artificial hydraulic lime; and clinker Portland. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Bizerte Tunisia.

Name: Jordanian for Management & Consultancy
Description: Jordanian for Management & Consultancy provides specialized consultancy services in the field of health insurance management in Jordan. The company offers medical insurance management services. It also engages in purchasing selling trading importing and exporting products and materials such as machines equipment and vehicles for sale installment sale and finance lease. Jordanian for Management & Consultancy was founded in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Tedea Technological Development and Automation Ltd.
Description: Tedea Technological Development and Automation Ltd. through its subsidiaries manufactures imports markets and sells building materials in Israel. It is also involved in managing and investing activities. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Herzliya Israel.

Name: El Nasr Manufacturing Agricultural Crops S.A.E
Description: El Nasr Manufacturing Agricultural Crops S.A.E engages in the manufacture drying cooling and sale of agricultural crops in Egypt. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beni Suef Egypt.
